tei:div.tei:p: 'amatshu lta ba gyad kyi la sku ni hūṃ snang cha gnas 'gyur dur khrod thod mkhar dbus: pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi bsgol ba'i khar: rig pa hū las rta mgrin yang khros sku:mthing nag lcags kyu khyung nag phyag char bsdam: khro chas rab rdzogs gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khyud: gdos bral dwangs ma 'od kyi sku ru gsal gnyis snang lha 'dre bdud gegs ar la gtad: byas hya spri wa shrī ka la na gwa sod: snang ba gtad med ngang la bzhag rig pa so ma'i rang tshug skyongs gnyas su snang ba chos skur bsre gnod byed spros rtog ka nas dag sa ma yu sngags kyi mchod cing bstod pa na hūṃ hrī: 'bar ba'i gar mdzad 'jig tshogs zil gyis gnon: bzhad pa'i glu yis dregs pa dbang du bsgyur: thugs rjes gzigs pas 'khrul ba chos skur bcoms: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i rgyal la bstod: zhes pa 'ang chos gsal dang rin mtshos bskul ngor nus ldan pa sa bris pa 'o
bye /
'a( cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin nag po'i gab don shin tu bsdus pa'i lhan thabs pad ma'i phreng mdzes bzhugs so:

btsakhri na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye za chenan/ bsnyen ci sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas dkyil 'khor gsum du khyer shes shing dag nyams bden pa dbyer med du rdzogs pa'i bskyed pa' rim la 'jug sa ma mā dang po bsang chu byin rlabs ni o badzra yakta hūṃ: zhes brjod pas dur khrod thod 'bar rlung me 'khrugs shing 'tshubs pa'i dbus su: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang yum rlung 'byin mas sku las phra bar rdul gyi khro tshogs spro bsdus 'byung po dam sri 'thar zhing gzhom pa'i mthu ldan du dmigs la: hūṃ snyi ta kṛ ta tshinta tshinta hūṃ phaṭa: brgya rtsa brjod mthar/ lha nyid 'od zhu bsang chu dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni hūṃ : bde ba'i rang mdangs pad ma'i yol go rtsa dga' bzhi'i rang gzugs lha mo grangs med pas:blta na sdug pa'i lha rdzas kun bzang sprin mkha' dbyings dogs mor byed pa'i byu dza yangs dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer 'bul lags na: nye 'du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma'i: dgyes bskangs bcu drug rab 'bar chogs gnyis rdzogs don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i dngos grub stsol oṃ ma hā byu dza sa ma ya ho: sbos byu ni oṃ : dri med

ba:tshu yid 'ongaspos kyi sprin chen po: badzra dhu pe'i tshogs kyis rnam par spel: dbyings las spros shing ye shes dbyings su 'bul: rang mtshan chags rtogs ka nas dag gyur te: mchod pa chen po mkha' dang mnyam par sbyor: mnyam nyid thabs shes zung 'jug dal du 'bul: slo badzra dhā pe pra ti tsa a nyu: rol mo byin rlabs ni hū trī: la la nā da rdu di'i ring bzhin las sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rol mo ni: dbyings ye sras kyi dkyil 'khor skongs phyir 'bul khams gsum rnam par rol ba'i rtar drangs nas: khu rdul rlung sems bde ba chen por smin mi shig sgog gzugs grub pa dwangs ma'i sku: 'og min zla gam dgu ru byang chub mdzod: o badzra shabha pra titstsha a /: skyabs yul bskyed pa na mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal chen po rta mgrin yang gas khros pa la rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs zhing rab 'byams mu mtha' yas pa'i bskor nas rang cag sgrub pa po la zhal gyis phyogs: spyan gyis gzigs thugs brtse ba chen po'i dgongs shing bskyabs par mos la skyabs sems brjod mthar maṇḍal na 31 āḥhū: zhin khams chen po

nam mkha'i khyon mnyams par: lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor longs spyod gter: bdag lus bde stong dus gsum dge tshogs dang: sems nyid 'od gsal dbyings rig dbyer med par bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir 'bul tram̐ ratna maṇḍal badzra pu dza sa ma ya ho: mthar tshogasazhing rnam rang la thim pas gnyis su med par lta'o bgegs gtor gtong ba na rang nyid gnyug ma'i lha mchog dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer gyur: tshe hya skṛ wa hrī: rgyu las rin po che'i sgod du oṃ las glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung por gyur: o.ā hūṃ: na mo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden mthu dang: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje'i lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin zab mo'i bden pa'i mthus: dam chos thos bsam sgom gsum bskyed rdzogs bsnyen bsgrubs kyi dgongs spyod la slob par 'tshe bas 'byung po gnyis 'dzin can thams cad lan chags 'jal ba'i mgron tu 'dus shig: sarba bighan a ga ya dza dzatshumaho: glud bsngo ni o.uḥsmi tshe rab sngon nasad lta'i bar: bu lon bsnyegs pa'i 'byung po ni: yid

btsa: kyi gzugs can thams cad kun: lan chags 'jal ba'i mgron tu 'dus 'dod lnga'i dga' ston sgyu ma'i 'phrul: ting 'dzin dkor nor zad med pa: rang rang yid dang mthun par 'bul: dga' mgu yi rang bsam pas spyod: 'dir 'dug skal dang gnas med pas: byam dang snying rje'i chos nyan la: dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha mthar dengs: phyin chad nye bar ma byed cig: gal te 'tshe zhing glag blta na: khro bo khro mo'i rnam mkha' gang: mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshubs: 'dre 'jigs yung dkar thun char 'bebs: gdon bgegs 'byung po'i lus sems bral de bas da lta phyir dnges shig:hū hūṃ sarba bisnye ghad tsha: byin 'phebs la rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul te: rnga yab nas o rgyan rin po che dang zla gam dgu rdzogs dbang gi 'od khyims nas: rjes chags bshad pa'i zhal bzang can dbang chen yang gsang khros pa sras 'khor dang bcas pa bskul nas: thugs dam chen po las bzhengs te bdag gnas sgrubs rdzas yo byad rnams la byin chen phab cing dbang mchog bskur bar bsam mo: dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni rang

gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul te rgyal ba sras bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar rigs lnga'i rnam par byon nas dbang bskur zhing rtag kyi rnam par bzhugs nas dbu brgyan par mos la: o ma hā pra te sgye kta na badzra swā bha wa atma da ko3nya: tshe ma hāphag darsha oṃ ma hā sa ma ta oṃ ma hā shu bye ta sa ma hā kri te (spyi na zhes ye shes lnga dang ldan par dbang bskur: phung po rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du rgyas gdab: 'byung ba dbyings kyi phyag rgya ru mnga' gsol bar bsam mo: slar yang rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung gsang bsam mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid chen po sku mi 'gyur: gsung 'gags med: thugs ye shes 'khrul bral gyis rol par rgyas gdab par mos la: sgo sarba ta tha ga ta ma hā: ka ya wakka tsitta su bha wa atpa ko3nya: tiṣṭha badzra: dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa nas ye shes rjes su chags pa'i khro rgyal rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa sras 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la bstims mo: phreng ba byin rlabs na o sarba dharma ga ga na ā rin po che pad ma rā ga'am byu ru'i phreng ba'i dngos mtshan mi dmigs pa las: bde ba mchog gi rang gzugs

ba:tshu pad ma rigs kyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs su gyur te kun kyang rol pa chen po'i gar mdzad: byang chub sems kyi zer thag gis sbrel te gzhan phan thugs rjes nyi mas 'gro khams rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs par bsam la: sa ru ci ra marta na pra wadhe na ye swā hā: nyer gcig dang dbyangs gsal byed rten snying gis rab tu gnas par bya'o bskang sa byin rlabs ni sarba dharma gha gha na aḥtshogs rdzas gyi dngos mtshan mi dmigs pa las: mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong: rin chen sna bdun gyi gzhi yangs khod snyoms bkrag 'bar 'od gsal ba'i zhing dri ma med pa ra shar ba'i dbus su: tshogs rdzas dang bskangs rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas thams cad ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba: grangs mang la bkod legs pa: lha klu mi dang mi min gyi 'dod rgu phun sum tshogs pa mdzes sdug blta bas mi ngom pa'i phyag rgya mu mtha' yas pas pu dza bde ba mchog gi dga' ston spro ba: shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i dga' ston: ting 'dzin gyi dkor nor: mi zad pa'i dpal 'byor chos dbyings nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter chen po 'di rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing

spyi dang: bye brag rjes chaṭa padma gsung gi dal du rgyas shing khyab nas dgyes pa skongs la bdag gzhan gyi tshogs chen po rdzogs par mos la nam mkha' mdzod sngags kyi spel bar bya'o tshogs bsgral la tshogabadasnod lcags(khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang: tshogs rdzas zhing bcu tshangs ba'i dgra bgegs dngos su gsal la: na ma dam na mtshago gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden mthu dang: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los bden pa chen po'i mthus: tshe sgog thar lam la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la khug cig zloX tri:a garsha ya dza dza lhag gtor byin rlabs ni pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ ha ho hrī: lhag malisgod bharnya lcang lo can yang shing rgya che bar lhag gtor sha khrag rus pa'i phung po 'dod yon nam

rus rgesum las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod yon lnga yi phung po dug gsum rnam par dag pa'i rol ston du gyur: oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hohrī lanagasum bstan gtor la rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar bshal chu dang gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gyur rmo.ā hūṃ lanagasum bro mnan la mi mthun pa'i phyogs slong ba'i dam sri 'byung po thams cad nub par bsam la na mo skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnams gsum gyi bden pa dang dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje glu gar bro yi dbang phyug rta mchog rol pa rtsal gyis bden pa dang: bden gnyis basmu ba med pas bden pa chen po' mthus sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri 'gab 'dre bse rag dbul sri pho mo thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og rol du khug cig dzaX/ baṃ ho: gnod byed dam sri 'byung po thams cad rims dgu sa yi 'og rol: gru gsum mun pa nag po: las

kyi gshin rje'i bsha' khang: 'byung ba dgra gshed 'thab pa'i btson dong 'bar bar khug dza bstims nan tri dza tri rbad ma tri ya su tri ya du tri ya ma 'du ya he dha ra ni dza e sha hūṃ ma ra ya nan nan: gtor snod btegs pa'i tshe hūṃ: pad ma'i yol ko stong gsum dang mnyam par phan bde'i dge mtshan dpa' yon gyi char chen pos yongs su gang bar gyur cig:tso sarba a yu pukhye puṣṭi ku ru ye swā hā: mchod dmigs ni bdag bskyed las spros pa'i 'dod yon gyi lha mo grangs med pas mdun bskyed rjes chags bzhad pa'i rdo rje gsang ba gsum gyi dgyes pa skongs bar bsam la: bstod dmags ni mardzas sdug yid du 'ong ba'i lha mo grangs med pas mnyam sbyor phyag rgya lnga dang rdo rje glu yis bstod pa rgya chen po phul bar bsam la: mthar lha mo rnams bdag bskyed kyi gnas rnams su thim pas dbang byin dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam mo shis brjod la rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul te: dag pa dbyings gsum na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyis mdzes pa'i gar dang bro mdzad: snyan pa'i bkra shis glu

pa(tshu dbyangs kyi brda' bstod brjod thugs gnyis su mi phyed pas gus 'dud kyis ngang dang ldan pas dge mtshan bkra shis pas me tog tshal du dngar zhing tshigs su bcad pa sgrogs par mos la: smon lam na na mo gu na rgyal ba'i bstan padar zhing rgyas gyur cig: bstan 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs pad bstan gyur cig: yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde skyid ldan gyur cig: nad mug mtshon gyis bskal ba zhi gyur cig: bsod nams longs spyod mnga' thang gyur cig: bshad dang bsgrub pa'i bstan pa 'phel gyur cig 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing la 'god gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs gyur cig: gu ru'i mdzad pa phrin las rgyas gyur cig: don gnyis rmad byung yid bzhin 'do/nga shākyar cig: dza ya dza ya ba dza ya: de ltar smon lam rgya cher gdab sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshangs bar bslab thams cad dag mnyams lam du khyer tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam ma lus mtha' ru phyin par byed sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'idabang po pa da ma saṃ bha was ma 'eng 'gro la rjes su chags pa yis thugasakyi yangasabacudardo rje snya po 'a skor tshogasasmon la 'dzomasathugs kyi sras la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda' la

bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong la dgongs pra sdoms ma 'o snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus mo rgyan nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bsnyan 'gro'i rgud pa sna mang sel 'gro phan phrin las byang nas byang rong rgyas 'brel tshad rnga yab dpal gyi ri la 'god zab pa'i srog tig spu gri gsum la gnyer dam nyamasa'adod sred can la mi 'chor bar skal ldan thugs kyisamasadang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya rta nag lcags ral can gyis gab tig zab pa'i lhan thabs rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhesapa'angasgrul ba'i sku pad ma zeg mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bskur ngor kho bo nusaldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis/

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin nag po'i brgyud 'debs dpal gyi bum bzang bzhugs badzra na mo gu ru pad ma kā ra ye: shā dzonosgo /shā khyed shes dad pa drag po yis oṃ ā hūṃ: yi grol gdod nas dag pa kun tu bzang: rang bzhin 'gags med 'od gsal snang mtha' yas: thugs rjes mkhyen gnyis dbang phyug skyabs grol la: gsol ba 'debs so don dam rtog pa sbor dga' rab rdo rje chos kyi 'byung gnas dang rdzogs chen ston pa rig 'dzin shrī seng bi ma mi dra ye shes bka' rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs so don dam rtog pa spor gsung gi bka' bab na gardzu na dang: rta skad gtsug bton rgyal ba mchog dbyangs zhabs mi brjed gzung thob ye shes mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so don dam rtog pa spor: brgyud gsum chig rdzogs bla ma pad ma 'byung:ye shes gzigs pa brgyud pa'i gu ru dang: nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gter bzhed snying po la: gsol ba 'debs so don dam rtog pa sbor: dbang chen rta mjen yang gsang khros

pa dang: bde ba mchog gsang 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sprin: rdo rje'i srog ldan bka' sdod rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis lhun grub shog snang zhen rnam dag ye shes lha ru smin: sgra grags bde chen gsung gi rdo rjer dag 'gyu 'phro ye shes thugs kyi thig ler rdzogs: dka' ba med par he ru ka zob shog de ltar gsol bawa byin rlab 'jug pad ma'i pha nor thugs kyis bcud skal ldan bu yi dpal du bzhag mdo khams rdzo sal dgongs pra bsdoms las can bu la gtad rgya byas snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus sbasargya bkrol nas 'gro phan shog sam yu rgya rgya rgya rta mgrin nag po'i brgyud 'debs dpal gyi bum bzang rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o bdo zim snyi zhes pa'ang rig srasatheg mchog rgyal mtshan dpa slob bu chosagasal/ grogs rnam na yang yang bskul ngor nus ldan pasaspel ba ma lam/

gtsa(: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa la brten pa'i sngon gtor 'bul ba phrin las rgya mtsho bzhugs btsaX na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye:gro nyadzosgo smo dkar dmar gtor ma skyems phud bshams sngags da phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel lhar gsar ting 'dzin brtan po yas dkar nag gnyis skyongs phyag rgyas bkugs tha tshag sgrogs ba 'ad skad do dza hū stong pa chos dbyings nam mkha'i khams la rgyu:rgyal bstan rin chen bsgrub pa'i drod la nyul:sngags pa'i dam la rlung gis rtsal gyis pheb sgrub pa'i gral mthar pus btsug thal sbyar gnas lhag bsam dkar po'i skye rgu'i bde skyid spel brngan pa'i gtor mar dkar dmar skyems bzhes la:mtha' mi dbus su 'byung ba'i rgud pa dang:chos mdzad bla ma sun ma'i cho 'phrul rkyen:sgrub pa'i sgo gtor zhing bcu tshangs ba'i dgra thar lam 'phrog byed phung sri 'byung po'i tshogs zhi bzlog bsgyur la ming med stong par mdzod:gnyer bcol phrin las ma g.yel sa ma yā:gnyer bcol gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs rnam ma phrin las gang bcol 'grub sgrub pa

zab mo' cha rkyen 'di skal ldan can gyi dpal du shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya sngon gtor 'bul ba phrin las rgya mtsho rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim lha zhes pa'ang theg mchog rgyal mtshan chos gsal ratna sa ra rnamasakyis bskul ngor/ kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyisadabyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod lasabasgyur ba dge legs 'phel sarba ma le

ba tshu bka' bakhi ni hū hū ye nas rnam dag chos sku'i zhing: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i spros pa dben: padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor ste 'di la 'byung po'i glag mi rted mtshon chen ye shes 'du 'phro 'byed: log par 'dren pa tshar chod cig: hūṃ hūṃ sarba duṣṭan phaṭa: srung gur ni hū mtha' dbus mi dmigs de bzhin nyid 'bar ba'i khro tshogs bu yug 'tshub: ye shes phyag rgya lnga yis gtams: zla gam dbang gi dal du shar dzñā na dhartu badzra rakta: byin 'bebs ni hū trī: zla gam dgu rdzogs me ri 'bar: ye shes gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'bar ba'i khro rgyal rta mchog dpal: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir bskul lags na: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams dang rtogs pa 'bar ba dang: rtags mtshan bzang po dang bcas nas a nu ra ga'i dbang bskur zhig e hya hi sa ma ya dzaXs:baṃ ho: mgo rdzas byin rlab ni hā gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir 'dod yon lha mo dpag med pas nam mkha' rab 'byams khyod bkang ba'i: bla med phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: rno āḥhūṃ:badzra pu dza spra ra ṇa sa:

'amatshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i byin 'bebs ye shes gzi bskyed bzhugs so:badzra na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: 5sno shā sha chen dud btang rol mo lol snyan pa'i dbyangs kyas 'di skad gyer hū dza: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: dpal ldan kun bzang yab yum la rgyal ba rigs lnga'i 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang bskur 'od lnga lhun grub pho brang nas: bde gshegs rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor la: sems dpa' lcam dral 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang bskur: rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: o rgyan pad ma thod phreng la: rje 'bangs lo paṇa 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang bskur: dhu ma tha la'i pho brang nas: ḍakki'i rje mo mtsho rgyal la: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang bskur: ma la ya yi pho brang nas chos skyongs ma mgon lcam dral la: bka' sdod dam can rgya mtshos bskor gnas 'dir byin

phob bdag dbang bskur zla gam yo yi klong dkyil nas: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa la: rdo rje rnal 'byor tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang bskur:dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs gcig phyungs: sgrub rdzas rnams la bcud cig phob: rnal 'byor bdag cag nyams rtog sbor: rtags mtshan ma g.yel myur du ston: e hya hi sa ma ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho: a be sha ya a āḥ sha chen sbyar spos bdug rol mo krol brtul zhugs bskyed des ni byin pheb pa'i drod rtags 'byung bar 'gyur ro sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya rta mtshog rol ba'i byin 'beb ye shesagazi bskyed rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda zim snyi zhes pa'ang theg mchog rgyal mtshan dang chos gsal ratna sa ras bskul ngor nus ldan pa sa so
'a( zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can gyis gab don zab pa'i ti ka bzhugs so:

badzra na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye ba 'ustem114 dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa na the'u rang 'go bo dgra ru lda rgya 'dre lung po'i za kha dar gso ru mi bayi nad kyis gzer de tshe nag po lha gsum 'dis phrin las myur zhing byin rlabs zab rno nus gzhan las ya mtshan 'phags bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal sa ma yu 'dil spyor dngosarjes da gsum dang po sbyor ba'i las la gsum skyabs su 'gro ba 'di lta ste/ na mo: dkon mchog kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor la: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: bdag sogs yal bar ma dor rjes su zungs lan gsum de nas sems marga bskyed pa ni bdag gzhan gyi don du dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa yi dam du 'dzin cing bskyed rdzogs bsgom bzlas la 'bad par bya'o: lan gsum de nas tshogs bsags bya ba ni rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyi rnams 'phrul ba'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub chu bo

ba tshu gcod pa'i bgegs nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos:ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang:dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med:rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do:bde gshegs dbang phyug sems dpa' la:dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo:tshe rabs dge bsags ci snyed pa:bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig:sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig bde legs dpal dang mi 'bral zhing:mnyam nyid don la gnas gyur cig:lan gsum gnyis pa la bskyed na gzung 'dzin gyi sems rnam par dag pa gdod nas ma byung ma skyes pa'i de bzhin nyid du mnyams par bzhag go:de'i ngang las nyi ma 'bum dus gcig la shar ba lta bu'i 'od zer kun tu snang ba chen por klas so:skad cig nyid la sgra brag cha tsam du o hya snyi wa trīXzhes yongs su gyur pa las:'jin rten gyi khams rnam par dag pa dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i 1nga:rab 'jigs thod mkhar rngams pa brda rtags rdzogs pa 'od gsal ba'i gzhal med

khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su: ma chags pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i khar rig pa hrīḥmathing nag spro bsdus yongs su gyur pa las: bdag nyid skad cig gis rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis shin tu khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khyud cing: spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig tu g.yo zhing smar smin las me stag 'phro ba: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar gyi mche ba gtsig shing lcags kyi ral pa gnam du gzing ba: thod skam lnga yi dbu la brgyan cing dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phur ba: gtsug rgyan rta mgo ljang zhur hi hi sgrogs pa'i rnam par mtshan pa: dur khrod dpal chas sku la klubs shing zhabs gnyis gyad kyis 'dor thabs su bzhengs pa: phyag g.yas gdug pa'i snying 'byin gyi lcags kyu bsnams shing: g.yon pa nā ga klu 'dul gyi khyung nag spro ba sku che brjid 'jigs su rung ba bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bskyed do: dregs pa gza' klu sde brgyad 'dar zhing bka' la nyan par mos pa'i thugs srog hrī las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'og min pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas ye shes pa
she/ //tt+waṃ bhe bhe bhe hūṃsmyo bhett+waṃ sdebye kṣiṃ/ ghi rdo bhebhe ṭwāṃ bhe ༷ bhe/ de / de ༷

mchod pa ni hū:trī nyam pa zhing bcu bsgral ba'i dam rdzas ni: dbang lnga'i me tog tshil gsur bdug pa spos: rnam shes mar me mkhres pa'i dri chab dang: sha rus zhal zas rkang gi gling bu sogs: dug gsum gnas stong sman rag gtor chen po yang gsang khros pa'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul: bdag gzhan don phyir mnyam pa nyid du rol: sarba rā tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: ma hā pu dza khā hi: bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: nyon mongs bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i khri yi khar: rjes chags bshad pa'i sku mchog char sprin mdog: yang gsang khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ha hi'i gad rgyang sgrogs pa'i sa gsum g.yo hi hi rta glu'i khams gsum mnga' dbang bsgyur: 'gros dang skad dgu'i gdul bya yong grol byed yang gsang khros pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgongs pa bde chen ye shes 1nga du 'khyil: rjes su chags pa'i gnas yul dur

bsgotshu dag pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: lhag pa'i lha mchog bsnyen cing sgrub lags na: ngar 'dzin sgyu lus snang zhen rnam dag nas: pad ma he ru ka dpal myur 'grub shog 'dzab ni rang pad ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs rin po che mchong gur phub pa lta bu'i dbus su: dbyangs gsal nyi zla'i dal theb long tsam gyi lte ba la: padma dbang chen tshon gang ba gcig gsal gdab pa'i thugs gar: rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru tsam gyis lte bar hūṃ mthing nag spus bris pa tsam gyi mthar rang sngags 'bru bdun gyis g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don mdzad: rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i byin rlabs bsdus te gnyis su med par bstims pas 'khor 'das kyi dpa' yon la rang dbang 'byor bar mos la: hya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa: ting 'dzan 'gyur med gzer gdab bas smra bcad rtsa sngags bye ba bzla bde drod 'bar zhing dri bzang 'thul nyams rtogs yon tan bsam yas 'char bsnyen pa'i rtags tshad zeb pa 'o/sa ma yu sgrub 'dzab ni rang rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sku ru gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng las spros pa'i

'od zer gyis: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen nus brtse ba'i yon tan thams cad bsdus te gnyis su med par bstims: 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyi las sgrib sbyangs: tshe dpal 'byung ba'i dngas bcud thams cad bsdus te gnyis med par bstims: khyad par du tshe dang ye shes kyi gter chen po dang rig pa'i 'od gsal la mnga' dbang 'byor bar mos la: rgo tyā snyi wa bṛ ka la sakhya su kha sirnyi pha la /: bzlas pa dbug gi rta la drangs spro bsdu'i 'od zer 'dzab rgyun 'dzin 'khor 'das dpal yon gcig tu dril bye ba bzlasapa'i yon ma 'phel me mar rang 'bar bdud rtsi khol/ sgrub pa tshad du theb pa'i ltas sa ma mā las 'dzab ni rang rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sku yi cha thams cad nas khro chung mtshon thun nyi rdul ltar 'tshubs pas: 'byung po dam sri sde brgyad ma rung ba dang sa bdag klu gnyan gtod rigs rnams kyi sha la za: khrag la 'jib: rus pa mur: rkang la ldag: tshar bcad rdul du brlag par dmigs la: skyirngo tyā snyi wa ka la yakka mu tra bhyo dza: sa nā ga srog tshig nan gags lhog srin la rbad mdze grag grum bu la dza skya ya chu ser sum sbril la bhyo rims

—4rdo yams grib gdon dzwa la ram swā hā:rnam pa gzhan du ma yeng bar 'bum phrag bzlas pa sasteng gdon dang bar gdon 'og gdon kun las grol 'gos nad srin rigs sogs lasargyal nus pa gnam lcags thog dang 'dra gang la gzas kyang de gzhom 'gyur sa ma yu slar mang sa sngagasasrung 'khor bstan 'dre 'jigs spang spos yung dkar dang mu zi gla nag lnga po yis ril bu gran 'bru tsam du bya snag gi na bza' gsol bar bya las sngags 'bum gyis dab bskur nas btung dang phyug dang bdug pa yis klu gnyan sa bdag nad las grol sa ma yu shang kun sru nag phag tshil dang gze ma ra mgo byi rug pa bye byas sngagasapas dri chu bsre las sngagasa'abum btab sbyar bdug na sde brgyad gdon nad kun la bsngags sa ma mā dza ta gla rtsi lga pu pho gu waṃ chang rnyang khu bas bskol dro 'jamasamanal tshe btung ba na grang ba'i nad rigs kun la zab sam ya bong nag spang rtsi tsa ṭa ka ga bur nag po 'dre 'jigs rnams zhib btag chu grang gis btung na tsha ba'i nad la mchog tu bsngags sa ma mā rgya gar tig ta hong len dang snyer shun dom mkhrisogur gum rnam chu bskol grang mosabatung ba na mkhris pa'i nad rnams kun la bsngags sa ma ā gser me sga pu pho cung zhi shing tsha sur dkar dbyi mong ba gos dre spang brgyan dkar po dang dza ti zhib btags btung ba na bad nan nad rigs kun la zab sa ma mā ya ru dza

ti tsasnyen dang shing tsha ske gre skru ru dang gur gum bdun thang skar chu'i bskol grang 'jams bas bas rlung la bsngags sa ma yu gla nag rtsidang 'dre 'jiṭa pa glang chen snyi haṃ dom mkhris dang /kha gur sman chen nag po ga bur nag po bdun dus kyi yams rigs kun la bsngags sa ma mā gnyi pa sngag kyi sbyor ba ni gza' sdum la ni sngags 'di btab trī kring tsakra rbad:'bum bzlas btab pas gza' grib thub klu bdud rdo rjer sngags 'di btab nā ga 11ga tshig ram 'bum btab klu nad kun la bsngags spang spos la ni sngags 'di btabacas tshal pa shag pa rbad:'bum btab btsan nad kun la zab stag sha la ni sngags 'di btab yasga tiphur re ram̐ dza:'thum bawa gnod sbyin gdon nad sel 'dre 'jiṭa la ni sngagasa'adi bawa ra dza tsitta dung shag tshal:'byum bawa rgyal gdon thams cad thub thang phrom la ni sngagasa'adi bawa raklo yaklo tshal shag myog:'bum btab mo 'dresagadon nad sel glang dmar rwa gzhob sngags 'ad btab rakta tshe ma ngas kha dun dza:'bum btab srin po'i nad la bsngags phag brun nus bsregs sngagasa'adi btab sa zhenag gnyan gtod shag pa tshal pa trig rbad:'bum btab sa bdag gnyan gtod thub yung ba la ni sngags 'di btab snyen mkhris pa rtsa 'khyams nig tshal rbad 'bum btab mkhris pa'i nad la bsngags gla nag rtsi la

ba:tshu sngags 'di bto theb theb khreb khreb sod sna khrag mtshon khrag khrag nad thub chang ning la ni sngags 'di bawa zhi zhi dug zhi swā hā 'bum bawa rlung gi nad la phan sisnyo ra la sngags 'ad bawa oṃ tsha sod gzhob sod tsha yu ru ru sod:'bum bawa tsha ba'i nad rnams sel cung zhi bsreg bzhus khu ba ma oṃ dzer spu shad pho thogs mkhris gzer ram sod dza:'bum bawa pad gan nad la bsngags sa dmar chu sbyar sngags 'di bawa thab ram lang ti ta sod:'bum btab thab nad kun la mchog chu grang bskol da tha chu bsre mig shad jer ling skyam swā hā:khrag lang srin ling dzer ling dang thab li grib li 'bum bawa sel dri chu la na sngagasa'adi bawa a snyi rtsa chu'i sgo khrol khrol 'bum bawa rtsa chu bsdam pa grol la phub khu ba chang sbyar bawa rtsa rus gab 'then bcingasakhrolaswāhālas bags spyosas ga asnye 67793 locho ra gonon khrudagu'adi4ngabs stengagadonagaza'askaraganodapozha rkarka skasgo55zo gang zig khru dgu bya ba 'dis mkha' 'ayo ma myog thams cad thub thalngasgyu bzo dpa 'a bo khru dgu bya ba 'dis ra dza gdon gyi rgol ba thub rwa'i rgya tha4 gnam thig khru dgu bya ba 'das steng 'og bar gsum the'u

rang thub shākhu〉shā ma'ithan29 gar gyi dpal dgu bya ba 'das bkra ma shes pa'i rkyen rnam thub 434paratshang 'ogs kyi phag dgu bya ba 'dis bar gdon dreg pa sde brgyad thub ju rgya 13 2char gyi dpal dgu bya ba 'dis 'og gdon sa bdag klu gam thub 5 sgo thig le khru dgu bya ba 'dis lo zla sa dus ngan pa thub ba ga zi15 thub pa khru dgu bya ba 'das nad rims yam nad thams cad thub thu na 24 tha'ir4 non pa wā dgu bya ba 'das sgrang gzer g.yo rims thams cad thub rtarnyatho nyi111jo 'a ba raku khru dgu 'dis dus min lo dang rkyen ngan thub stornyasgyumirwarnarshadma gsod byed las kyi khru dgu 'dis chung 'dre chung sri chung bdud thub ri rnathona'i ma la 'azu dgu bya ba 'dis god 'dre god gdon thams cad thub tha' tshotshocho1 'phro gser gyi wā dgu bya ba 'dis rta sri rta god thams cad thub ngalnga 77kwa chu yi 'bru dgu bya ba 'dis nya 'og glo dang kha tsha thub cha ma2'iza za gsal byed khru dgu bya ba 'dis tsha mkhris rlung dang bad gan bsrung ka bzhugargyalca ruzatshodzham gyi 'byu dgu bya ba 'das yul 'dre btsan dang ma mo thub

ba tshu za 〉〉rjo11rig rgya nag khru dgu bya ba 'dis mo 'dre bse reg khrul gdon thub 4rwacha ra ma ma 'tsha kha tshe tsa dgu bya ba 'dis gags lhog 'bras sgran ya ma thub zostoskyoza2〉〉 zangadza rgya gar khru dgu bya ba 'dis chu ser rtsa rgyug rgyus 'then srung zacitho 'a ste/ log min khru dgu bya ba 'dis gre thogs pho thogs thams cad thub 'i tshospyo22shā mi nam mkha'i khru dgu bya ba 'dis rnal yor bsam pa'i don rnams khrub sa ma yā yi ge 'tshal dang bzang po drug sbyar nas lhag chad bral bar bkod dzos ni 'dre 'jiṭa gla nag rtsi dri bzang gha waṃ li khri dang gzer 'joms gser me brag gi rtsi gser dngul zangs lcags bye ma dang tsasto dkar dmar ke sar gsum/stag ngu gsum dang a dkar gsum bdud rtsi chos sman bcas byug nas gza' skar bzaju bo'i 'phrod la brtsam dar lnga'i dril nas gos kyis btum rab gnas lus la 'bral med bcing gang gi dmigs bsal bsngag pa'i don ca bzhin srung 'gyur the mi tshom sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gsum pa rjes kya rams pa la tshogs byin rlabs ni hūṃ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis:tshogs su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa kun ye shes me rlung chu yis bkrus:sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi spel:o āḥ hūṃ ha ho hrī spyan

'dren ni hūṃ hūṃ chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i klong: 'gags med 'od gsal pho brang nas: rgyal ba kun gyi gsung 'dzin pa: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i rgyal: gtso 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas: 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs rdo rje'i bro gar stobs g.yos te: gza' klu rgyal bsen 'dul ba dang: rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab tu gsol: e rgya hi pad ma kro dha ra dza sarba sa ma ya dza dza: tshogs phud ni ho 'dod yon lha mo dpag med pas: gser dngul rin chen gzhong pa phu bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs bkod nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza kha hi: bar bshags ni blo chung rtog pa dman dbang gis: lta spyod gzhung ltar la ma zlos: sor byang sngags sdoms nyams pa kun: tshogs kyi mchod pa'i bskang zhing bshags sa ma ya ā bsgral ba na hūṃ dza: snying rje zhi las ma g.yos bzhin: log rtog 'dul phyir yang khros gar dpa' brjed rngams pa'i brtul zhugs kyis ma rig ru tra dbyings su bsgral: sarba duṣṭa rū tra pra be sha ya phaṭa: bstab pa ni hūṃ trī: dug gsum rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: sha

btsa) khrag rus pa'i dga' ston 'di:dbang chen yang gsang khros par 'bul:'khrul ba ka nas dag phyir bzhes:me sa rakta tsitta la kha hi:tshogs la rol ba ni ho:gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rdzas:phyong grol zag med bdud rtsi 'di:rdo rje phung po'i dal du 'bul:bde ba chen por dga' bzhis rol:a la la ho:lhag ma ni phe rdo rje'i bka' nyan dam tshig 'dzan:dbang phyug ma sring ging ling rnams:dpal gyi pham phab lhag gtor bzhes:rnam mangs 'phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub:phun tshogs bskyed rdzogs 'gal zla bzlog:nyams rtogs yar ro sa zla ltar spel rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sa la sbyor:'ja' lus 'od sku grub mdzod cig:ma ma hrīng ba ling ta kha hi po mdo ni bhyo:chos dbyings dag pa'i gsang sgog can:rdo rje'i spyod pa la gnas pa'i:dreg pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang:dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin rnams:sngags kyi tha tshig mchog la 'dus:rnal 'byor zhabs pad spyi bor bkur:thog mtha' bar gyi dus tshig la:zhal bzhes dam mnos ji bzhin du chad kyi gtor ma

'di bzhes la: rnams mangs brin las gang bcol sgrub: nyer 'tshe'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang: gdul dka' ma lus 'dul bar mdzod: gnyer gtad phrin las ma g.yel zhig:sarba dharma bā ling ta khā hi: bstan ma ni bhyo tshogs kyi dbang phyug he ru ga: rdo rje thod pa'i phreng ba yis: bka' dang tha tshig la gnas pa'i: ma sring brtan ma bcu gnyis dang skyongs ma ya ma'i tshogs rnams kun: sngags pa'i 'bod do da tshur 'dus: rnam lnga'i dga' ston mchod pa dang: bshal chu'i brngan pa 'di bzhes la: gnyer bcol phrin las rab 'byams bsgrubs: phyi nang gsang ba'i rkyen gegs bzlog: dngos grub mi 'khyang myur bar stsol: badzra pra mo ha bā ling ta kha kha khā hi: rta bro ni hūṃ rang bzhin chos dbyings stong pa'i sgrom skye 'gags 'gyur ba med pa'i lhum: rlung sems bdud dang dam sri bstims ma ldang ldang med pro rgyas gdab o sa hūṃ swā hā dzwa bha ya nan nan: bzod gsol ni ho rlang sems gnyisa'adzin a 'thas pas bag chags dri ma bskyed pa'i nong: mi 'chab 'gyod bshags sdom sems bcas tshang pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: badzra sa

bsgotshu ma ya āḥ bsngo smon ni he rnam dkar dge bsags gcig bsdus te: 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo: lus can 'gro ba ma lus rnams: he ru ka dpal mchog thob shog: lan gsum bsdu lda ni hū: snod kyi zhing khams gzhal yas khang la bsdu: de yang lha dang lha rnams gtso bo la: gtso bo ye shes sems dpa'i thugs sgog la hū yig gyen rdzogs na dwa spros bral ngang: a u: slar yang 'od gsal shin tu phra ba'i rgyun: rig gdangs sgyu ma lta bu spyod lam khyer: phaṭalaṭa: shis brjod ni na mo byin rlabs mchog rtsol rigs kyi bdag bka' brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog: dngos grub rgya mtshos char 'bebs pa: yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog bde stong 'bar ba'i gzi byin 'khyugs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pa'i: bka' sdod pho nyas bkra shis shog: 'brel tshad rig 'dzin sar bkod pas rdo rje snying po bkra shis 31ga: de ltar sbyor dngos rjes tshangs bas dregs pa ma lus zil gnon cing lha srin sde brgyad dbang du 'du 'byung po dam sri tshar gcod 'gyur tshe dpal bsod nam nyam rtogs 'phel bden rdzun lag tu long

dang gsal ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad ma saṃ bha was ma 'ong 'gro la brtse ba' rjes chags kyi thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po' skor skal ldan las can thugs kyi srasal gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong la dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snying ma sum cu kha ral dus ma rgyan nga sgru nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nasagadul bya'i lhag ma skyongs bar byed 'brel tshad rigasa'adzin saru dbugs dbyung 'gyur bka' gsang srungs shig spu gra mched gsum po dam nyam 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar: skal ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par byos sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya rta nag lcagasaral can gyi gab don zab pa'i ti ka rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang rigs srasatheg pa mtshag gi rgyal mtshan nas bkra shisalha reg bri gzhi bcas bskul ba dang tshogs smon las 'dzoms chos gsal nas yang yang nan bskur ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel grogs kyi mos 'dun yang 'grub par gyur cig sarba maṅga lam

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i mchod byang pad ma'i phreng ba bzhugs so:'amatshu na mo gu rupad ma ka ra ye: thanornathartes dang po glu gar bro mchod ni hū: chos kyi dbyings kyi nam mkha' la: skye 'gags 'gyur ba med pa'i glu: mtshan ma tshig dang bral ba'i gar mnyam nyid rol pa chen po'i bro: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer 'bul: bde mchog gdul bya'i dpal du bskul o ma hā shu dzñā na te te hūṃ te na /:phyi mchod ni hrī dga' ba'i 'dzum bshad lha mo ni: gnas la dbang bsgyur mched brgyad kyis mkha' dbyings bkang ba'i pu dza spro: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer stobs 'bar dang g.yo ba'i brtul zhugs kyis: gdul bya bde ba chen por sbyor: sna ma hā su kha badzra pu dza ho nang mchod ni hrī mchog tu dga' ba'i gar nyams can: yul la nye rgyu rnal 'byor mas: dkar dmar nyi rna'i pu dza spo dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer stobs: 'bar dang g.yo ba'i brtsal zhugs kyis gdul bya bde ba chen por sbor: o blo dri tsitā ma

hā pu dza ho gsang mchod ni hrī khyad par dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ngoms: dur khrod la spyod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: so 'bab sen sbar pu dza spro: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer stobs: 'bar dang g.yo ba'i brtul zhugs kyis gdul bya bde ba chen por sbyor o dzñā na dhartu e haṃ badzra pu dza ho: sman rag gtor mchod ni trī tshos dbyings rgyan gyur nyi zla'i bshos: ḍakki su kha'i dwangs ma ra: byang chub sems kyi thig le che: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer stobs 'bar dang g.yo ba'i brtul zhugs kyis gdul bya bde ba chen por sbyor: o ma hā bā lirnyi rakta pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: sbyor dang sgrol mchod ni trī lhan skyesadaga' ster 'dzum bzhad g.yo: he rur dbang bsgyur ḍakki'i tshogs: 'ju 'dul khams gsum rol pa'i skyes nyi zla sgra gcan stong par stobs lha la lha thim tshul du rol: a la la ho bde ba che: ma ma hā a dṛ ta kurnya li ho: asde li phe rū tra pra be sha ya phaṭa ma ha pu dza ho: de bzhin nyid mchod ni hri:ngo bo ka dag de bzhin nyid: rang bzhin 'od gsal phyogs mtha' yas thugs rje mi rtog ye shes nyid: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer 'bul

badzra snang bzhi'i 'od gsal bdag la sbor: o ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swā bha wa adma ko3nya pu dza ho: bstod pa ni hū hrī nyon mongs mi mnga' rdul dang bral ba'i sku beeḍūrya yi 'od khyims spros pa'i dben: gang sku dran pa'i tha mal snang zhen 'gags: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i rgyal la bstod glu gcig sagasum du tra 'dul ba'i skad:gnyis pas ma mo mkha' 'gro dga' bzhir bskul: gsum pa yis ni snang gsum chos skur sbyor: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje'i gsung la bstod: ji ltar mkhyen pas gzhi snang gzugs skur sbyor: ji snyed gzigs pas ye shes chos skur bsre: kha sbyor bdun ldan mnyam pa nyid kyi klong yang gsang khros pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod gang yang ma yin cir yang 'char pa'i dpal: yon tan yid bzhin nor bus re ba skongs: gdul bya 'dul byed phrin las mi nub pa: nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter la phyag 'tshal bstod de ltar mtshod byang thabs ba mos gdul bya'i re 'dod skong ba dang bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za gsang ba mtshog gi thugs thig 'di skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog sam mā rgya rgya

badzra dreg pa'i mchod byang ni hū bhyo:rdo rje thod phreng bka' 'dor la gnas pa'i:mkha' la dbang bsgyur g.yu yi khyi mo brgyad:rngam pa'i skan rdeb mche ba gangs ltar gtsigs:glogs dmar ljags bskyang gdug pa'i don snying 'dren sa gsum dbang bsgyur skad cig bya ma rta:myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul thabs dang stobs ldan pa:sngags pas 'bod do dam la da tshur 'dus:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dza gad skyems bzhes la:yang gsang khros pa'i bka' bzhin bdud bgegs sgol:bhyo:sha khrag sgog dbugadrod la dbang bsgyur bas lcags kyi spyang mo brgyad ni rngams skad 'don:rgya mtsho'i gling la dbang bsgyur gser mig ltar:rlung gi shugs can mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'dra:dgra bo'i bla 'joms tshe srog dron mor 'dren mtha' mi kla klo bdud srin 'byung po'i gshed dus drug rnal 'byor drod nyul gtsug lag 'grims:legs nyes bya ra dam tshig so kha bsrungs:sngags pas drag tu bskul lo da tshur byon:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dza gad skyems bzhes la:sgrub pa po yis phrin las rab 'byams sgrub bhyo chos dbyings stong

pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i:ye shes rjes 'gro dam tshig drod 'dzin pa'i:pho nya chen po sna tshogs 'brug brgyad ni:skog gyur gnas la mi rmongs shan 'byed mkhan bsam pa'i yul la skad cig mda' ltar sleb:rjes chags bshad pa'i dam tshig thugs la 'chang:sbyor dang sgrol la mnga' brnyes mthu rtsal can:sngags pas drag tu bskul lo da tshur byon:brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dza gad skyems bzhes la: legs nyes stong srog 'dzin pa'i phrin las mdzod:sto srid gsum srog rtsa lag na 'chang ba yi dregs pa sde bcu'i dam tshogs glog ltar 'byugs:ging ge zog ser skar mda' rlung ltar 'debs:gsod gcod mtshon cha'i 'khor lo drag tu bskor:byad ma zhing bcu'i don snying lkog mar 'byin:thub bstan mdo dang gsang sngags gtsug tu bkur:de 'dzin 'du sde'i zhabs tog phrin las sgrubs:phyu g.yang 'dod rgu'i longs spyod char du snyil:sgyu lus zhu bde'i smin pa'i grogs ldan pa:rdo rje'i gsang srog 'chang ba'i dam tshig can:sngags pas drag tu bskul lo da tshur byon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dza gad skyems bzhes la

ba tshu rnam mang phrin las rab 'byams char ltar snyil:gnyer bcol dus las ma g.yel dam tshig can zhes pa 'di 'ang khrur med rgya mapo thugs bzhed skong phyir nus ldan pas smras te pad mas yi ger bkod pa dge legs 'phel/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khros ba'i gtor 'bul phrin las char 'bebs bzhugs so:badzra: na mo gu rupad ma ka ra ye:sgo cha rge gtor ma skyems lamasazod rnga sogs rol mo lol la spyan 'dren ni hingo: dbang chen bde klong rol ba'i pho brang nas: dregs pa gza' klu rgyal bsen khri steng na che brjid gar dgu'i nyams 'byud he ru ga: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa sras 'khor bcas gdung dbyang glu yis bskul lo da tshur byon:dug gsum rang mtshan gdon tshogs 'dul ba dang: nad yam mu ge 'khrugs rtsod zhi bas phyir: ye shes khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang: rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bstan du gsol: o badzra kro ta tyā skṛ wa sa pā ri wa ra sa ma ya dza sa ma ya ste: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i lha tshogs dpung nge thibs se byon nas bzhugs par bsam la: hūṃ hrī: pad ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lhar: 'dzab dgongs grangs them sman raka gtor mchod 'bul: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams

chags bshags rang sems dpang btsug bka' bzhin sgrub lags na: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: lus ngag yid la bde ba mchog sbor cig o rgya skṛ wa sa pā ri wa ra ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rakta khā hi: ma hā bā lirnyi khā hi: ma gyi pad ma'i sgod rgya che zhing dpang mtho bar bsam ba'is lha'i bdud rtsi ro mchog brgya dang ldan par mos hūṃgisanye rkyon dri ma dag cing 'dod yon gyi lha mo 'phro bar bsam la yo badzra kro dha rgya sbyo wa sa pā ri wa ra e dam bha lirnyi khā hi: dza gad a mṛ ta khā hi: lha tshogs ma kyilngags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi gtor ma'i bas drangs te gsol bas thugs bde stong gi ros tshims rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bdag la stsol bar bsam mo hū hrī: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: sti ra nyi zla pad ma bdud bzhi'i khar: rta mchog rol pa yang gsang khros pa'i rgyal: gtum rngams char sprin 'khrugs 'dra'i sku la bstod: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i gzi byin bskyed: gdon gsum rang grol zhing glang stag shams klubs: dug gsum rnam dag thal zhags khrag thig mdzes: srid zhi ye mnyam thod skam sbrul do

badzra 'phyangs dpa' ba'i chas brgyad rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i gzi byin bskyed:rab 'bar bskal pa'i me yi klong na 'gyings:rjes chags bzhad glu rta skad gtsug na spa:gnam lcags ral pas lha min grong khyer 'jig:snyigs ma'i gdon tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i gzi byin bskyed:phyag g.yas lcags kyus khams gsum dbang du sdud:sdang mig bsgrad pas sa gsum 'jig rten 'dar:g.yon pa nā ga klu 'dul khyung nag 'gyed sde brgyad zil gnon mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i gzi byin bskyed:zhabs g.yas gyad gyis gza' klu rgyal po gnon:g.yon brkyangs stabs gyis gnyan gtod bse mo bcil:'bar ba'i gar la ma mo mkha' 'gro 'du:bde chen chags pa'i rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:bde chen ye shes

'bar ba'i gzi byin bskyed: ha he'i gad mos glu gar bro la bskul: hi hi rims dgu thegs pa'i go skabs 'byed: hi ya 'gros dgu'i sa lam thod rgal byed: rjes chags bshad pa'i gsung gi rdo rjer bstod: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i gzi byin bskyed: byams dang brtsebasagadul bya bu bzhin skyong: nus pa mthu yis sbyor sgrol thabs mang 'gyed: stobs dang gar gyis 'khor 'das mnyam par rol: dbang mchog rol pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i gzi byin bskyed ho dgongs shig padma dbang chen mkhyen cing gzigs: bsnyen dang sgrub pa'i skal ldan pho mo la: nad mtshon mu ge'i rgud pa mi 'byung zhing kla zla'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i brin las mdzod: tshe rabs lhag pa'i lha khyed mi 'bral zhing tshe dang bsod nams nyams rtogs 'bar ba dang rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed pa sogs: yon tan yar ngos zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod: lha 'dre mi gsum dregs tshogs dbang bsgyur zhing mkha' 'gro

ba:tshu dpa' mo rdo rje rnal 'byor mar: nye 'du dga' bzhis zlos gar la drangs nas: bde ba chen po'i mdzad pa mthar phyin mdzod: bstan la 'khu ba'i dgra bdud sgog 'phrog sgol: dam la gnas pa'i dam can sgog 'phrog bkol rlung sems sgog 'phrog padma he rur sbyor: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: de ltar gtor 'bul phrin las 'grub rno la — ra btaṭa ci bzhin no pad ma'i pha nor srog gi bcud skal ba can rgya dpal du shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya rta mgrin gtor 'bul phrin las lhun grub rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu hya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pad ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'a rigs sras theg mchog rgyal mtshan dang chos gsal ratna sa ra rnams kyis bskur ngor kho bo nus ldan pas spelab dge legs 'phel sabo maṅga lam

'amatshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa la brten pa'i bshags pa dag gsal sgrol me bzhugs badzra: na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye:jazathage173 gnyen po bstob bzhi tshangs ba yi ༅gas pa'i rgyal po 'dir brtson bya na mo badzra sa twa ya: rig kun 'dus pa bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang: ye nas spros bral chos dbyings btsun mo yum: gdangs rtsal bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la phyag 'tshal: gdod nas rang chas ma rtog mthol lo bshags: bde chen ye shesache mchog he ru ga: rtog bral shes rab dbyings phyug kro ti yum: 'bar ba'i gar mdzad khrag 'thung la phyag 'tshal rang snang rang grol ma rtog mthol lo bshags: padma 'bum 'byil zla gam e yi klong: sor rtog rang gzugs rta mgrin yang khros gar bde chen ye shes ngang la phyag bgyi'o: chags sogs rang gar spyod pa mthol lo bshags: phyi nang gsang 'byung rnam par dag pa'i dbyings 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gsang 'dzin rigs kyi dal dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal rol bzhin brda phyag 'tshal: kun dma ma srung zag pa

mthol lo bshags: tshogs brgyad rtog pa'i rang mdangs dregs pa'i sde: gnas pa'i gsang srog chos nyid gcig pa can: ye shes rjes su 'gro la bdag phyag 'tshal: lha 'dre rang rgyud bltas pa mthol lo bshags chos kyidabyings la phyogs lhung med pa la: rlung gi rta byas sems kyi 'dzin rtsol gyis: gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dri ma kun: ka dag kun tu bzang po'i dgongs par bshags khu rdul rlung sems 'grogs pa'i byed las kyis: lus ngag yid kyi 'dzin stsol phra rag 'thas rdo rje gsum du sbyangs smin ma nus pa: yi dam dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer bshags: rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i 'gros rims la: bde dang mi rtog gsal ba rang chas kyang: dbab bskyil 'dren dgram thabs la ma mkhas nongs lus gnas las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rjes ye shes nyid: blo bral rang rig rjen par bstan na yang: bying rlug rtsi dang ma bral 'khyil 'byams rkyon: dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang la bshags: sor byang sngags kyi nyes pa'i mi gos par: sgrib bral bya btang rnal 'byor bdag 'grub

gtsarsha shog:a ā de ltar bshags pa'i thabs brtson na slo bur sgrib sprin mkha' la de sa nyam rtogs rta bdun dbang po tshes ma rig mun pa sa gzha mi tshug shin tu zab pa'i srog tig 'di skal ba can gya dpal tu shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bshag pa dag gsal sgron me ོgas so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi zhesapa'ang sprul pa'i sku theg mtshog rgya mtshan dang bla ma chos gsal ratna sa ra rnams kyis bskul ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyas mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel sarba masgo lam

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dgyes bskyed rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba rin chen phreng mdzes bzhugs:ba rte na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye:zo ra sgo dzos bzha'i mchod sprin bstab byas te dkyil lor lha tshogs bskang ba ni hū hrī:zla gam dbang chen e yi dkyil 'khor nas:chags pa'i rdo rje rta mgrin yang khros gar:'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:bde ba'i rol ston dga' bzhi'i dpal la 'dzum:pad ma 'dab stong mdzes pa'i skong bu rtsartsi bcud 'byung ba'i dwangs ma rlan gyis gtams:nyi zla 'od gsal snang ba'i sgron me 'bar dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang:bug rdol skyon bral ḍakki su kha'i mkhar:bde ba rab 'bar gtum mo 'dzum pa'i bcud:padma rakta dbab bskyil mchod pa'i mchog rta mgrin yang khros thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul snying chil

'bul: skye med a wa dhu ti'i bhanta na/ 'gags med ye shes 'od lnga'i bdud rtsi 'khyil: thig le 'od gsal ḍakki'i sprin phung 'khrigs yang gsang khros pa'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: gnyis med mnyam pa chon por dgyes rol nas bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag sangs rgyas 31ga: de ltar phul bsachags nyams byang nyams rtogs yar ngor zla ltar 'phel mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i srog tig 'di skal ba can gyis dpal du shog sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba rin chen phreng mdzes rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim dzi zhes pa'ang sprul pa'i sku zeg mchog rgyal mtshan dang chos gsal ratna sa ra rnams kyis nan bskur ngor kho bo nusaldan rdo rje'i spel ba dge rbesgob/thab zu phe05/

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i tshogs bsdus bsod nams dpal spung bzhugs badzra: na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: tha ske2) bza' bca' bayo bar 'os pa'i rigs dum gcig snod du bsags byas te hū trī: zla gam dbang chen pad ma brtsegs pa nas rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i lha tshogs rnams: 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rol ston phud la rol: bde stong gnas ma stobs pa mthol lo bshags: rlung sems dbu ma sgra gcan dbyings su sgrol: 'bar dang 'dzag pa'i dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal stobs: tshim pa drug ldan sngags kyis zlos gar bsgyur: rjes thob rlung sbyor lhag skyongs dam tshig bzhes: 'khrul snang ka dag mi shig srog gzugs grub: gnyug ma'i he ru ka dpal mngon gyur shog: de ltar phul ba'i tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib dag nyamasartogs mkha' ltar rgyas zab pa mkha' 'gro'i srog tig 'di thugs sras bu dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya rta mgrin tshogs bsdus bsod nams dpal spungs rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi bskang ba gter gyi bum bzang bzhugs:ba rte na mo gu ru pad mā ka ra ye sha skosgo991 chos dbyi sa sto pa'i khyon mnyam pa'i brtan g.ya'i dpal 'byor tshogs su ༅mas dbang go gsung gas bskang phyar spro rnal 'byor nyams pa gso phyir bzhes:hū trī:ma bcos ye grol gdod nas dag pa'i gshis chos sku kun bzang yab yum thugs dam bskang ma 'gags rang grol pad ma brtsegs pa na:longs sku snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskang ma brtsal byams dang snying rje'i klong yangs nas:sprul sku spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang:'od gsal 'tha' bral thig le'i klong yangs nas:rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang chos dbyings rdo rje lta bu'i klong dkyil nas mkhas pa bṛ sidha'i thugs dam bskang:kun khyab 'od gsal sgon me'i dkyil 'khor nas:paṇa chen bi ma mi dra'i thugs dam bskang:rnga yab zangs mardog dpal ri'i gzhal yas nas:mkhas pa pad ma sam byu'i thugs dam bskang:bla

ma'i dgyes bskyed dpal chen sgrubs sde mo: mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang dbang chen bka' bab rta skad gtsug na spa: ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs thugs dam bskang: zab gter chu bo bdun gyi mdzod 'dzin pa: rig 'dzin gter bzhed snying po'i thugs dam bskang: bla ma'i bka' bsgrub bstan pa'i so nam spel: gter slob smon lam dag pa'i thugs dam bskang: zab pa'i rgya 'byed dpa' bo bzhed don stsol: las ldan gzung ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: lha rdzas phyi mchod rang byung nang mchod dang: gsang ba bde stong rdo rje rig ma'i tshogs: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskang: rnal 'byor nyams bskang dbang dang dngos grub stsol: / trī zla gam dbang chen e yi klong dkyil nas: pad ma dbang chen bshad pa'i thugs dam bskang: gtum rngams me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong dkyil nas:rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i thugs dam bskang: thabs kyi rang bzhin bde ba mchog gi gsang: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo rnal 'byor thugs dam bskang: shes rab a nu rā ga su

ba tshu kha'i gsang:ḍakki rnal 'byor ma yi thugs dam bskang nam mkhar gnas bzhin ba yi bcud la 'dzum:rdo rje ging dkar tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang rgyal mtshor rgyu zhing 'bar ba'i drod la gnas:pad ma kha kha'i tshogs rnams thugs dam bskang:zla gam lnga klong 'bar g.yos bcom ldan 'das:dwangs ma cha med kun 'gro'i thugs dam bskang:thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:lha rdzas phyi mchod rang byung nang mchod dang gsang ba bde stong rdo rje rig ma'i tshogs rmad byung ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskang:rnal 'byor nyams bskang dbang dang dngos grub stsol:hūṃ hrī rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong pa'i dbyings:nam mkha'i dpal mo btsun gyi thugs dam bskang:sra ba'i dbyings kyis thams cad mnyam byed ma:cha nyams sangs rgyas spyan ma'i thugs dam bskang:mnyen pa'i dbyings kyis kun la brdal bar byed:gsal dag ma ma gi yi thugs dam bskang snyoms pa'i dbyings kyis thams cad 'bar bar byed kun gzigs gos dkar mo yi brdal ba'i dbyings kyis ma lus rol bar byed:shugs chen dam

tshig sgrol ma'i las dang ye shes dam tshig rjes 'gro bas:'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang:thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:lha rdzas phyi mchod rang byung nang mchod dang:gsang ba bde stong rdo rje rig ma'i tshogs:med byung ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskang:rnal 'byor nyams bskang dbang dang dngos grub stsol:nyu trī gnam lcags ma la yar gnas bstan srung ba ma mgon lcam phrul rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang:dbyings la gnas kyang dam tshig rjes 'gro bas:ma lnga yum drug sman mo'i thugs dam bskang:bon chos gnyis srung gnam sa phyed kyi bdag:skyes bu rdor legs mchod 'khor thugs dam bskang:legs nyes sa ler gzigs pa'i spyan stong ldan spug nag 'od 'phro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang:skye dgu'i srog la dbang za gtsugs lags srung:rgyal chen sku lnga blon 'bangs thugs dam bskang:khams gsum yud bskor

badzra: bskang: thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: lha rdzas phyi mchod rang byung nang mchod dang: gsang ba bde stong rdo rje rig ma'i tshogs rmad byung ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskang: rnal 'byor nyams bskang dbang dang dngos grub stsol: chags che nyam nga rkyen dang bar chad bzlog: gnyis 'dzin sems gyi nong pa bzod gsol bzhes: mi gnas rang bzhin dag pa chen 21ra ā de ltar bskang bas tshogs chen rdzogs sprib dag nyams rtog mkha' ltar rgyas bka' gsang ma mo mkha' 'gro'i srog pa da ma'i thugs kyi thag le 'di las can bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya rta mgran lcags ral can gyi bskang ba gter gyi bum bzang rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu hya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha la' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o bdo thim snyi zhes pa 'a sprul ba'i sku theg mchog rgyal mtshan dang chos gsal ratna sa ra rnams kyis bskur ro ra nusaldan pa so

badzralho zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i gnam phud gnas yul srung ma'i bskangs ba bzhugs so:badzra na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye tsā tha3spyon tshogs dzos skyems mchod bstab byas te hūṃ hrī: 'du ba chen po'i dga' ston la: rdo rje'i lta spyod la gnas rnams: brtul zhugs rol pa'i gar dang bcas: thog med rlung gi 'gros ldan pas: chos dbyings nam mkha'i 1nga dkyil nas: bshud glu rol mo phem gyi sgrar: dam tshig chen po'i nye bar byon: padma'i dal la 'dzum bcas rol: bde ba'i ro dang mnyam gnas pa'i: dga' ston tshogs la dgyes bzhin spyod: sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dran nas a nu rwa ga'i skyes lan stsol: phung po zhu bdes rab smin nas zag pa zad te he ru ga: tshe 'di nyid la mngon gyur mdzod: de ltar phul bas yul rnams dgyes rnal 'byor nyams bskang rtog pa 'bar bka' gsang zab pa'i rgya ldan pa skal ba can dang 'phrad gyur cag sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gnam phud gnas yul srung ma'i skang ba rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha was

bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang sku skyes theg mchog rgyal mtshan dang bla ma chos gsal ratna sa ra rnams kyi nan tan chen po'i bskul ngor kho bo nu ldan rdo rje'i dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can gyi yang tig nyi zla'i ga'u bzhugs so:btsarsha na mo gu rupad ma ka ra ye: graspyosgosgo〉〉 dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa na nad mtshon mi ge'i gze sa pa lang 'gro ba'i bde skyid nub rigs phyogs de tshe lha 'di' phrin las myur skal ldan rnams kyis gces par zungs sa ma yā phrin las las kyi rjo nga chen ni snang grags rigs gsum lhar shes pas ye rdzogs dkyil 'khor chen po ni ma ngon gyur chen po' 'di skad do hūṃ dza: e nyid stong pa chos kyi 'byung gnas su: yi las bya ba lhun grub rgya gram rlung: sum las zhing chen lpags pa lhun mnyam brdal: raḥlas rakta khrag gi rba klong 'khyil: ram las 'bar ba'i me dpung phyogs bcur 'khyil: keng las rus pa'i ri rab zur brgyad khar: dur khrod brgyad ldan 'dod yon lha mos bstod bde ba'i drod 'bar byang chub ljon pa'i rtse: bzod ldan cang shes gnyis 'thung gdong lnga pa: chos kyi mchog grur stong nyid rang sna sbogs: rdza 'phrul rkang bzhis brtegs pa'i gzhal med khang: yan lag brgyad lngan rta babs gdugs

tog 'bar:ye shes lngas brtsigs dga' bzhi'i 'dod snam mdzes ma rig mun sel phar phyin drwa gur phub:thugs rjes pha khu rin chen phra yis gtams:dri med shar bu 'od gsal mda' yab mdzes:phyi nang med par 'ja' yis rnam par dkris:phyin bcu'i don rtags gdugs 'phan rgyal mtshan dar:byang chub yan lag bdun gyi yon tan rdzogs:mi 'jigs 'gyur med rdo rje'i brag steng brjid phrin las lhun grub rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor:tshad med sgo rgyan 'khyud la pho nya 'tshubs:mthong ba'i yid 'phrog 'byul ba kha lo bsgyur:gzhi snang lhun grub rgyal kun lhun rdzogs gnas:bcu drug gsum gyi dpe rtags 'dzoms pa'i dbus:tshogs brgyad rang grol byol song brgyad btegs khar:nyon mongs gnas stong bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i khri mngon par byang chub pad nyi zla ba'i steng khu rdul rlung sems rnam dag he ru ga rjes su chags pa'i rta nag lcagasaral can:char sprin 'khrigs 'dra gzugs thung gzi brjid che:dmar zlum spyan bsgrad sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs:zhal gdang ljags 'dril mche bzhi gdangs ltar gtsigs:smra smin

'amatshu kha spu ag tshom me ltar 'bar: thod skam dbu brgyan dar sna'i cod paṇa bcing: nyi zla'i snyan cha rus pa'i ka shal 'chang: yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan: lcags kyi ral gseb thog ser bu yug 'tshubs: rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma leb brgan 'bar: glang mgo' stod g.yog rū dra'i sku reg bcing: stag lpags sbrul chun mgo phreng rnam par bkra: rdo rje'i gshogs pa dug rlung bu yug 'tshubs: phyag g.yas lcags kyu'i sde brgyad dbang du sdud: dregs pa pho mo'i sgog 'phrog dam la 'dogs g.yon pa khyung nag dug gsum gdon la 'byed: 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad gdon rkyen gegs 'joms: zhabs gnyis bsgrad pa'i bdud dang dam sri gnon: sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung rdo rje srin po'i skur: thal tshom khrag thig zhag gi zo ris 'byud: dgod gshe drag shul ldan pa'i gsung sgra sgrogs: snying rje rngams zhis gdul bya ma lus 'dul:

la 'gyed: nā ga durnying tshogs kyis klu bdud 'joms rakka ha ling dam sri 'byung po'i gshed yakka shwa nas mtha' yi dmags dpung gzhom: rdo rje'i ging tshogs dpa' bo'i las la 'du: padma ḍakkis dpa' bor dgyes ston stobs rdo rje'i sgog ldan phrin las bzhi la gnas dur khrod sha zas legs nyes shan drangs 'byed: a tsa ra rnams sbyor sgrol rjes su nyul: kiṅka sha zan tshogs rnams 'phur lding rtse: lce spyang gdug pa'i khyu tshogs ngar skad 'don: 'byung bzhi'i sgra rnams hūṃ phaṭa ha he sgrogs: dug lnga'i kha lo ye shes dbyings su bsgyur che brjid dpa' rtags srid na mtshungs dpe bral: rta mchog rol pa yang gsang khros pa'i rgyal: gsal dag stong pa mtshan ma'i gdos bral bskyed: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor dbang byin brlabs mi shig 'gyur med sku lngar phyag rgyas gdab: sgog gi yi ge las spros 'od zer gyis: 'og min gnas nas ye shes lha yi tshogs dbang mchog rol pa'i sma gsung thugs kyi rgyar: bzhengs la dam tshig ye shes gnyis med par: chu la chu bzhag ci bzhin sib sib bsdims: snyed badzra kro dru hya bṛ wa bṛ ka la sarba sa

gas(: mā ri wa ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: a be sha ya phem phem: ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs bstims dam tshag dal dang gnyis med bsre lta ba 'jal ba'i phyag kyang phul kun bzang rol ba'i rgyan mchod stobs phyag rgya bzha dang ldan pas bstod nongs pa bshags shing dam tshig 'dzin dkyal 'khor gsum du bsnyen cing sgrubs rtags mtshan bzang po 'byung bar brtson sa ma mā me ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad ma saṃ bha was ma 'ong 'gro la brtse ba chen po yas thugs kya yang zhun rdo rje snying po'i skor skal ldan las can thugs kyi sras la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong la dgong pra sdom ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum bcu kha ral dus yo rgyan sprul pa nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas gdul bya' lhag ma skyo sa bar byed 'brel tshad rag 'dzan zhing du dbugs dbyung 'gyur bka' gsang srung shig spu gri mched la gnyer dam nyams 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar thugs sras rig pa 'dzan pa 'i dpal du shog sa ma rwa rgya rgya rgya rta nag lcags ral can gyi yang tig nyi zla'i ga'u rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu hye o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda zim thi zhes pa'ang sprul ba'i sku pad ma zeg mchog rgyal mtshan nas bkra shas lha regs bri gzhi bcas nan bskul ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis
dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis sarba maṅga lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i bum pa'i bskyed bzlas sa 'og gdon 'dul bzhugs so:badzra na mo gu ru pad ma kā ra ye: ste sgo zarwastso/rdo bum pa bla med so lngas gawas dal bkod rnams lnga nyer spyod bkrams oṃ swā bha was sbyangs/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub cing: nang zla gam dbang gi gzhal med khang sgo gru rta babs sogs mtshan nyid bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus: bdud bzhi nyi zla pad ma'i khar rig pa hrīḥmathing nag las 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus hrī yig la bstims te yongs su gyur pa las: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa mazing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khyud cing lcags ral sngon po 'byel zhing gzing pa rta zhal ljang sngon bzhad glu'i rnam par brgyan cing rjes chags kyi bshad skad sgrogs pa: dur khrod dpal chas sku la klubs shing zhabs gnyis gyad gyi 'dor thabs su bsgrad pa: phyag g.yas lcags kyu dregs pa can thams cad dbang

du bsdud cing g.yon pa dug khyung 'bar bas sa 'og 'byung po'i dpa' rkong bar byed: sku las me rlung dug zer rab tu 'phros pas rgya 'dre dam sri 'byung po'i tshogs tshar gcod cing rdul du brlag pa: gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs nye 'du mdzad cing dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal la gnas pa: dregs pa lha srin gdug cing rtsub pa'i rigs rnams dbang du mdzad cing dam la 'dogs pa: snang stong gdos mtshan las grol ba 'od kyi sku ru gsal ba'i gnas gsum las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la bstims mo: / trī: gtum drag me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dkyil 'khor nas: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa gshegs su gsol pad nyi bdud bzhi'i khri khar bzhugs su gsol: brda' yi mtshon nas gar gyis phyag bgyi'o: sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya st+waṃ: na mo ho: hūṃ trī: chos dbyings nam mkha'i brgyan gyur lha dzos sprin: phyi nang gsang ba yangs gsang de kho na: rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i dga' ston gyis: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje'i gsang gsum bskangs: ma ma hā pañtsa pu dza ho:

btsa/ hūṃhrī:mi sdug rdo rje srin po'i sku mnga' ba:grags sto hi ya rjes chags bzhad glu ngoms snying rje zhi dang khros pa'i thugs mnga' ba:rta mchog rol ba'i gsang ba gsum la bstod:'dzab dmigs ni bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa 'phros:mdun bskyed bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul:sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang khyung dkar nag khro chung dpag tu med pa byung nas bum pa gang bar dmigs la oṃ hya snyi wa hūṃ phaṭa:brgya rtsa la sogs ci rigs brjod sngagasamachod phul rjes bstod par bya bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu la thim pas ye shes khro bo dang khyung gis rdul phra rabs tu gyur bar bsam de nas las bum bsgrub pa ni oṃ swā bha wa sogs las kyi bum pa mi dmigs pa'i ngang las thar ba chen po'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su:bdud bzhi nyi zla pad ma'i khar trīsapas dbang chen he ru ka sku mdog dmar nag khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams kyi khyud cing: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor thabs su bsgrad nas bdud bzhi nyi zla padma'i khar brjis pa:

phyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun gcod kyi gri gug dang g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang bsdams pa: bskal pa'i me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus snang stong gdos bral du gsal ba'i spyi bor rta mgo ljang zhur hi hi sgrogs pas lha srin dregs pa dbang du sdud cing zil gyis gnon pa/ra gyur: thugs garatt+waṃḥdamar po la sngags phreng 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dpal yon dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te bum pa gang bar bsam la snyed rgya sgro wa hūṃ phaṭa: brgya rtsa brjod mthar sngags kyi mchod cing bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī: 'bar ba'i sku mchog bde ba chen po'i zhal: rjes su chags pa'i zur mig rnam par g.yo: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mor dga' bzhi 'gyed: rta mgrin rta skad bshad la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu la thim pas bag chags dag byed kyi mthu ldan du gyur bar bsam mo de nas maṇḍal phul la bdag 'jug blang ba ni hūṃ hrī:〈snang gsal 'du ma byas pa'i 'od kong nas: rgyal ba kun dngos chos ska pad ma'i gsung: chos rje 'od dpag med mgon rgyal ba'i sras: span ras gzigs dbangatreeḥlas rngams brjid ska:

btsañtsa rta mgrin rta skad bzhad mdzad he ru ga:rjes su chags pa'i nye bar dgongs mdzod cig:bde ba chen po'i ye shes dbang byin rlabs:skal ldan bsgrub pa po la stsal du gsol:'dug sa gdan thog 'du ru byin gyis rlobs:lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol bar mdzod:rtsa sngags mthar mirnyi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ:hrī dbang sa thamasacad gnas gsum gtug slob ma rjes su 'dzan pa'o dug sbyor gdon bkrol gang 'opa bya phrin las gang brtsam thog med 'grub sa ma yā e ma rgyal dbang pad ma'i thugs bcud 'di da lta ma spel ba 'a la bstims mdo khams rtse shod gshams du sbos snyigs ma sum bcu kha ral dus la gros sprul pa gcig dang 'phrad gdul bya'i lhag ma skyongs bar byed 'brel tshad rig 'dzan zhing du 'god sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bum gnyis bsgrub pa sa'og gdon 'dul rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa 'o brda thim snyi zhes pa' theg mtshog rgyal mtshan dang chos gsal ratna sa ra rnams gyis bskur ngoranu ldan pas sdel ba dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i bskul ba me rlung 'tshubs ma bzhugs so:bsgo/: na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: zang rnanashes1/ gtor ma 'gugs bstims bdud rtsir bsgyur brtul zhugs khros mas blta ltangs bsgrad rnga rol snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas dbang chen la tshogs bskul ba ni hūṃdza: 'og min dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i zhing: zla gam dbang chen pad ma 'bum rdzogs klong: rin chen khri rkang pad zla nyi ma'i khar: log rtog bdud bzhi kha sbub gan skyal steng: rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi gsang 'dzin pa: ma chags bde ba'i 'byung gnas he ru ga: brtse ba'i zur mig dpa' bo mkha' 'gror g.yo: rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags gtsug rgyan 'chang: mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i thugs dam las: bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la skul: 'dod yon ro mnyam mchod gtor 'di bzhes la thogs bcas dgra dang thogs med bgegs gyi tshogs: ming med rdul du brlag pa'i brin las mdzod: ṭwāṃ hrī: dpa' ba'i rtags su dpral bar thal tshom bkod: rjes su chags

pas rakta'i thig le byug: log rtog gdon 'dul zhag gi zo ris bkra: lha min grong 'byer 'joms pa'i lcags ral gzing: dug gsum rtsad gcod spyan gsum glog ltar 'byug: snang zhen rab bsregs smrar smin me ltar 'bar mnyam nyid shangs nas snoglu'i dregs tshogs 'dar: 'khor ba dbyings sgol zhal hom rab tu gdengs: tshad med 'gro 'dul mche ba gangs ltar gtsigs dmar zlum ljags brkyangs dug gsum krum krum rol gzugs thung gzi brjed che bas khams gsum 'dul: rlung sems dbyings sbyor bskal me dug rlung 'tshubs: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i gsung gi rdo rjer bstod: bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la skul 'dod yon ro mnyam mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thog bcas dgra dang thog med bgegs gyi tshogs ming med rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: nyu hrī: mi sdug dpa' bar khros pa'i he ru ga: sgeg pa 'jigs su rung ba'i sku mnga' zhing: dgod dang gshe dang drag shul ldan pa'i gsung: zhi ba snying rje che las rngams pa'i thugs: dug gsum gdon 'dul zhing glang stag shams tshobs: ma rig kun rtog

ba:tshu rang grol mgo phreng sbrul:dbu la rdzogs pa'i thod rkam rigs lnga'i brgyan:ye shes lhun grub dar sna'i dpyangs pa 'phur:thugs gar mi 'gyur sgog gi go ru gsal:mdzad pa mthar phyin dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur:ngo bo mtshan ma gdos bral chos kyi sku:rang bzhin 'od gsal lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs brtse ba'i rjes chags thugs rje sprul ba'i sku:dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i rgyal la bstod:bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la skul 'dod yon ro mnyam mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas dgra dang thogs med bgegs gyi tshogs:ming med rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod:hū trī:rū tra bsgral mdzad rta mchog rgyal po yis 'gros dgu gar gyis srid zhi'i sa rnams gcod:skad dgu glu yis spangs rtog mthar phyin byed:rngog ma leb brgan chos sgo brgyad khri mtshon:thod rgyan dmar ser nang rgyud sde gsum rtags:ljang zhur dri bral a ti'i brda' don 'chang:rjes chags 'dzum la gnas yul mkha' 'gro 'du stobs chen dro la bde stong dga' bzhis 'bar mdzes pa'i gar gyis bcu drug rol

rtsed bsgyur:chags sogs nyon mongs bde ba chen por sbyor sdang rmongs kheng tshogs 'khrul bral dbyings su sgrol:'khor 'das stong sgog 'phrog pa'i dbang chen po:'bar ba'i hya ṣṭṛ war phyag 'tshal bstod bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la skul 'dod yon ro mnyam mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:thogs bcas dgra dang thogs med bgegs gyi tshogs ming med rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod:( hrī:khams gsum dbang bsgyur srid zhi zil gnon pa'i:phyag g.yas lcags kyus thams cad 'gugs par byed:ma lus bde chen ye shes dbyings su sbyor g.yon pa sdig mdzub rtse la dug khyung spro:sa bdag klu gnyan gtod tshogs 'dul bar byed:zhabs g.yas gyad gyis lha bu 'chi bdag gnon:g.yon brkyangs phung po nyon mongs bdud sde gzir:skye ba rnam bzhi'i kha lo dbyings su bsgyur:tshad med phrin las gdul bya'i yul la 'gyed:dregs pa sde brgyad gza' the'u zil gyis gnon:khro chung phra rab bu yug bzhin tu 'tshub:nyon mongs brgyad khri'i bdud kyi kha lo bsgyur:ma rig gnyis snang 'khrul ba chos skur gzhig

ba:tshu dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la skul: 'dod yon ro mnyam mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thogs bcas dgra dang thogs med bgegs gyi tshogs ming med rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: bdag ni ma nyes dkon mchog zhabs pad khur 'gro ba'i don du zeg chen bsgom sgrubs byas: bstan pa'i zhabs tog thos bsam byed pa la bar chod dgra dang bgegs kyi ma ster bas: 'di la dbang chen yang gsang khros pas gzigs: rū tra bsgral ba'i tha tshig ci bzhin du: mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyis grub mdzod cig: zhal bzhes dus bab ma g.yel sa ma yā: gtor skyems dgra ya phyogs su rdeb dmod bor thal mo drag tu skye ral pa sprugasal dmigs pas gzir dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jig bka' 'di skal ldan las 'phro can pad ma'i rgyal tshab dang 'phrad shog sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya rta mgran ya gsang thos pa' bskul ba me rlung 'tshubasam rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim ñtsā zhes pa'ang sprul sku theg mchog rgyal mtshan dang chos
gsal ratna sa ra rnams kyis bskur ngor kho bosasaldan rdo ngasamakha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod lasabasgyur ba dge legasa'aphel sarba ma lam

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rjesnying po las: rta nag lcags kyi ral ba can gyi gtor bskul drag po har bzhengs zhes bya ba bzhugs so:ba rte na mo gu rupadma kā ra ye: 4/thornasmomishā //dzogasgro'i gtor skyems bsham la 'gugs bstems bya sha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor mos rnal 'byor lta ba' gdengs bskyed de rngams pa'i glu yi bskul ba ni hūṃ dza: ma chags bde klongazla gam dgu brtsegs nas rab 'jigs thod mkhar rngams pa chen po yi rlung me dug gi sprin phung 'khrigs klong nas: rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags 'chang ba yi rta mgrin yang khros rjes chags bshad pa'i gar: bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel phyir bskul: snyigs ma'i ru 'dzing rgud pa 'di la gzigs: spyi mthun las kyi mnar ba'i snying rje'i yul: yal bar ma dor dbang drag thabs mkhas pas: sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i las la mi g.yel bar: myur mgyogs glog 'dra'i mthu rtsal da phyung la: bdud bgegs dam sri 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: dgyes ston khrag stems gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bde ba mchog gi dgongs spod la sbor phyir: gdul dka' nyon

mongs rgyas pa'i sems can rnams: rang mtshan kun spyod log rtog rtsub mo zhi: zhu bde'i drangs ba'i he ru ka dpal du: dbang bskur rgyas thob ldog med phrin las mdzod zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel dam tshig can zhes bskul gtor skyems dgra phyogs rdeb mngon spyod lhun gyis grub par 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gtor bskul drag po har bzheng rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang sgrub pa zab mo'i cha lags su nye bar mkho phyir nus ldan pasamakha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ye ge pa ni lung zin pad ma'i mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/
badzra zab gsang ༷ ༷ ṭwāṃ ༵ ༷dhi /༷/ ༷//sa ya ༵ gsang khros pa'i bsgral

badzra na mo gu ru pad mā ka ra ye: rtsothe 4114 zhi rsā yal bar mi dor bar mngon spyod drag po' bsgral las brtsam dang po gser skyems khrul ba ni stong palingang las gser skyems gtor ma 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa mi zad pa'i gter du gyur rdza āhūṃ kye skyabs kyi dam pa bla ma dkon mchog gsum yi dam sgrub rgyud dbyings gsum mkha' 'gro'i sprin dpa' bo dpa' mo ging dang lang ga'i tshogs gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod brin las sgrubs pad ma dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i lha: gdul dka' 'dul mdzad yang gsang khros pa'i gar: sa gsum gdug pa'i snying 'dar sgog 'phrog pas: gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod phrin las sgrubs gsang srog dag pa ma mgon lcam phrul dang: pha lha ma lha phrag lha dgra lha dang: grogs lha zhing lha yul lha gzhi bdag gis: gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod phrin las sgrubs:bdag la brnyes btsug thad langs dgra bo te: gling bzhi skyabs gsum sngags pa'i gur khang sogs: gang na gnas kyang rang dbang med par khug: rgyugs chang gtor ma 'di

bsgolho bzhes bcol las bsgrub ma g.yel ma 'bying shugs phyungs las la yā: mkhyen gzu ni kye bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyis mkhyen par gsol: yi dam pad ma dbang chen mkhyen par gsol: dag pa dbyings gsum mkha' 'gros mkhyen par gsol chos skyongs ma mgon lcam dral mkhyen par gsol yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis mkhyen par gsol: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad mkhyen par gsol: gzu dang dpang du rtsa gsum chos skyongs khur: nyes med bdag gi mgon dang dpung rog mdzod: tshe 'di'i bya btang 'chi chos dang du blangs: rang don bor nas gzhan don khur du khyer: phun tshogs gzhi bzungs bskyed rdzogs las gzhung bsrengs: snang zhen rnam dag lha sngags chos skur bsgrub: dgongs pa mi 'gyur gnyug mar sa bzung yang: dgra dang bgegs kyi ma ster tho 'tshams byas: gsang ba'i sgo gtor 'du ba mkhon gyis dkrugs: bstan pa'i khrims bshigs bshad sgrub phra mas gtug: yongs la gnod cing chos mdzad sku dgra byas: rnam smin na rag skye 'byur las tshangs ba'i: zhing bcu'i dgra 'di thugs rjes ma

bzung na: mngon spyod phrin las yal bar 'dor ram ci: rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs mi mdzad dam: gces pa'i bu ngus ma yi bzod nus sam: thugs bskyed thog 'dra'i nus mthu nyams song ngam ma g.yel ma g.yel dbang chen gsung gi lha: brgyan pa'i mchod gtor khrag skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs gnyis la bka' yi chad pas chod: gsod gcod brlag pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol e bskyed ni: bdag nyid pad ma dbang chen yang gsang khros par gsal ba'i mdun tu: yi getsasde nag po yongs su gyur pa las: gru gsum las kyi bsha' khang gshin rje nag po'i kha sde brgyad kyi pho brang lcags sgrom nag po kha tog la mthil yangs pa: dug lnga rang gshed du 'bebs pa'i nad mtshon thun gyi yo langs 'tshubs pa bla 'dzin gyi drwa ba bkrams shing: gsod gcod kyi lce spyang dang khyi nag ngu ba: bdud kyi lag pa brkyangs shing: btsan gyis jag pa rgyugs pa: ma mo dang sha za srin po rnams kyi bsha' gzhi khrag zu 'khrigs pa'i dbus su: ni dang triḥyongs su gyur pa las: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshangs ba: sku dgra rnam lngar

ba tshu gyur pa'i dgra bo de'i mdog sngo la mdangs nyams pa skya ba ham pa rid pa nyam thag dbug dang bral la khad 'dar phri li li byed cing rkang lag lcags gzer gyis bsdam pa:dri gshang nas dkar dmar gyi rgyun 'dzag shing mig nas sdug gi mchi ma 'babs pa:de'i sa bon dzraḥtriḥlas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas gzugs rten la yang yang thim par bsam:bdag mdun las spros pa'i pho nya lcags zhags sgrogs dril thogs pa grangs med pas stong gsum gling bzhi srid pa'i khams na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par ling ga la yang yang bstim mo:'gugs bstims ni na mo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden mthu dang:dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bden pa dang:gnas yul gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byer ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang:rdo rje chos skyongs ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmags tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa

rnams kyi bden pa chen po'i mthus spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par khra kyi li li nag sga ra ra: byis chung khra yi ded pa ltar lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang gi gzugs ling ga 'di la khug cig bstims shig: dza hūṃ baṃ ho grangs gang skabs brjod gru gsum gshin rje'i lto bar tshud pa'i dgra bgegs rnams thar ba'i dus med par bsam mo: lasags pa'i las drug ni dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab mngon spyod phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir zla gam eḥyi klong dkyil nas: gdug pa 'dul ba'i las la bzhengs dang po'o dzaḥ pho nya lcagasakyu can gyi tshogs rno mtshon 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya yis:gang la gzas pa'i dgra bo yis: snying nas drongs shig gzugs la phobs: gnyas pa'o 31 badzra 1sna dha hya snyi wa hūṃ phaṭa: dgra bgegs e ku sha ya dza dza: gsum pa'o khyi dkar po'i brun byi la nag mo' thun chu rtsa sngo kyu rnam bdug go bzhi pa'o lag pa gnyis kyi gong mo zung lcags kyu ltar dgugs ci gzugs la bskor bar bya'o lnga ba'o ho dbang chen yang gsang khye sa pa'i lha tshogs rnams

ba tshu kyis dgra bo de'i snying nas lcags kyus drongs la gzugs rten la sib sib phobs cig drug pa'o de nas zung ba'i las drug ni dza dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab mngon spyod phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir zla gam eḥyi klong dkyil nas: gdug pa 'dul ba'i las la bzhengs: dang po'o dzaḥ pho nya zhags pa can gyi tshogs: 'ching byed byad thag sngo dmar gyis: gang la gzas pa'i dgra bo yis: sgo gsum 'gul mi shes par chings gnyis pa'o 31 badzra kro dha hya ghri wa hūṃ phaṭa dgra bgegs ma ra ya thum ri li li chings shig pa sha hūṃ gsum pa'o rta bon dang ga bur nag po spang spos ra grod rnams bdug go bzhi ba'o lag gnyis khu tshur bskor bcings bsdam pa'i rgyas gzugs rten la btab po lnga pa'o rted rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis dgra bo de'i lus ngag yid gsum 'gul mi shes par byad thag sngo dmar gyis dam du chings shig drug pa'o de nas dbye ba'i las drug ni dza dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: mngon spyod brin las mdzad pa'i phyir zla gam e yi klong dkyil nas gdug pa 'dul ba'i las la bzhengs dang po'o dzaḥ pho nya kha kha hu
