lu'i tshogs 'dzang 'thab dri dug dbal spros nas gang la gzas pa'i dgra bo de'i: mgon skyabs lha srung kun dang phrol: gnyis pa'o skyo badzra kro dha hya snyi wa hūṃ phaṭa: sarba du tra pra be ro/ ya phaṭa: ༷ kre ha sa na ya hūṃ phaṭa: gsum pa'o lham 'bol yug dor khyi thun ra dug pa rnams bdug go bzhi pa'o lag gnyis 'khor lo'i rgya bca' shad sgro gnyis bcas gzug kyi steng du dbye rgya bca' 'o lnga ba'o ho rta mchog rol pa yang gsang khros pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis dgra bo skyob byed kyi lha dang khrol cig mgon dang sdong grogs byed pa thams cad dang dbye zhing ring du bskrad pa'i phrin las mdzod cig drug pa'o de nas spyo 'bogs las drug ni dza dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: mngon spyod phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir: zla gam eḥyi klong dkyil nas: gdug pa 'dul ba'i las la bzhengs dang po'o dzaḥ pho nya nad sprin 'dzin pa'i tshogs: spyo 'bogs sbos gas skyal ba rdeb: gang la gzas pa'i dgra bo yi: dran pa nyams nas smo ru chug gnyis pa'o skyod badzra kro dru rgya smi wa tram̐ phaṭa dgra bgegs dzwa la pa ya dzwa la pa ya myos shig 'bog brgyal nag thib sod: gsum pa'o spyo brun dug khrag ras lngags

gas/: thang phrom kyi 'bras bu rnam bdug go bzhi ba'o lag pa gnyis spar mo bsdam bkrol 'dzan pa'i rgyas gzugs la brab po lnga ba'o ho:padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i lha chags rnams kyis dgra bo de spyo ru chug cig:'bog tu chug cig:brgyal bar gyis la brlag par mdzod cig:drug pa'o de nas bdag gso ba ni rang padma dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs sgog (ཿlas hūṃ mu med pa 'phros 'khor 'das brtan g.yo thams cad srog yi ge'i rnam par bsdus te bstims pas chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i stong srog la rang dbang 'byor bar mos la:cha hya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa:brgya rtsa brjod sras phur gso ba ni bdag pad ma dbang chen gyi sras phur badzra ki la yar gsal gdab pa de las 'od zer steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'phros pas rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas sras mchog la dbang bskur gzi byin bskyed:dregs pa can thams cad kyi nus mthu dang stobs rtsal phyungs:brtan g.yos dwangs bcud bstsas nas sras phur la bsnyims pas bsal 'dren gnyis la dbang thob par bsam la:31 pad ma ta kuta badzra ki li ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa:brgya rtsa brjod

dgra bo gso ba ni ling ga dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba de las 'od zer 'phros: stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i zhing bcu tshang ba thams cad nya rgyas nya tshogs sdud pa ltar dgra gzugs ling ga la 'dus shing thim par bsam la sarba rū tra 'dus 'dus: brgya rtsa brjod bla lungs ni phur pa dgra bgegs la gzir bas bla rten skyal ba 'dra ba la thebs nas dwangs bcud 'o rgyun lta bu bstems pas sgrol phur ngang mer gyis song bar bsam la bde ba chen por bzhag tshe lungs na yang phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gar gdab pas sha gzhob kyi dri 'thul bzhin byang khog la bab: snying 'phyong gur lta bu'i kha phrol nas khu khrag gi dwangs ma rgya sran gyi ga'u lta bu la phog nas mar la lcags sregs sbyar ba ltar skems: yid 'gyu byed kyi rten byi'u leb mo'i mgo tsam gnas pa la gzir bas na bun bzhin du yal: tshe rten ba spra 'dra ba la sgog gi mthud ma tshe rjoḥyig rnam par gnas pa phur rtser 'ub kyis bsngas te khongs seng nas yar drangs nyes rkyen mtha' dag sbangs: gtsug tor nas byung bdag he ru ga'i thugs gar thim pas tshe yi mthud mar

bsgoji: gyur bar mos:khrus lungs na:slar yang phur pa'i rtse mo nas bdud rtsi mu tig lta bu'i rgyun ta la la bab sgo lnga rnam shes sems kyi bag chags sbyangs:phyi nang gnyis med du brdal ba'i 'od gsal cher 'bar:rlung sems bag nyal gyi dri ma sangs bar bsam mo:gnas lungs ni slar yang shes rig gi ngo bo 'od lnga'i gong bu de phur rtser 'dus: kun gzhi'i sgrib pa chos kyi dbyings su sbyangs:khong seng brgyud gtsug tor nas 'phos 'og min gyi dbyings la mnga' mdzad pa'i he ru ga'i thugs gar spar:sku dbyings brgyud yum mkhar bab:sku yi rtsib ma ga g.yas nas thon:bar snang nyi zla'i dal la he ru ka tshon gang ba gcig tu sad par bsam mo:a phaṭa a phaṭaḥ.a phaṭa:thun gdab ni snyigs ma'i phung khams la ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs mtshon cha'i char spros gzas pa po'i kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i mtshangs stong par bsam la rdo rje'i thun gdab la hūṃ dza nga

zhe sdang dmyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor kha lo bsgyur: slo hya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa: thun ya thun ya: zor ya zor ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshe sgog phung khams skye mched la ma ra ya phob dza phob dza: spyor lo' thun gdab la hūṃ dza: nga ni dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje che: 'khor 'das ma lus stong srog phyag na gnas: chos dbyings ye shes rang gzugs 'khor lo'i thun:dgra bgegs gdug pa'i gzugs kyi phung por gdab gti mug dud 'gro'i 'khrul 'khor stong par mdzod: tshe hya ṣṭṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa thun ya thun ya zor ya zor ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshe srog phung khams skye mched la ma ra ya phob dza phob dza be con gyi thun gdab la hūṃ dza nga ni dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje che 'khor 'das ma lus stong srog phyag na gnas mnyam nyid ye shes rang mdangs ratna'i thun: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshor ba'i phung por gdab: nga rgyal lha yi 'khrul 'khor chos skur gzhig: slo rgya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa: thun ya thun ya: zor ya zor ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshe srog phung khams skye mched la ma ra ya phob dza phob dza: pad ma'i thun gdab la hūṃ dza nga ni dbang chen chags

ba:tshu pa'i rdo rje che: 'khor 'das ma lus stong srog phyag na gnas: sor rtog ye shes rang mdangs pad ma'i thun: dgra bgegs dam sri'i 'du shes phung por gdab:'dod chags yi dwags 'khrul sna rba slong skems: ma hya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa: thun ya thun ya: zor ya zor ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshe sgog phung khams skye mched la ma ra ya phob dza phob dza: rgya gram gyi thun gdab la hū dza: nga ni dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje che: 'khor 'das ma lus stong sgog phyag na gnas bya grub ye shes rang mdangs rgya gram thun: log 'dren dgra bgegs 'du byed phung por gdab: phrag dog lha min 'khrul snang rang sar gzhig: oṃ hya snyi wa hūṃ phaṭa thun ya thun ya: zor ya zor ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshe srog phung khams skye mched la ma ra ya phob dza phob dza: gri thun gyis gatshi la hūṃ dza: nga ni dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje che: 'khor 'das ma lus stong srog phyag na gnas khro rgyal mi g.yo'i rang ba'in sa bi yis: dag babegs maso was yan lag so sor brkol: ma rig gzang 'dzin 'a la 'khor kha lo bsar mi yi bag chags ye shes wa ma bse: tshe

rgya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa: thun ya thun ya: zor ya zor ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshe sgog phung khams skye mched la ma ra ya phob dza phob dza dgra gzugs gtun khung du tho bas brdung la hūṃ dza:nga ni dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje che: 'khor 'das ma lus stong sgog phyag na gnas: thabs shes gnyis med tho gtun rgyar bcug nas dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa dmar nyog brdung: dug gsum rnam par dag pa'i bdud rtsi gyur: kun hya sbyo wa hūṃ phaṭa: dgra bgegs ta tha ya ta tha ya phye ma phye ma rdul phran rdul phran ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa: bstab pa ni hūṃ dza:zla gam dbang chen rol pa'i e klong nas: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i zhal hom du ma ga rtog bsgral ba'i phung khams skye mched bstabs: rnam shes 'khrul mi shes pa'i dbyings su sbyor: rtsa sngags mthar dgra bgegs gdug pa'i ma hā me sa khā hi: ma hā rakta khā hi: ma hā tsitta khā twe ma hā ko ro tsa na kha twe ma hā kau ni ri ti la kha twe de ltar drag po'i las sbyor brtsams rjes su sgrub pa grol ba'i tshe nang sgo dbye ba'i rim pa ni gser skyems mchod la 'di skad do dza bdestong pho brang zla gam gyi: zhi ba snying rje chen po'i sgo: tshad med lcags

ba tshu kyu'i phyag rgyas dbye me long ye shes dngos grub stsol: habadzra pra be sha ya phaṭa: hū bde stong zla gam 'khyil ba yi: rab rgyas byams pa chen po'i sgo: tshad med zhags pa'i phyag rgyas dbye mnyam nyid ye shes dngos grub stsol: ringatna pra bee sha ya phaṭa: baṃ: dga' bde rab 'bar pho brang gi: dbang phyug dga' ba chen po'i sgo tshad med lcags sgrog phyag rgyas dbye: sor rtogs ye shes dngos grub stsol: ni: padma pra bee sha ya phaṭa: ho: klong gsal pad ma dbang gi dal: gtum drag btang snyoms chen po'i sgo:tshad med dril bu'i phyag rgyas dbye: bya grub ye shes dngos grub stsol: sa: karma pra bee sha ya phaṭa gser skyems mja la sgo rtsang len dngos grub sa kyi blang ba ni hū trī phyogs res mi dmigasabade chen chos kyi dbyings: zla gam e sang rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: pad ma dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje nyid: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor kha bskang mthar phyin pas:dngos grub stsol len dam tshig dus la bab mi gnas ye shes thugs mchog dpal be'u nas: bde ba chen po'i dngos grub bdag la stsol dga' bzhis drangs nas gnyis su

med par rol: zag lus zhu bde he ru ka thob mdzod: sa a la la ho: daro sa grub gnas gsum la rol zhing de nas phyi sgo dbye ba ni hūṃ dza shar phyogabangadung sgo dkar po'i nang: shel gyi mi mo pad rgyan can sngon gyi dam dgongasatha tshig bzhes: gser skyems gtor ma dgyes rol la: gtor sgo zor sgo yas sgo phyes: nad dang rims yams gdon sgo 'don: thun zor ltas ngan dgra la ston: mngon spyod lhun gyi grub mdzod cig gzhan la ma 'byams ma yo shig: / lto phyogasagaser sgo ser po'i nang: bse yi mi mo rus rgyan can sngon gyi dam dgongs tha tshig bzhes: gser skyems gtor ma dgyes rol la: gtor sgo zor sgo yas sgo phyes: nad dang rims yams gdon sgo 'don thun zor ltas ngan dgra la ston mngon spyod lhun gyi grub mdzod cig: gzhan la ma 'byams ma yo shig: / nub phyogs zangasasgo dmar po'i nang: byi ru'i mi mo dar chas can: sngon gyi dam dgongs tha tshig bzhes: gser sgems gtor ma dgyes rol la: gtor smo zor sbo yas smo phyes: nad dang rims yams gdon smo 'don: thun zor lngas ngan dgra la ston: mngon sgod

ba:tshu lhun gyi grub mdzod cig:gzhan la ma 'byams ma yo shig:pa byang phyogs lcags sgo sngon po'i nang:g.yu yi mi mo gzi chas can:sngon gyi dam dgongs tha tshig bzhes:gser skyems gtor ma dgyes rol la:gtor sgo zor sgo yas sgo phyes:nad dang rims yams gdon sgo 'don:thun zor ltas ngan dgra la ston:mngon spyod lhun gyi grub mdzod cig:gzhan la ma 'byams ma yo shig:dza sgo ba rnams kyi sgo phyes shig:'phreng ba rnams kyi 'phreng sol cig:lce spyang tshogs kyi zor sna drongs:khro bo rnams kyi rgyab ded la:bsad pa'i shan pa lag ma ldum:gcod pa'i spu gri'i ngar ma zhan thun zor mtshon cha'i rno ma rdul:sde brgyad za rngam yus ma chung:bgegs kyi rgar thob 'degs ma snga:gang la gzas pa'i dgra sde rnams:ming gi lhag tsam med par mdzod:phung thal brlag pa'i las gyis shig:snyen a ka ni ni ka ni a bhi la maṇḍal ma ye swā hā:gtor lam phyes zor lam phyes:yas lam phyes:dgra bgegs ma re ra myur du brlag pa'i brin las mdzod cig:mda' spreng la zor lam dbye'o gtor ma zor bsgyur na hūṃ dza smyo

gtor ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dal: steng gi nam mkhar me rlung 'tshubs dbus dpag: drag po mngon spyod sgrol ba'i las la dgongs hūṃ phaṭa gad rgyang sod rgyob 'brug ltar sgrogs: gsod gcod las kyi pho nya'i bu yug 'tshubs gtor ma thog zer mtshon cha'i 'khor lor gyur: gang la gzas pa thal ba'i rdul du rlog: ma hya sgro wa ka la yakka mu tra bhyo dza: sa nā ga srog tshig nan gags lhog srin la rbad mdze grag grum bu la dza: skya ya chu ser sum spril la bhyo: dgra bgegs byad ma'i sgog snying la tshal ba dum bu bring shag dza rbad bye : de ltar bsgral las byas pa yis mngon spyod drag po' khyad chos 'byung sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba bskyed bden rdzun shan dbye no nus gsal mthu rtsal gnam lcags thog dang 'dra zab pa'i yang zab mkha' 'gro'i srog skal ba can gyi dpal du shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i bsgral las spu gri reg gcod rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang sprul ba' sku theg mchog rgyal mtshan dang chos gsal/ ratna sa ra rnams kyi bskul ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro'i
gsaX brda' ris las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel/sarba ma lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i bzlog pa gnam lcags thog zer bzhugs:ba rte na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: 33thamathe khrag skyems gtor chung ling ga bstabs bzlog dar sprugs shing rol mo sgogs gdung ba'i yus brjod sdang mig bsgrad rngams pa'i glu ya 'di skad do hūṃ bhyo: 'og min dur khrod me ru 'bar ba'i zhing: zla gam dgu rdzogs pad ma 'bum 'khyil klong: sti ra pad ma nyi zla bdud bzhi'i khar: che ba'i dbang phyug rta nag lcags ral can gar dgu'i rngams pa'i rnam gyur bzod dka'i gzi: gtum rngams char sprin 'khrug 'dra'i zhal mnga' ba: rjes chags brtse nyams gdul bya'i yul la g.yo: nyon mongs ra mtshan 'khrul ba'i kha lo bsgyur: pad ma dbang chen yang gsang khros par bstod: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: steng gdon gza' the rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlog: bar gdon lha srin sde brgyad rgol ba bzlog: 'og gdon sa bdag tsho gnyan ngan sbor bzlog: mdze grag grum bu chu ser nad rnams bzlog: nag po sum

sbrelanya gas thod gas bzlog: mkhris pa rtsa rgyugs gags lhog srin 'bras bzlog: ban byad bon byad kun rgyu'i byad phur bzlog: mo rtsis rmi 'khrugs than dang ltas ngan bzlog: dgra sna gyod sna gri kha mtshon dbal bzlog thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog ming med rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: bzlog sngags gdab hūṃ bhyo:dbang chen pad mgasung mchog rol pa'i lha'i sku yi che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyams:mnab pa'i gos gsum byug pa'i rdzas gsum brgyan btags pa'i rgyan gnyis che ba'i rtags su 'chang: gsung gi nga ros srid pa g.yo 'gul byed: rta skad dgu bton theg dgu'i chos char 'gyed: 'gros dgus sa gcod spangs rtog mthar phyin mdzad:thugs kyi gzigs pas sa gsum rmongs mun sel: byams brtse'i go chas 'gro ba 'dor med skyongs:nus mthu'i stobs kyis sbyor sgrol thabs mang 'byed: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las gter la bstod: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: steng gdon gza' the rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlog bar gdon lha srin sde brgyad rgol ba

ba:lho bzlog:'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan ngan sbyor bzlog:mdze grag grum bu chu ser nad rnams bzlog:nag po sum sbrel nya gas thod gas bzlog:mkhris pa rtsa rgyugs gags lhog srin 'bras bzlog:ban byad bon byad kun rgyu'i byad phur bzlog:mo rtsis rmi 'khrugs than dang ltas ngan bzlog:dgra sna gyod sna gri kha mtshon dbal bzlog:thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog:ming med rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod:hū sto dpa' bo chen po'i lcags kyi ral pa sprugs mtha' mi kla kle'i rdzas sbyor rbod gtong gtor:g.yas phyag lcags kyus gnas yul mkha' 'gro bskul:dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal mi nub 'bar bar byed:g.yon pa'i sdig mdzub dug khyung 'bar ba spro 'byung ba lnga la rgyas btab gtad mnan bkrol:zhabs gnyis bsgrad pas bdud dang dam sri gnon:skye bzhi'i kha lo ye shes dbyings su bsgyur 'bar ba'i me dang dug rlung 'tshubs ma 'phyo:gdug pa rgya 'dre'i 'khrul 'khor gzhig par byed:bde ba chen po'i ye shes dbang 'od 'bar:gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i mkha' 'gro dgyes:

sprul pa'i khro chung bu yug ltar du 'tshubs:byad dang byur dang gtad khram bzlog mdzad pa'i:'bar ba'i he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:steng gdon gza' the rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlog:bar gdon lha srin sde brgyad rgol ba bzlog:'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan ngan sbyor bzlog:mdze grag grum bu chu ser nad rnams bzlog:nag po sum sbrel nya gas thod gas bzlog mkhris pa rtsa rgyugs gags lhog srin 'bras bzlog:ban byad bon byad kun rgyu'i byad phur bzlog:mo rtsis rmi 'khrugs than dang ltas ngan bzlog:dgra sna gyod sna gri kha mtshon dbal bzlog:thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog:ming med rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod:hū bhyo ha he'i gad rgyang sgrogs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis:zhi drag gza' lnga'i rbod gtong sbyor ba bzlog:hi hi rjes chags dpa' ba'i glu dbyangs kyis sde brgyad dbang bsgyur cho 'phrul kheng log bzlog:hi hūṃ rol ba chen po'i rta skad kyis:klu gnyan sa bdag gtod kyi 'khrul 'khor bzlog:shing nas hūṃ glu 'brug ltar sgrogs pa yis:dri za

ba tshu grul bum klu dbang gnod sbyin bzlog bzhad pa phaṭa dang phem sgra sgrogs pa yis asne be ci srin po dbang ldan bzlog:tshangs ma srog 'jib rkang ma 'phro 'du yis:mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i phyogs kun mthar bar byed:dbang gi 'od khyims srid zhi'i bde 'byung gnas:bde mchog chags pa'i rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la steng gdon gza' the rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlog bar gdon lha srin sde brgyad rgol ba bzlog:'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan ngan sbyor bzlog mdze grag grum bu chu ser nad rnams bzlog:nag po sum sbrel nya gas thod gas bzlog:mkhris pa rtsa rgyugs gags lhog srin 'bras bzlog:ban byad bon byad kun rgyu'i byad phur bzlog:mo rtsis rmi 'khrugs than dang ltas ngan bzlog:dgra sna gyod sna gri kha mtshon dbal bzlog thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog:ming med rdul du brlag pa'i brin las mdzod:slo rgya sgro wa hūṃ phaṭa:mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i rkyen snang thams cad sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du

bsgyur cig: bzlog cig: e sa ma ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: de nas khyung bzlog ni hūṃ khro bhyo phrin lasathamasacad 'dus pa'i sku: ye shes khyung chen stobs po che: ri rab ri yi rtse mo dang dpag bsam shing gi yal steng nas: gsang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: sman raka gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes: byad dang byur dang gtad khram dang: bod zor rbod gtong thams cad bzlog: rnal 'byor nyams kyi bye brag dang: than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul bzlog mo ngan rtsis rdil 'khrugs pa dang: chags che nyam nga'i rkyen kun bzlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs tshogs bzlog gcan gzan gdug pa'i za rngams dang: 'byung ba bzhi yi chos 'phrul bzlog: lha gdon gza' dang rgyu skar dang: dregs pa sde brgyad rgol ba bzlog: lhog pa spun dgu'i sbyor btab dang: sa bdag klu gnyan gtor sbyor bzlog: mdor na mi 'dod mi mthun phyogs: ma lus bsdus te dgra la bzlog: dgra bgegs rdul rlog phrin las mdzod: lo khro ga ru ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba ru tra mā ra ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: rtsang bzlog ni hūṃ bye gdug

badzra rtsub dbal ngar ldan pa'i rtsang phur rnams: yar rtse 'bar bas gza' dang rgyu skar bzlog: lte ba rgya mdud dbang mo'i cho 'phrul bzlog: mar rtse mthing nag sa bdag klu gnyan bzlog lcags kyi drwa bas dam nyams 'chor med bcing: ye shes drwa bas skal ldan bu rnams skyongs: rtsang gi drwa bas 'khor ba chos skur bsre: las byed lcags sdig bung ba'i 'du 'phro 'byed: dgra bgegs dri 'dzin gshing lam nas zhugs te: bla srog tshe yi 'du byed bsnub par byed: mi mthun mi 'dod nyer 'che'i phyogs rnams kun:sdang byed dgra la rbad do dgra bzlog cig: gnod 'tshe'i bgegs la bzor ro bgegs bzlog cig: phung byed sri la brdar ro sri bzlog cig: za ba'i 'dre la ston no 'dre thul cig: mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig: kaḥs ra na gaḥnyanyim ra ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: 'di yi mi bzlog gang yang med ban bon stong gi dmod mthu bzlog chagasasgo bkra ma shes pa dang gdug pa bdud kyi ngan sbyor thub sa ma yu ye ma rgyal dbang pad ma'i thugasabacud 'di rin chen brda' yi rgyar bcug la mdo khams rtse shod gsham du bkod snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul nga dang mi

gnyis pa nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas gdul bya'i lhag mar skyongs bar byed 'brel tshad rig 'dzan zhing du 'god mi bsru rdo rje'i tha tshig yin sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i bzlog pa gnam lcag thog zer rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda zim snyi zhes pa'ang sprul pa' sku theg mchog rgyal mtshan dang chos gsal ratna sa ra rnams kyis bskul ngor kho bo nusaldan pasadag par phab pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig sa maṅga lam/

ba tshu rta nag lcags ral can gyi sngags bzlog ni oṃ ma hā ka la shrī hya ṣṭṛ wa rbad: nyi li ma yakka mu tra bhyo bzlog: sa la nan bṛ kre ka ra bhyo bzlog: nā ga sgog tshig he he bhisne bhyo bzlog: gnyan mgo dgu ha la bhyo bzlog: ltog pa rigs brgyad gas rims bhyo bzlog: mdze skya rlung gi 'khor lo bhyo bzlog: mdze dmar me mi tsha tsha bhyo bzlog: mdze nag spu gri reg gcod bhyo bzlog: 'brum bu dkar nag dmar gsum bhyo bzlog: sib dang be ge'i ldog nad bhyo bzlog: gnyan rims nag po sum spril bhyo bzlog: rgyu bshal mkhris pa rtsa rgyug bhyo bzlog: gag 'bras srin dang ya ma bhyo bzlog: grags dang grum bu chu ser bhyo bzlog: a bhyoḥyaḥspyomaḥspyoduḥbhyo phustsotsa bhyo shaḥbhyoḥn bhyoḥraḥbhyoḥgyisto byad ma rbod gtong mkhan gyi tshe bla sgog gi gshed du bhyo bzlog: a ha la la he bhyo: 'di yi mi bzlog gang yang med nus pa gnam lcags thog dang 'dra bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal nges shes gting nas 'grong bar 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya sngags bzlog spu gra reg gcod rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya gu ru pad ma'i bka' mtsho rgyal gyis brda res su bcug pa'o brda thim snyi zhes
pa'ang lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtsho dang chos srung rde wa rnams kyis bskul ngor nu ldan pasabasgyur ba dge legs 'phel sarba mgi lam

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin lcags ral can kyi bzlog bsdus nyon mongs 'dul ba'i ru maston zhes bya ba bzhugs so:bsgotshu na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: zanar rte//tsho rngam pa'i gdengasabaskyed rol mo sgrogs snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad gyer hūṃ bhyo: bde ba mchog sbyin rjes chags 'dzum pa'i gar: dbang gi rdo rje yang gsang khros pa'i gar: rta mgrin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can: mi mngon chos kyis dbyings nas sku bskyod la: rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags gar ngom bzhin 'dod yon ro mnyam mchod gtor 'di bzhes la a 'thas sems kyis bzos pa'i nyes tshogs bzlog: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug phyogs rnams bzlog: dgra sna gyod sna mi kha pra mchu bzlog btsa' sad ser gsum 'byung bzhi'i g.yo 'khrugs bzlog: mi nad nor gyis god yam mtha' dag bzlog: mo ngan rtsis 'khrugs pra lngas ngan pa bzog lngas ngan nyer gcig than dang cho 'phral bzog: kun brtag gzhan dbang yongs grab rkyen sngang banog: mtha' bzhi'i dmags dang rgya 'dre 'byang po

bzlog: steng 'og bar gdon dus kyi yo lang bzlog: rnal 'byer shes nyams rlung sems g.yo ba bzlog: dus min 'chi rkyen tshe yi bar chad bzlog: mdor na rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs rnams bzlog: nyes pa kun gyi nam yang mi tshugs par: nyes tshogs ye shes ka dag nyid du gyur: bde ba mchog gi rdo rje mngon gyur nas zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor dbang bsgyur te: rjes chags dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kha sbyor nas khams gsum yongs sgrol phrin las mthar phyin 31ga de ltar grangs bskyar dgra bdud 'joms nyon mong nyes pa'i tshogs lasargyal phrin las rnams bzhi lhun grub cing don gnyis 'bad med yid bzhin 'byung bka' 'di dam can rgya mtsho srung nyes can lag tu ma shor cig sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya rta nag lcagasaral can gyi bzlog bsdusardzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang theg mchog rgyal mtshan dang dhe wa gnyisakyi mos ngor nu ldan pa spel ba ma lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i bsregs blug gdul dka' gdon 'dul zhes bya ba bzhugs so:ba tshu na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: sko2 sgo34tsho mi bzad char spran gzugs 'dra'i sku rjes chags rta skad rgyang glu'i gsung chos kun mnyam sbyor thugs kyi gar he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo snyigs ma'i rgol ba sna tshogs pa'i gzengs pa rang sar gzhom pa'i phyir yang gsang rta nag 'di bsgom nas phrin lasakha bskong sreg blugs 'bul sa ma mā maṇḍal mda' gang drag po' thig rdul tshon drag hom me tshangs bca' dzos bsags yo byad tshangs bar bya lhar gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yis mdun bskyed bsreg blugs 'bul bar bya sa ma mā rdzas byin rlabs ni 31 āḥhū: thabs dang shes rab nyams sbyar sgod: drag po'i sregs rdzas sna tshogs pa: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs nas rta mgrin yang khros dgyes bskyed spel: 'iḥlal༅tha 'iḥbraḥ༅la'iḥlalamā ra ya ku ru swā hā me sbar ba ni hū hūḥ dug lnga'i rnam rtog sreg sbyangs phyir: mngon spyod drag po grub pa'i me: ljang nag las kyi mkha' 'gro yis: bya grub ye shes gzi byin bskyed: ram̐ḥkarma bhisne ta krita badzra dzwa

la ram̐ ram̐: rma g.yab ni hūṃ hūṃ gdug pa'i tshogasarnams 'dul ba dang ma rig du tra dbyings sgrol phyir lhag mthong shes rab rlung gis bskul: 'bar ba'i phrin las bskul ma mdzod: yi snyisne sarba garma duṣṭa phaṭa phaṭa: thabs khaṃ lha bskyed ni hūṃ mi dmigasangang las me dpung sang: dur khrod thod mkhar bkod rdzogs dbus pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i khar: / mthing spro bsdus zhu ba las: rta nag lcags kyi ral ba can: khro gtum gar dgu'i rnam par 'khyud: lcags kyu khyung nag phyag char 'dzin: thod sprul zhing g.yang stag shams klubs: rus pa'i ka shal me rlung 'tshubs: zhabs bsgrad dregs pa zil gyis gnon dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging gi tshogs ma 'dres rang gsal gdab par bya sgog gis bskul te 'og min nas ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs bstims: mda' dar g.yab cing spyan 'dren ni hūṃ hrī: gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i klong: rā tra bsgral ba'i khri steng nas: rta mchog rol ba sras 'khor bcas: 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir span 'dren gshegs sa ma ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: bams gsol na tī& rab 'bar dbang gi da la ru mngon

'amatshu spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i phyin: rta mchog rol pa gshegs nas kyang gnyis med mnyam pa chen por bzhugs: sa ma ya dza sa ma ya st+waṃ phyag 'tshal ni na mo rjes chags pad ma 'dzum pa'i zhal: dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal rigs bzhi dpa' bo dpa' mo dang mkha' 'gro ging la phyag 'tshal lo sa ma yā na mo ho phya nang gsang ba sbyor sgrol sogs mchod bya ltar du phul bar bya byon skyems 'bul ba 'di lta ste hū hrī: rtsi ba da snyeng po 'bru yi mar: byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin gyis rta mgrin nag po'i gsang gsum bskang mngon spyod phrin las lhun grub mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa a dṛ ta kha nyi: nyer gcig brjod la mar khu 'bul se be'i yam shang phul la rtsa sngags mthar bho dhi bhe kta ye rta sri god gdon ma ra ya phaṭaḥswā hā: nyer tshog phul la 'dod gsol ni ho snang zhing srid pa'i khyon yangs pa: rta mgrin yang khros dal du shar rta bdud rta sri btsan gshed kun: dbang chen rol pa'i zhal du 'bul mi mthun phyogs rnams tshar bcad nas: bde legs dpal spel phrin las bsgrabs: sarba ma ra ya phaṭa swā hwa: so ba 'bul la:rtsa sngags mthar badzra bee dza

ye phyug nad glo rtan lhog 'gags kha tsha rmig nad tshangs gza' mgo spyon sarba ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: nyer gcig gi phul 'dod gsol ni snang zhing srid pa'i khyon yangs pa rta mgrin yang khros dal du shar: phyug nad glo hon lhog 'gags sogs: dbang chen rol pa'i zhal du 'bul: mi mthun phyogs rnams tshar bcad nas: bde legs dpal spel brin las bsgrubs: sarba ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: gro phul la rtsa sngags mthar badzra ghasma ri ye: 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad thams cad sarba mā ya phaṭa swā hā nyer gcag gis phul 'dod gsol ni ste snang zhid srid pa'i khyon yangs pa: rta mgrin yang khros dal du shar: 'phral rkyen gzhan dbang yongs grub gdon: dbang chen rol pa'i zhal du 'bul: mi mthun phyogs rnams tshar bcad nas bde legs dpal spel phrin las bsgrubs sarba ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: yung dkar phul la rtsa sngags mthar badzra sirnya ye gdon gsum dgra yi 'tshe ba thams cad ma ra ya phaṭa swā hwa nyer gcig gis phul 'dod gsol ni hoḥ snang zhing srid pa'i khyon yangs pa: rta mgrin yang khros dal du shar: steng 'og bar gdon dgra rman sogs dbang chen rol

btsardo pa'i zhal du 'bul: mi mthun phyogs rnams tshar bcad nas: bde legs dpal spel phrin las bsgrubs: sarba ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: lcags phye la ga sha khrag rus gsum phul la rtsa sngags mthar sarba duṣṭa a mu ka me sa rakta tsitta la kha twe: brgya stong la sogs phul la 'dod gsol na ho: snang zhing srid pa'i khyon yangs pa: rta mgrin yang khros dal du shar: gri gshed dgra bdud dam sri sogs: dbang chen rol pa'i zhal du 'bul: mi mthun phyogs rnams tshar bcad nas: bde legs dpal spel brin las bsgrubs: sarba ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: skabs 'dir spro na bska tshogs gtong gzhu gi bstod pa rgyas pa ra bya slar ya gta nga rag 'bul ba niḥ 〉 hrī gzung 'dzin nyon mongs rdul bral bas: phyi nang gsang mchod sman gtor raka sbyor sgol bla med mchod pa rnams: dbang chen khros pa'i zhal du 'bul bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes thun mongs mchog gi dngos grub stsol:oṃ badzra pusgo dhu pe shasta dū pa shabha sparnye dharma rakta ba ling ta sta na ga ṇa sarba pu dza khā hi: rja sa khrus phul la ma: ye shes 1nga yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khong du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi

'bar ba'i sregs blugs 'di: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dal du 'bul mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar sto ṅgisgrokṣa a dṛ ta badzra sirnya saṃ bha dhe puṣṭa be gha bi dza ye gasma bā la a yu ṣe pra ti ha na gha gha ni sarba pa paṃ dwa ha na gnod byed gdon bgegs ma ra ya phaṭa:swā hā: nyer gcig gis phul 'dod gsol ni ho snang zhin srid pa'i khyon yangs par: rta mgrin yang khros dal du shar: mi phyug g.yang la 'tshe ba'i bdud: dbang chen rol pa'i zhal du 'bar: rte 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs zhi zhing: legs tshogs 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod: sarba ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: bstod pa ni hūṃ trī bde ba'i pro dang dga' bzhi'i gar: stong pa chos dbyings glu la gnas: rjes su chags pas 'khor ba stong: dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal la bstod: dngos grub ni ho sems kyi yid bzhin yi ge'i sprin: 'khor 'das nus pa mthu ru grub: byin gyis rlobs pa'i dgongs spyod can dbang chen bde ba'i dngos grub stsol: sidhi pha la oṃ uhūṃ hrī: bzod gsol ni ho kun nyon 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang: bskyed

gtsaX rdzogs ting 'dzin ma gsal nongs: bshags so sgrib bral tshangs par stsol sa ma ya āḥ yig ge brgya ba lan gsum bzlas la lhag ra skongs lhag ma cha gnyisabyas la skyon uṣṭi ṭa bā ling ta kha hi: thab tu 'bul o rte ling ta bha kta sgye swā hā: thab kyi phyi rol du dor bsngo smon ni ho: bsngo ba bya byed yul 'das par: 'khor gsum yongs su dag par bsngo med snang stong gzugs 'khor ba'i yul: sku gsum sang du byang chub shog: lan gsum bsdu rims ni ho 'bar ba las kyi dkyil 'khor lha: chos dbyings 'og min chen por bsdu mi dbang 'byung po gdon 'joms shing: mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyis grub a u bkra shis ni na mo snga 'gyur bstan pa'i bdag po dang 'khor slob sbyin bdag ma lus pa'i sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa dang: mdzad brin rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: 'phral byung rkyen dang kun btag gdon yongs grub tshe dang gzhan dbang las nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i rgyus bskyed kun: rang sar dag grol bkra shis shog: bde ba mchog gi zhal can pad ma dbang rjes su chags pa'i bshad gru gtsug na spa ma mo mkha' 'gro bro

gar glu la sbyor rta mgrin yang gsang 〈snas pa'i bkra shis regag: de ltar drag po mngon spyod kyi me las brtsam pas dgra gdon 'dul che rtags sde brgyad gtsug na spa khams gsum srid las rnam rgyal thob sa ma mā e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad ma ngas 'gro la brtse ba'i rjes chags kyis thugs kyi yang bcud zab rgya can rje mo mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad da dung spel ba' dus ma yin rin chen 'phrul gyi yi ger thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du sbos dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa na mtha' yi dmags kyi gzengs pa langs nag po sum bsgril nad rim rgod ma mo dgra ru ldang ba'i dus nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa nus ldan rdo rje da 'phrad nas gdul bya' lhag ma de yi skyongs 'brel tshad rnga yab dpal rir 'god de bar bka' 'di thub par srung dam nyams lag tu ma shor cag spu gri mched gsum dag la gnyer sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya rta nag lcags ral can gyis bsregs lugs gdul dka' gdon 'dul rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza' bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang thugs son sras po theg mchog rgyal mtshan nas bkra shas lha reg bra gzhi bcas bskul ro ra kho bo nub ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyas dbyi sa sna mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel sarba marsha lam

༄༅// rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa la brten nas klu yi gdon bkrol bya tshul gyi las 'grigs bzhugs so:ra༅༅ las gzhung bsrangs la/ lhag mjug tu/khrus bum sgrub te/ bum lha 'od zhu bcas grub 'phral/ g.ya 'bod rta klu chog las/ nā ga phu mdun du nee gseng sogs bsam 31'i bar ro/gdon bkrol las/ bdag nyid skad cig gis sogs dmigs la: dug sbyong las hūṃ: nga ni sogs nyon cig bum lnga las /: dri bral sogs ku ru ye swā hā: gdon bkrol las/ na mo: dkon mchog sogs khrol khrol swā hā: klu chog las gdon byung ni dza klu gnyan sogs swā hā: dug spyong las/ phu gangs ri dkar po'i sogs bsdus shig yang gdon bkrol las/ na mo dkon mchog gsum sogs bsdus shig /gza' lnga'i gdon bkrol las/ dza rdo rje 'chang dbang sogs mdzod cig gdon bkrol las srung dmigs ni/ na mo dkon mchog gsum sogs phyes phyes khrol khrol: dug sbyong srung dmigs ni/ hūṃ rgyal ba sras bcas sogs rakta rakta: st+waṃ: de ltar gong gi hū dri bral

nasa'adi bar lan lnga bskyal rjes/ klu chog las/ nā ga phu sangs rgyas bde bar sogs bkra shis 31ga bkra shis ci rig brjod de klu chu gnas su gshegs/ gdon bkrol mjug gi hū hrī nga ni rgyal kun sogs dhantu rakta hūṃ: tshe 'gugs 'dir byas na rung la bro mnan gyi mjug dngos grub blangasarjes bton kyang chog go snyams/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa la brten pa'i klu chog bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bzhugs so:ba rte na re gu ru pad ma ka ra khru: nana'i14je dza klu sman ba dmar 'o chab dang shel tshig shing rtsi klu gzuṭa bkod/ gnyen po las kyi lha gsal gdabs klu yi bskyed chog 'di lta ste:nā ga phu: mdun tu nee seng skyed tshal klong:na bun ljang sngon 'thib pa'i khrod: sman shing sna tshogs ra bas bskor ngang ngur mtsho rdzing pad tshal bkra: bdud rtsi'i chu mig ne'u seng 'dzoms de dbus saljang spro bsdus ru: chu bdag klu rgyal ljang sngon zhal sbrul gyi gdeng ga lnga dang ldan: nor bu chu 'dzin phyag char 'dzin: pad ma zla steng sbrul mjug 'khyil: 'ja' tshon sbrang char sil bur 'bebs: de rgyab srung bya la gnod pa'i: nad btang gdon byed bcings bsdam mkhan: thams cad ma 'dres gsal bar bskyed 'gugs bstims ni hu dadzad mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs dang: rta mgrin yang khros bden stobs kyis bdag dang srung bya la gnod pa'i: klu gdon ma lus gzugs la khug:

nā ga phu a garsha ya dza: lan gsum dzaḥsnorba ho: rin chen ming dang gzugs mdzes dang: 'jam klas 'jigs bral la phyag 'tshal: klu nad gdon rkyen las grol phyir glud gtor phun tshogs 'byung gyur cig: sam bha ras sngags brjod bzhin klu sman dang 'o chab shel tshig gis mchod na gā sarba durga te sarba pā paṃ shirnye ku ru swā hā: lan bdun brjod phrin bcol ni nā ga phu: deng 'dir gnod cing 'tshe ba'i klu: rgyal ba'i bka' la tshur nyon cig phan pa'i lan chags sbyin gtong 'jal: ma sod mkhon sbyangs bu lon bsad: klu na ba rnams la sman gyur cig tsha ba dag ni bsil gyur cig: grang ba rnams ni dro gyur cig sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig: bde ba phun sum tshogs gyur cig: dbul ba dag ni phyug gyur cig: bkres pa'i lto ni 'greng gyur cig: yon tan phun sum tshogs ldan nas: sbyin bdag bde skyid dpal dang ldan: nad med tshe ring longs spyod rgyas bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par 31ga: zhes chos kyi rgyud grol nas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par bsam mo: gdon phyung ba ni phag tshil rta bon lhum rtsa rdo me la bdug nas 'di skad gyer dzaḥ klu gnyan sa

btsaX bdag gtod sde rnams pad ma dbang chen dam la 'dus mdze grag grum bu chu ser sogs bsrung bya'i lus las da tshur bsdus:sbal nag rnam par da phyungs shig:sbrul gyi rnam par da phyungs shig:nya yi rnam par da phyungs shig:gcung mo'i rnam par da phyungs shig:sdom gyi rnam par da phyungs shig:sdig pa'i rnam par da phyungs shig:nyer 'che'i rkyen rnams rang gnas bsdus klu nad thams cad byang gyur cig:gnyan nad thams cad grol gyur cig:gtod nad thams cad dag gyur cig:sa bdag nad rnams zhi gyur cig:tshe hya skṛ wa hūṃ/nā ga du tsarnye tsarnye mi li mi li bhanta bhasto:nā ga ni klu gnyan sa bdag gtod kyi bcing bsdom thams cad phyungs phyungs khrol khrol swā hā:klu chu gnas su gshegs la nā ga phu:sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' klu yi snying la gnas par gyis:gnod pa phar la mi byed par:gtad mnan tshur la mi len zhing:pha ma lta bu'i byams sems kyis:skye dgu 'di dag skyongs bar gyis 'ja' sprin mkha' la yal ba bzhin:klu yi nad gdon rkyen bsdus la:rgya mtsho chu mig klongs du

dengs yon bdag bde skyid dpal dang ldan: phywa g.yang nor gyis phyugs gyur cig: nā ga hūṃ: sarba sirnyi pha la hrī: bkra shis ni na mo: bsod nams chen po ri rgyal bzhin tu brtan: tshe chos rgya mtsho nyi zla bzhin du gsal: grags snyan mnga' thang rgya mtsho che bzhin mer 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /de ltar klu chog gdon bkrol bas rnal 'byor nyer 'che'i rkyen la grol nad med tshe ring ci bsam 'grub mnga' thang stobs 'byor rgyasapar 'gyur zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i srog tig 'di skal ba can gyisadapal du shog sam shā rgya rgya rgya klu chog bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza' bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang rigs srasatheg mtshog rgyal mtshan dang sgob bu chos gsal grogs ratna sa ra rnamasakyis bskur ngor/ kho bo nusaldan 'dusapa rtsal kyi dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod lasabasgyur ba dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam/

'amatshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bum lnga'i khrus gsol nā ga'i gdon bkrol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:gtsaX na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: tshojucimi—1’ bum rdzas gu gul mi zi dang gla rtsi bong nga ga bur nag zhib btags bye dang rma bya khyung khyams bya'i sgro gzhob chu dang sbyar bzlas pa bskyed dmigs gzhung ltar btang hūṃ dri bral shel gyi bum pa dza me long ye shes bcud kyis gtams: skal ldan bu la khrus byas pas zhe sdang las byung nad gdon grib rgyal rigs klu yis bskyed pa yi: mthong reg kha rlangs dug gzhom cig: o rgya skṛ wa trī: nā ga du tsarnye tsadhe: mi li mi li bhanta bhanta nā ga ni rgyal rigs klu yi dug nad thams cad zhi ba shirnye ku ru swā hā zhes dang hūṃ: rab mdzes gser gyi bum pa na mnyam nyid ye shes bcud kyis gtams skal ldan bu la khrus byas pas: nga rgyal las byung nad gdon grib: rje rigs tsho yis bsted pa yi: mthong reg kha rlangs dug gzhom cig: rgo hya spyo wa hri: na ga du tsarje tsache: mi li mi li byujo byusmo na ga ni rje rigs gla yi dug nad

thams cad zhi ba shirnyi ku ru swā hā: zhes dang sa: 'od 'bar rā ga'i bum pa dra sor rtog ye shes bcud kyis gtams: skal ldan bu la khrus byas pas: 'dod chags las byung nad gdon grib: bram ze'u klu yis bskyed pa yi: mthong reg kha rlangs dug gzhom cig: yo rgya skṛ wa hrī: nā ga du tsarnye tsadhe: mi li mi li: bhanta bhanta nā ga ni bram ze'u klu yi dug nad thams cad zhi ba shirnyi ku ru swā hā zhes da hūṃ gting gsal int+ra'ibum pa na bya grub ye shes bcud kyis gtams skal ldan bu la khrus byas pas phrag dog las byung nad gdon grib: gdol rigs klu yis bskyed pa yi: mthong reg kha rlangs dug gzhom cig: ma rgya skṛ wa trī: nā ga du tsadhe tsadhe mi li mi li: bhanta bhanta nā ga ni gdol ba klu yi dug nad thams cad zhi ba shirnye ku ru swā hā: zhes dang hūṃ spros bral 'od gsal bum pa rba chos dbyings ye shes bcud kyis gtams skal ldan bu la khrus byas pas gti mug las bang jad gangor bib: ngamangs ribs ka yis bseng pa yi: mthong reg kha rwangs ngag ga'om cig sgo j-i wa ci: ra ga nga tsaje tsaje: mi li mi li: bran bran na ga ri

gtsaX dmangs rigs klu yi dug nad thams cad zhi ba shidzña ku ru swā hā:de ltar khrus byas nad gdon grol/tshe ring bsam don yid bgo 'grub sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya khrus gsol na ga'i gdon bkrol rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o/brda zim dzi zhes pa'ang theg mtshog rgyal mtshan dang chos gsal ratna sa ras bskur ngor/nus ldan pa sa spel ba maṅga lam/

ba:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:nā ga'i dug sbyong nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs:ga(: na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: za ngasanya rta mgrin yang khros rgyal dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'di skad gyer hūṃ nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi:gsung gi gsang ba mchog 'dzin pa:rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i rgyal:lha srin sde brgyad sgog gi bdag sa gsum 'byung po'i gtsug na rgyal:nga las che btsan su yang med bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la gnod pa'i 'byu po tshur nyon cig:phu:gang ri dkar po'i shar phyogs nas:rgyal rigs klu yi tshogs rnams 'dus:skye ba sngon nas da lta'i bar:mkhon 'gres 'gram 'khrugs shor ba dang:sa gnyan brkos dang rdo gnyan phyungs:chu mig gnyan brus spangs gnyan btanags:brag gnyan bshigs dang nā gnyan bslang:ne sang bkral dang khang nag bshas:zhing sa bral 'dul thabs gnyan gtor:mna' gnyan bskal len byas pa dang:pha rol rbod gtong bsam ngan gyis:gtad mnan sbor log sna

tshogs pas: ko long rū nga phrag dog dang: gdug rtsub bsam sbyor ngan pa yis: mthong ba'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig reg pa'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig: kha rlang dug btang phyir phyungs shig: bsam spyor ngan pa phyir phyungs shig: mdze grag grum bu phyir phyungs shig: gags lhog 'bras gzer phyir phyungs shig: shu ba rgya thor phyir phyungs shig 'brum bu dkar nag phyir phyungs shig: phol mig bas ldag phyir phyungs shig: rma 'brum gcung skran phyir phyungs shigaX chu ser rgyus 'then phyir phyungs shig: rtsa 'khum rtsog nal phyir phyungs shig thams cad ma lus zhi gyur cig: klu yi dug nad grol bar 31ga: cha phu le phu le phud phud: ha la ha la phud phud ma ma khaṃ shā khaṃ baṃ swā hā: ma ma su su rta rta swā hā: ma ma dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ swā hā: ma ma ku ru ye ye swā hā: ma ma mkha' gzhu mkha' gzhu swā hā: ma ma ri gi ni ra phud de ye swā hā 'byung ba lnga yi dug thams cad rang gnas su bsdus shig: chu ldum nag ldum spang sbos dang 'dre 'jigs mu zi'i dud pa bdug phu nag ma 'thug po'i lho phyogs nas: rje rigs glu yi tshogs rnams 'dus: skye ba sngon nas da lta'i bar: mkhon

gtsasdo: 'gres 'gram 'khrugs re ra ba dang sa gnyan brkos dang rdo gnyan phyungs chu mig gnyan brus spangs gnyan gshags brag gnyan bshigs dang nā gnyan bslang:ne sang bkral dang khang nag bshus:zhing sa brul 'dul thabs gnyan gtor mna' gnyan bskyal len byas pa dang:pha rol rbod gtong bsam ngan gyis:gtad mnan sbyor log sna tshogs pas:ko long rū nga phrag dog dang:gdug rtsub bsam sbyor ngan pa yis:mthong ba'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig:reg pa'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig:kha rlang dug btang phyir phyungs shig:bsam sbyor ngan pa dug btang phyir phyungs shig:mdze grag grum bu dug btang phyir phyungs shig:gags ltog 'bras gzer dug btang phyir phyungs shig:shu ba rgya thor dug btang phyir phyungs shig:'brum bu dkar nag dug btang phyir phyungs shig:phol mig bas ldag dug btang phyir phyungs shig:rma 'brum gcung sgran dug btang phyir phyungs zhig: chu ser rgyus 'then dug btang phyir phyungs shig:rtsa 'khum rtsog nal dug btang phyir phyungs shig:thams cad ma lus zhi gyur

cig: klu yi dug nad grol bar regag sa phu le phu le phud phud: ha la ha la phud phud: ma ma khaṃ baṃ khaṃ baṃ swā hā: ma ma su su rta rta swā hā ma ma dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ swā hā: ma ma ku ru ye yi swā hā: ma ma mkha' gzhu mkha' gzhu swā hā ma ma ri gi ni ra phud de ye swā hā 'byung ba lnga yi dug thams cad rang gnas su bsdus shig phu: rgya mtsho rdol ba'i nub phyogs nas:bram ze'u klu yi tshogs rnams 'dus skye ba sngon nas da lta'i bar: mkhon 'gres 'gram 'khrugs shor ba dang sa gnyan brkos dang rdo gnyan phyungs: chu mig gnyan brus spangs gnyan gshags: brag gnyan bshigs dang nā gnyan bslang: ne sang bkral dang khang nag bshus: zhang sa brul 'dul thabs gnyan gtor mna' gnyan bskyal len byas pa dang: pha rol rbod gtong bsam ngan gyis: gtad mnan sbyor log sna tshogs pas: ko long rū nga phrag dog dang: gdug rtsub bsam sbyor ngan pa yis: mthong ba'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig reg pa'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig kha rlang dug btang phyir phyungs shig: bsam spror bhe na pa dug btang phyir phyungs shig: mdze grag grum bu dug btang

bsgotshu phyir phyungs shig gags myog 'bras gzer dug btang phyir phyungs shig: shu ba rgya thor dug btang phyir phyungs shig: 'brum bu dkar nag dug btang phyir phyungs shig: phol mig bas ldag dug btang phyir phyungs shig: rma 'brum gcung sgran dug btang phyir phyungs zhig: chu ser rgyus 'then dug btang phyir phyungs shig: rtsa 'khrum rtsog nal dug btang phyir phyungs shig: thams cad ma lus zhi gyur cig klu yi dug nad grol bar shog: tshe phu le phu le phud phud: ha la ha la phud phud: ma ma khaṃ baṃ khaṃ baṃ swā hā:ma ma su su haṃ haṃ swā hā ma ma dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ swā hā: ma ma ku ru ye ye swā hā ma ma mkha' gzhu mkha' gzhu swā hā: ma ma ri gi ni ra phud de ye swā hā: 'byung ba lnga yi dug thams cad rang gnas su bsdus shig: phu sha ma bde ba'i byang phyogs nas: gdol ba klu yi tshogs rnams 'dus: skye ba sngon nas da lta'i bar: mkhon 'gres 'gram 'khrugs shor ba dang:sa gnyan brkos dang rdo gnyan phyungs: chu mig gnyan brus spa sa gnyan gshags: brag gnyan bshigs dang na gnyan bslang zhe sang bkral dang khang nag bshus: zhing sa

brul 'dul thabs gnyan gtor: mna' gnyan bskyal len byas pa dang: pha rol rbod gtong bsam ngan gyis gtad mnan sbyor log sna tshogs pas ko long du nga phrag dog dang: gdug rtsub bsam spyor ngan pa yis mthong ba'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig: reg pa'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig: kha rlang dug btang phyir phyungs shig: bsam sbyor ngan pa dug btang phyir phyungs shig: mdze grag grum bu dug btang phyir phyungs shig gags lhog 'bras gzer dug btang phyir phyungs shig: shu ba rgya thor dug btang phyir phyungs shig: 'brum bu dkar nag dug btang phyir phyungs shig: phol mig bas ldag dug btang phyir phyungs shig: rma 'brum gcung skran dug btang phyir phyungs zhig: chu ser rgyus 'then dug btang phyir phyungs shig: rtsa 'bum rtsog nal dug btang phyir phyungs shig thams cad ma lus zhi gyur cig: klu yi dug nad grol bar shog: tshe phu le phu le phud phud ha la ha la phud phud: ma ma khaṃ baṃ khaṃ baṃ swā hwa: ma ma su su haṃ haṃ swā hwa: ma ma dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ swā hwa: ma ma ku ru ye ye swā hwa ma ma mkha' gzhu mkha' gzhu swā hwa: ma ma ri gi ni ra phud

ba:tshu de ye swā hā: 'byung ba lnga yi dug thams cad rang gnas su bsdus shig: phuḥ ri dbang brjed pa'i khong seng nas: dmangs rigs klu yi tshogs rnams 'dus:skye ba sngon nas da lta'i bar mkhon 'gres 'gram 'khrugs re ra ba dang sa gnyan brkos dang rdo gnyan phyungs chu mig gnyan thus spangs gnyan gshags: brag gnyan bshigs dang nā gnyan bslang: rte sang bkral dang khang nag bshus: zhing sa brul 'dul thabs gnyan gtor: mna' gnyan bskyal len byas pa dang: pha rol rbod gtong bsam ngan gyis: gtad mnan sbyor log sna tshogs pas: ko long rū nga phrag dog dang: gdug rtsub bsam sbyor ngan pa yis mthong ba'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig: reg pa'i dug btang phyir phyungs shig: kha rlang dug btang phyir phyungs shig bsam sbyor ngan pa dug btang byir phyungs shig: mdze grag grum bu dug btang phyir phyungs shig: gags lhog 'bras gzer dug btang phyir spyangs shig shu ba rgya thor dug btang phyir phyungs shig: 'brum bu dkar nag dug btang phyir phyungs shig phol mig bas ldag dug btang phyir

phyungs shig: rma 'brum gcung skran btang phyir phyungs zhig: chu ser rgyus 'then dug btang phyir phyungs shig: rtsa gsam phyog nal dug btang phyir phyungs shig: thams cad ma lus zhi gyur cig: klu yi dug nad grol bar shog: slo phu le phu le phud phud: ha la ha la phud phud: ma ma khaṃ baṃ khaṃ baṃ swā hā: ma ma su su haṃ haṃ swā hā: ma ma dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ swā hā: ma ma ku ru ye ye swā hā: ma ma mkha' gzhu mkha' gzhu swā hā: ma ma ri gi ni ra phud de ye swā hā: 'byung ba lnga yi dug thams cad rang gnas su bsdus shig de nasagaza' lnga'i gdon bkrol ni sgo dbye rta mapha/ dzaḥ rdo rje 'chang dbang gsang bdag rgyal pad ma thod phreng la sogs pa'i: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga phu khas blangs dam bcas mna' bor nas: gza' brgyad gdong bzhi rgyu skar tshogs: padma'i brgyud 'dzin sbyin bdag la: steng gi gdon ni ma mdzad cig: sha ser gcu dkrugs ma 'debs shig: bya rog skad kyang ma dbyungs shig: zha krum gas gzer ma ston cig: gtor ma chang skyems brngan bzhes la: ra sha ra gsur dri snoms la: dkar nag 'byed pa'i mig gis gzigs: yo drangs shan dbye mda' stong

ga tshu la:nyes chad ston pa'i lto rdob la:yid brnag dgra bo rnye'i steng:gza' zla lhag nam mkha' la khra sha ra ra dgra bo la bhyo ltas ngan gyis mig 'phrul: cho 'phrul gi rtags ston:'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod cig zhes bskul la ra gsur khrag skyems gza' bgos dgra phyogs la rdeb dzaḥrdo rje 'chang dbang gsang bdag rgyal:pad ma thod phreng la sogs pa'i:rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga na khas blangs dam bcas mna' bor nas:gza' brgyad gdong bzhi rgyu skar tshogs:padma'i brgyud 'dzin sbyin bdag la:steng gi gdon ni ma mdzad cig:sha ser gcu dkrugs ma 'debs shig bya rog skad kyang ma dbyungs shig zha krum gas gzer ma ston cig:gtor ma chang skyems brngan bzhes la:ra sha ra gsur dri snoms la:dkar nag 'byed pa'i mig gis gzigs:yo drangs shan dbye mda' stong la:nyes chad ston pa'i lto rdob la:yid brnag dgra bo sgo'i steng gza' spen pa nam mkha' la khra sha ra ra dgra bo la bhyo:ltas ngan gyis mig 'phrul: cho 'phrul gi rtags ston:'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i brin las

mdzod cig: zhes bskul la ra gsur khrag skyems gza' bshos dgra phyogs la rdeb dzaX rdo rje 'chang dbang gsang bdag rgyal: pad ma thod phreng la sogs pa'i: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga dra/ khas blangs dam bcas mna' bor nas: gza' brgyad gdong bzhi rgyu skar tshogs: padma'i brgyud 'dzin sbyin bdag la: steng gi gdon ni ma mdzad cig: sha ser gcu dkrugs ma 'debs shig: bya rog skad kyang ma dbyungs shig: zha krum gas gzer ma ston cig: gtor ma chang skyems brngan bzhes la: ra sha ra gsur dri snoms la:dkar nag 'byed pa'i mig gis gzigs: yo drangs shan dbye mda' stong la nyes chad ston pa'i lto rdob la: yid brnag dgra bo rje'i steng: gza' nyi mig nam mkha' la khra sha ra ra dgra bo la bhyo ltas ngan gyis mig 'phrul: cho 'phrul gi rtags ston: 'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: zhes bskul la ra gsur khrag skyems gza' bgos dgra phyogs la rdeb dzaX rdo rje 'chang dbang gsang bdag rgyal: pad ma thod phreng la sogs pa'i: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga na khas blangs dam bcas mna' bor nas

bsgolho gza' brgyad gdong bzhi rgyu skar tshogs:padma'i brgyud 'dzin sbyin bdag la steng gi gdon ni ma mdzad cig:sha ser gcu dkyugs ma 'debs shig:bya rog skad kyang ma dbyungs shig:zha krum gas gzer ma ston cig gtor ma chang skyems brngan bzhes la:ra sha ra gsur dri snoms la:dkar nag 'byed pa'i mig gis gzigs:yo drangs shan dbye mda' stong la:nyes chad ston pa'i lto rdob la:yid brnag dgra bo sgo'i steng:gza' phur bu nam mkha' la khra sha ra ra dgra bo la bhyo:ltas ngan gyis mig 'phrul: cho 'phrul gi rtags ston:'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i phrin las mdzod cig:dzaḥrdo rje 'chang dbang gsang bdag rgyal:pad ma thod phreng la sogs pa'i:rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga dra khas blangs dam bcas mna' bor nas:gza' brgyad gdong bzhi rgyu skar tshogs padma'i brgyud 'dzin sbyin bdag la:steng gi gdon ni ma mdzad cig:sha ser gcu dmigs ma 'debs shig:bya rog skad kyang ma dbyungs shig:zha krum gas gzer ma ston cig:gtor ma chang skyems brngan bzhes la:ra sha ra gsur dri

sgoms la: dkar nag 'byed pa'i mig gis gzigs: yo drangs shan dbye mda' stong la: nyes chad ston pa'i lto rdob la: yid brnag dgra bo rne'i steng: gza' pa wa sang nam mkha' la khra sha ra ra dgra bo la bhyo: ltas ngan gyis mig 'phrul: cho 'phrul gi rtags ston 'phrad dang gsod pa mnyam pa'i brin las mdzod cig: zhes bskul la ra gsur khrag skyems gza' bsgos dgra phyogs la rdeb srung dmigasani /: rgyal ba sras bcas bden mthu dang: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa yis: sbyin bdag 'di la srung rgyas 'debs: steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar dang bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad dang: 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan gtod: 'jigs pa kun las skyabs tu gsol lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phyes phyes 〈snal ste/la badzra rakta rakta hūṃ de ltar steng 'og gdon bkrol phyir khrusabyab bsrung gsum cho ga 'dis mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang tshe ring nad med lang tsho dar pad ma'i thugasabacud zab pa'i gter skal ba can gyi dpal du shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya nā ga'i dug sbyor nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar
bas/ za bzas bkod pa'o brda thim lja zhes pa'ang sprul pa'i sku theg mchog rgyal ma' dang chos gsal ratna sa ra rnams kyas bskul ngor kho bonas ldan rdo spel ba dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga lam/
'tshon zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i gza' klu dregs pa'i gdon bkrol khro chu dug gi rdzong gur bzhugs so:

ba tshu na tho gu rupad ma ka ra ye: zang glidza/40skasgotho mi bzod char sprina'adrigs 'dra'i sku rta mgrin yang gsang khros par 'dud las can sgrub la snying rus can bdag nyid las rung sngon song nas gzhan don 'phrin las bsgrub pa la klu chog gzer bdun logs ltar shes khrus byas gdon bkrol bsrung ba bzhi lag du len tshul 'di ltar ro sa ma yā rdo rje slob dpon gyi khrus bum thog te bdag nyid skad cigagi khro bo rta mgrin yang gsang khros par gsal bas phyag g.yas bdud rtsi khrus kyi bum pa gnyen po lha gsum gyis khro rdul 'khrigs pa'i sku las bdud rtsis rgyun char ltar babs pas khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag nas nad gdon rkyen kegs thams cad sbal sbrul sdom sdig gi rnam par ba spu'i bu ga nas byung ste khrus glud dang rang gzugs rnams la thim par dmigs la: bum lnga'i khrus ni legs ltar bya bden pa 'i stobs kyi khrus bya ba na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo khro rgyal gnyen po ye shes kyi lha rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi bzad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bden pa chen po'i mthus: rgyu spror ba yon gyi bdag po 'di'i lus ngag

bas/: yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dkar po lha'i nad thams cad zhi ba shirnye ku ru ye swā hā ser po gnyan kyi nad thams cad zhi ba shirnye ku ru ye swā hā:dmar po btsan gyi nad thams cad zhi ba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: sngon po klu'i nad thams cad zhi ba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: ljang ku sa bdag gi nad thams cad zhi ba shirnye ku ru ye swā hā:khra bo gza'i nad thams cad zhi ba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: spug po gtod kyi nad thams cad zhi ba shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: thal skya the'u rang gi nad thams cad zhi ba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā:dud kha gdol ba nag po'i nad thams cad zhi ba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: mdze dang phol mug gi nad thams cad zhi ba shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: dregs dang grum bu'i nad thams cad zhi ba shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: rtsa 'khum dang rgyus 'then gyi nad thams cad zhi ba shidhe ku ru ye swā hā: rkya rbab dang chu ser gyi nad thams cad zhi ba shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: khong srin dang thor bo'i nad thams cad zhi ba shirje ku ru ye su ha: sub dang be ge'i nad thams cad zhi ba shirnu sa ru ye swa ha: gnyan rims dang rgya bshal gyi nad thams cad zhi ba shiṭwāṃ ku ru ye sā

hā: 'brum bu dang sum sbrel gyi nad thams cad zhi ba shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā klu gnyan sa bdag gtod kyi mthong ba'i dug thams cad zhi ba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: reg pa'i dug thams cad zhi ba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: kha rlang gi dug thams cad zhi ba shidzña ku ru ye swā hā: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dug thams cad zhi ba shirnye ku ru ye swā hā tshe phu le phu le phud phud:ha la ha la phud phud: nā ga du tsarnye tsarnye mu lu mu lu bhan dha bhan dha nā ga ni swā hā: gnyis pa nad gdon byab pa ni na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: khro rgyal gnyen po ye shes kyi lha rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan brin las mi bzad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bden pa chen po'i mthus: rgyu sbyor ba yon gyi bdag po 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dkar po lha'i nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā ser po gnyan kyi nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: dmar po btsan gyi nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hwa: sngon po gla'i nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hwa: ljang ku sa bdag gi nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hwa khro bo gza'i nad thams cad a pa na ye

btsa) swā hā: thal skya the'u rang gi nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: dud kha gdol ba'i nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā klu gnyan sa bdag gtod kyi mthong ba'i dug thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: reg pa'i dug thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: kha rlangs gi dug thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: bsam spyor ngan pa'i dug thams cad a pa na ye swā hā tsos badzra kro ta rgya snyi wa shrī kā la hūṃ phaṭa: sa nā ga srog tshig nan: keg lhog srin la rbad mdze dregs grum bu la dza rkya ya chu ser sum sbrel la bhyo: 'brum bu sub dang be ge la dza: rims yams grib gdon dzwa la ram phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā gsum pa 'byung bzhi'i gdon bkrol ni na mo: dkon mtshog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo khro rgyal gnyen po ye shes kyi lha rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bden pa chen po'i mthus: rgyu sbyor ba yon gyi bdag po 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dkar po la'i nad thams cad byung byung khrol khrol swā hwa: ser po gnyan gyi nad thams cad byung byung khrol khrol swā hwa dmar po

btsan gyi nad thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: ljang ku sa bdag gi nad thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: khra bo gza' yi nad thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā thal skya the'u rang gi nad thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: dud kha gdol ba'i nad thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: rgyal rigs klu'i nad thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā rje rigs klu'i nad thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: bram ze'u klu'i nad thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: dmangs rigs klu'i nad thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: klu gnyan sa bdag gtod kyi mthong ba'i dug thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: reg pa'i dug thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: kha rlangs gi dug thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dug thams cad phyung phyung khrol khrol swā hā ma ma khaṃ khaṃ baṃ be swā hā: ma ma su su haṃ haṃ swā hā: ma ma ram̐ ram̐ dzwa la swā hā: ma ma ye ye byer byer swā hwa: ma ma mkha' gzhu mkha' gzhu swā hwa: 'byung ba lnga'i dug thams cad rang gnas su bsngas shig: 'byung ba'i dzos thams cad khrus glud la bsdu'o gdon bkrol dngosan lhum rtsa
ṭwāṃ bhe )/bhe ༷ tt+waṃ bhe dhishaṃ she༅ tt+waṃ bhett+waṃ tt+waṃ bhe she dhi ṭwāṃtt+waṃ /tt+waṃ ṭwāṃ tt+waṃ tt+waṃ bhe bhebhe rdo bhebhe

baṃ me le le mkha' gzhu mkha' gzhu swā hā: 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi dug thams cad rang gnas su bsdus shig: bzha ba srung dmigs go bgo ni na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: khro rgyal gnyen po ye shes kyi lha rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bden pa chen po'i mthus: rgyu spyor ba yon gyi bdag po 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dkar po lha'i nad thams cad las srung shig rakta rakta: ser po gnyan gyi nad thams cad las srung shig rakta rakta: dmar po btsan gyi nad thams cad las srung shig rakṣa rakṣa sngon po klu yi nad thams cad las srung shig rakta rakṣa ljang gu sa bdag gi nad thams cad las srung shig rakṣa rakta khra bo gza'i nad thams cad las srung shig rakta rakṣa: thal skya the'u rang gi nad thams cad las srung shig rakta rakta: dud kha gdol bas nad thams cad las srung shig rakta rakta: rgyal rigs klu'i nad thams cad las srung shig rakta rakta: rje rigs klu'i nad thams cad las srung shig rakṣa rakta: bram ze'u klu'i nad

bsgotshu thams cad las srung shig rakta rakta: dmangs rigs klu'i nad thams cad las srung shig rakta rakta klu gnyan sa bdag gtod kyi mthong ba'i dug thams cad las srung shig rakṣa rakta reg pa'i dug thams cad las srung shig rakta rakṣa: kha rlangs gi dug thams cad las srung shig rakṣa rakta bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dug thams cad las srung shig rakṣa rakta:yin badzra 17 ta ha ya ṣṭṛ wa ma ma tsitta rakta hūṃ sbyo swā hā:yin badzra kwa ya rakṣa lus bcings pa phyes phyes khrol khrol: ā wākka rakta ngag bcings pa phyes phyes khrol khrol: hūṃ tsitta rakta yid bcings pa phyes phyes khrol khrol khrus glud da gdon yas rnams phyir ba da de hū hrī: nga girgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje che rta mgrin yang khros rjes su chags pa'i gar: mi dbang 'byung po'i tshe dang sgog gi bdag lan chags glud gyis brngan no phyir dengs shig: gal te 'khu na tshal ba dum bur byed: khrag skyugs 'bog brgyal ming med stong par 'khyar: de bas da lnga nyid du phyir dengs shig: tram̐ tram̐masatstsha ta ya phaṭa: dug sna dang 'dre 'jags phag tshil gyis dud pa bdug yungs dkar gyis grab hūṃ bzhi dang drag sngagasagyis gzir srung rgyas

gdab pa ni trī: 'byung dang 'byung ba'i rkyen rnams rang gnas bsal: nad dang gnod pa mi gnas stong par sbyangs gnyug ma'i rang bzhin ye shes lngas rgyas gdab byang chub sems las nam yang 'da' mi byed: dzñā na dhartu rakta sbyo: dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag la rgyas gdab par bya'o tshe rgyas gdab pa ni rang rta mgrin yang gsang 17sa par gsal ba'i thugs gar tshe dpag med ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba gcig bskyed pa'i sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer dbang mdog lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa spros te steng lha yi tshe bcud thams cad a:dkar po: bar mi'i tshe dang bsod nam zlo:ljang sngon: 'og klu dang lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshe sgog (:sngon po'i rnam par bsdus nas bdag dang bsrung bya'i tshe sgog bla yi gsos su gyur bar dmigs la skyirngo pad ma ta krita tshe hūṃ ā ma ra ṇi dzi warnyi ye swā hā: nyer gcig brjod la tshe 'gugs pa ni hūṃ hrī tshe dang ya shes dpag med gter: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub mdzod: rgyal kun ye shes rdo rje che: tshe dpag med pa 'gro ba'i mgon: gang ska pad ma rā ga la: nyin byed 'bum 'khyad bkrag

ba:tshu mdangs 'bar:sku gsung thugs las sprul ba yi:pho nya dkar ser dmar mthing ljang sprul pa yang sprul sa ya 'bum:kun kyang thugs dam rjes dran nas:stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten gyi:tshe bsod dpal dang bkrag mdangs bcud:'od dang 'od zer rnam par bsdus:skal ldan bdag cag rnams la bstims:lus la 'chi med tshe rgyas thob:ngag la 'gags med gsung dbang skur yid la 'khrul bral thugs byin rlobs:rdo rje'i tshe ni mkha' dang mnyams:g.yung drung srog ni nyi ltar gsal pad ma'i bla ni gnyis ga'i gsos:rgya gram bkrag mdangs gang ltar chags:'khor lo'i srung rgya'i 'gyur ba med:bla ni tshe yi gzhal yas khang:sha dang sa yi dwangs mar bstims:hūṃ ni 'gyur ba med pa'i rdzong:khrag dang chu'i dwangs mar tshugs tre ni zad pa med pa'i gter:drod dang me'i dwangs mar bskyil:hrīḥni ye shes snying po'i sgog:dbugs dang rlang gi dwangs mar 'dus:āḥni skye 'gags 'gyur med thugs:mkha' sems gnyis med ngang la rbad:rgyal ba rigs lnga'i phyag rgya yis:tshe srog 'byur med rgya yis gdab:

'khor 'das yongs kyi phywa g.yang blan: 'bru gsum yi ger dwangs bcud dril: srog gcig yi ger tshe rgyas gdab: skye shi med par rgyas thob la: tshe dbang rigs 'dzin 'grub gyur cig: lan grangs mang du brjod la tshe gzungs bcas tshe la dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya'o bden pas srung go bsgo ba ni hū trī rgyal ba srabasabacas bden ba'i byin rlabs dang: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i bden stobs kyis: sbyin bdag 'di la bdag gi srung rgyas gdab: phyin chad gdon gsum rkyen las rnam rgyal mdzod: hūṃ badzra rakta rasnya a yudzñā na tiṣṭha sbyo: shes brjod ni hū hrī rjes gas bshad pa'i sku mdog char sprin mdog dug gsum gdon la gshe bas bzhad skad sgrogs: mi 'gyur bde ba mchog gi thugs mnga' ba rta mgrin khams gsum rol ba'i shis pa stsol: mi mthun 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams zhi zhing stong: tshe bsod dpal dang 'byor ba mkha' ltar rgyas: lha 'dre mi gsum snang ba dbang du 'dus:dgra bdud g.yul las rgyal ba'i shis pa stsol: rgyal bstan rin chen dam pa'i chos kyis 'tsho: byams dang snying rje'i lo 'dabs kun nas rgyas: nyams dang rtogs pa'i 'bras

ba rte bzang yongs su smin: 'og min mkha' la dbang bsgyur shis pa stsol: sde brgyad gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dngangs: dregs pa gza' klu'i srog snying phyag tu phul: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtsug gi rgyan du bsngags bde mchog grub pa'i rdo rje'i bdag skyongs shig: gzhan yang shis brjod rgya cher bya gang la brtsams pa'i 'dod don 'grub mi mthun g.yul las rnam par rgyal dpa 'a rtags grub pa 'i yon tan 'byor sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs brtse'i rjes chags pa'i thugs kyi yongs bcud rdo rje snying po' skor grub pa' dbang phyug 'brog ban lo tsar gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma babs zhes mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra bsdams gter bdag bzang phyir klu bdud btsan la gnyer dus rkya snyigs ma' nad mtshon gzeng sa lang tshe o rgyan sprul ba las can gcig gis rnyed gdul bya'i lhag ma rig 'dzan zhing du 'god the tshom med do pad ma rgyal po' bka' tshogs smon las 'phro 'dzom pa'i dpal du shog sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gza' klu dregs pa'i gdon bkrol khro chu dug gi rdzo gur rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza'i bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang sprul ba'i sku

mchog pad ma theg mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba dang slobs bu dhe wa'i bkra shis lha reg bcas te nan tan chen po bskul ngor kho bo nus na 'dusapa rtsal gyi dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod la bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin pad ma'i mtshan can gyis brgyas pa dge legasa'aphel sarba ma lam/

ba rte zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin ma hā ka la'i cha lags: zag sgrub bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i bum bcud gyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs kun 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so: ba rte na mo gu ru pad ma kā ra ye:rabarje(za ma 'ong las can skal bzang skyes bu rnams yang gsang zab mo'i lam la zhugs pa'i tshe dad dang mos gus gdung ba drag po yi gsol ba 'debs pa 'i thabs la 'bad par bya sa ma yā de yang yid ches thob pa'i mos gus kyis gsol ba phur tshug gdab cing dang ba'i blo'i snyan pa'i dbya sa kyis dus drug 'di nyad bskyal gnad des byin rlabs zab mo 'byung bar 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i rgyal po'i bka' e ma ho chos sku'i ston pa sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: longs spyod rdzogs mdzad 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag o rgyan pad ma 'byung: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: gdug pa 'dul mdzad rta mchog rol pa'i gar ye shes dbyings nyid khro rgyal rigs bzhi'i sku: bde stong bskyed mdzad badzra wa ra hi: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: mtha' dmags tshar gcod rta nag ki la ya: dgra bgegs rdul brlag ging ging

dmar nag dang las mdzad bka' nyan dregs pa sde bdun la: gsol ba 'debs so bar chad dgra bgegs sgrol: de ltar mos pa'i gsol ba btab mthu yis: phyi ru mtha' dmags dus 'khrugs zhi ba dang: nad mtshon rims yam mi ge'i rgud pa sol: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan rbor don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis snang ba stsol rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho rtag 'phel nas: 'gro kun gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par re/ga: de ltar mo gusagadu shug drag po yi gsol btab 'bras bu chud mi za bar smin phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe zhi phan dang bde ba'i la tsho 'phel rgyas gyur bden rdzun lag tu longasadang ngesashesagasal bka' gsang thub par srungs shig spu gri gsum dam nyam lag tu ma shor a tham rgya la can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sam yu rgya rgya rgya gsol 'debasabyin rlabasakun 'dus rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wasabaka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda zim lha zhesapa'ang dge btsun dam pa ma ha pha la dang dzñā na ba 'i yang yang bskur ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nu ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i brda res las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legasa'aphel sarba ma lam/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dpal rta mgrin nag po'i zab sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum bcud zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ba tshu na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye:zabasgo/cho sa bye marga tu mi 'gyur bde za spros dang bral rang gsal ye shes 'bor 'das kun la brdal lhan skyes gas ma byang chub sems kyi dbyings sku gsum lhun grub dpal la phyag 'tshal gya'o bdag 'dra o rgyan pad ma thod 'phreng ngas ma 'ong 'gro la brtse ba chen po' yis phyi nang rkyen bzlog gdug tshogs drung 'byin thabs rta nag khro gtum rngam pa'i chos sde bstan sa ma mā de yang rgyasa'abring bsdus pa shin tu bsdus rnams pa bzhi las tha ma'i las rim la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa gsum dang po la'ang rnams pa dgu yi bstan maṇḍal bca' bsham spyi ltar mdzes par bkram rnam lnga nyer spyod phyi nang mar pa brtsam rnal 'byer bag pheb bde ba'i stan la gnas stong dang snyang rje ya ma bral ba yis dang po skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pa ni na mo bla ma sangs rgyasakun dngos rdo rje 'chang yi dam dpal chen hya ṣṭṛ wa'i gar bde stong bskyed mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la:byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi lan gsum gnyas pa byang chub mchog du sems bskyed na ho mtha' med 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i gzeb dbang med spyod pa'i dmus longs 'gro ba rnams:rig pa 'od gsal dbyings su ngal bso phyir:brdal khyab byang chub

ba:tshu mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum gsum pa yan lag bdun pa'i rim pa ni na mo mchog gsum ngo bo rta mchog rol pa'i lha: sgo gsum mos gus dad pa'i phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid 'dod yon kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: gzung 'dzin mi dge las kun masal lo bshags: zag dang zag med dge la rjes yi rang gang 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge tshogs gcig bsdus ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par 31ga lan gsum bzhi ba bgegs la bka' bsgo bya ba ni hūṃ hrī: nga bdag gzung 'ardzan las byung 'dre gdon bgegs: rang grol 'dod yon glud gtor 'di khyer la: 'od gsal bde ba chen por dengs shig: phaṭa: 'di la log par blta ba'i ming yang med: / hūṃ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: / bzhi'i sngags brjod thun brab drags sngags gzar lnga ba bsrung ba'i gur khang bsgom pa ni hūṃ ༷

mtshams bcad do: yo badzra dzñā na rakta rakta hūṃ: drug pa byan 'bebs pa'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī 'og min chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba nas: bde gshegs gsungs gi dbang phyug he ru ga gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs rta mchog rol pa'i lha: ma lus 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol: sgrub pa po la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: dag mnyam ye shes rol par byin chen phob: 31 dzñā na kro dha sarba sa ma ya hrīng hrīng dza dza: bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ram pa na 31 ā hū: dpag yas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yis: rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin: ma lus byi nang gsang gsum rnam par dag: nam mkha' mdzod kyi rol par byin rlabs gyur: 31 āXhū: badzra spa ra ṇa sa: brgyad pa dam bca' 'dzan pa'i rim pa ni hū hrī: rang gsal rnam dag ye shes lha yi sku: phyi nang bar med zang thal bde chen gshis sku dang ye shes 'dul 'bral med pa'i lha: rang gsal ye shes rjen pa mngon du bya: ma dzra na tsibyu sa ma ti hūṃ: dgu pa bshags pa bya ba'i rim pa ni ho: dpang gyar skabs mchog ma lus dgongs su gsol: bdag ni gsang ba mchog gi smor zhags nas:

btsa/: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams:rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems gyis mthol lo bshags:67 badzra sa ma ya shudhe āḥsbyor ba sngon 'gra'i rim pathi sa ma yu gnyesapa rnam grangs bcu yis legs par bstan da po lha bskyed bya ba'i rim pa ni yi gzhi med rtsa bral chos sku de bzhin nyid:lhun grub 'gags med byang chub sems kyi mdangs:rgyu yi sa bon (:mthing 'phro 'du las:dur khrod rab 'jigs rngams pa'i pho brang dbus padma nyi zla bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i steng:bdag snang dpal chen rta mgrin nag po'i sku:zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs:smar smin me 'bar thod skam dbu rgyan mdzes:dar sna'i cod paṇa nyi zla'i snyan cha bkra:stag shams sbrul chun mgo phreng rus rgyan spras:phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkha'i dbyings su phyar g.yon pas thod khrag sku yi lte bar bsten kha ṭaṃ rtse gsum mchan khung g.yon du bsten:dmar ser dbu sgra srid pa'i rtse ru 'khyil:rta mgo ljang zhur mtsher skad hi hi sgrogs:zhabs gnyis bsgrad pas bdud dang dam sri gnon:snang stong ye shes sgyu ma'i rol par bskyed:gnas lngar khro

rgyal rta mchog rigs lnga dang: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'du 'phro skar ltar 'khrigs: rigs kyi bdag po gu ru pad ma bzhugs: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag med 'phros: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spyan drangs nas: mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su sa ma dza gnyas pa spyan 'dren bya ba'i rim pa ni hū hrī 'og min bde chen rang gsal pho brang nas rgyal ba kun dngos phrin las rdzogs mdzad gar dbang chen rta mchog rol pa gtso 'khor bcas: gnas 'dir byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dza dza gsum pa bzhugasagasol phyag 'tshal bya ba ni hū hrī: gdan gsum tshangasab rdo rje phung po'i drung: dbyings nas spyan drangs lha tshogs ro gcig bstims: lha dang rang sems dbyer med bde ba che: don dam snying po'i gshes la gus phyag 'tshal: dzñā na tiṣṭha lhan: na mo na ma ho bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba'i rim pa ni hā trī med byung kun tu bzang po'i rol pa las: byung ba'i phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin: dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam

ba tshu pa yis: lhag pa'i lha mchog dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bul: ma hā pañtsa pu tsa ho: lnga pa sman rag gtor mchod 'bul ba na hūṃ hrī: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a mṛ ta:chags pa bsgral ba'i dmar gyi khrag chen po: brjid ldan dpal gyi ba ling ri ltar spung: dpal chen rta mchog rol pa'i lha la 'bul: ma hā pañtsa ba ling ta kha hi: drug pa bstod pa glu yi mchod pa ni hūṃ hrī: ma bcos spros bral chos sku snang mtha' yas: rang bzhin ma 'gags lhun grub hya ṣṭṛ: thugs rjes rang grol 'gro 'dul 'khor dang bcas dbyer med mnyam pa nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di bzung ji srid gdod ma chos sku'i bar skad gcig 'bral ba med par rjes bzung zhing: nyams dang rtog pa'i yon tan gong 'phel rgyas: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun bsal nas: sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs de: gdod ma'i kun bzang rgyal sa zin par shog: bdun pa 'dzab kya 'byul 'bor bsgom pa ni tī hri: rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka dza rang 'dre'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba: rgyan med gcer bu 'od kyi rang bzhin gsal: de yi thugs klong pad ma zla ba'i

steng: beeḍūr rang bzhin rdo rje nas 'bru tsam: lte ba thabs shes nyi zla'i ga'u dza rig pa hū la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags rnams:sbur ma me dang 'phrad bzhin lhag med bsregs: stong gsal ye shes lha sku'i rnam par sad tshug badzra kro dha hya snyi wa hūṃ phaṭa: bye ba bzlas pa' rtags dang mtshan ma 'byung brgyad pa sgrub pa'i 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hūṃhrī: bdag thugs 'od kyisamadun bskyed lha tshogs bskul de dag las ni 'od zer dpag med 'phros: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dpal yon dwangs bcud bsdus: bdag thim nus stobs gzi brjid rab rgyas nas: dbang byin dngos grub ma lus thob par bsam: o badzra kro dha rgya skṛ wa sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā 'bum ther bdun gyi rtags marga dngos grub lung dgu pa las sbyor 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hūhrī: rang nyid yi dam lha yi sku dang ni: ba spu'i bu ga kun nas khro chung dang: lcag sdig me dpung rdo rje'i 'du 'phro yis: rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po tshar bcad nas: snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos smra'i ngang: ma badzra kro ta hya spyo wa du khya bṛ ka la ru pa hūṃ phaṭa: 'bum phrag gsum bzlas rtags mtshan khyad

btsa/ par 'phags bcu ba 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa ni hūṃ hrī: lhag pa'i lha mchog pad ma dbang gi sku: thugs rjes brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol deng sang snyigs ma'i ru 'dzing 'khrugs slong 'tshubs: rgyal bsen dam sris g.yo ba sna tshogs ngoms: bar chad sabha'i gzing pa rab g.yo shing: mi nad nor la god kha sna dgu sdang: rgya 'dre 'byung po'i za kha ston pa la lha mchog khyed kyi thugs rje'i stobs kyis bzlog: nad mug mtshon 'khrug rgud pa mtha' dag sol: dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe thul:mo rtsis rmi ngan pra ltas 'khrugs pa thul phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon phyor: dgra gdon bgegs kyi nyer 'tshe ma lus bzlog: bkra shis gser gyi nyi ma rab tu sbor: nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngos zla ltar spel: tshe dang chos kyi sgrub mtha' legs smin nas gdod ma'i kun bzang rgyal sa zin par shog: dngos gzhi lha bskyed rim palhargya sa ma yā gsum pa rjes rims rnam grang dgu yis bstan dang po tshogs rdzas byin gyas rlabs pa ni gi mtshan ldan bharnya yang pa'i snod nang du: dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi gter ye shes mchog

gi mchod pa rmad byung ba: nam mkha' rab 'byams khyon rnams yongs bkang ngo yo āḥhū ha ho hrī: lan gsum gnyis pa tshogasago spyan 'dren bya ba ni hū hrī: rang bzhin rnam dag 'og min chos dbyings nas: brgyud ldan bla ma yi dam lha yi tshogs rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs sras 'khor bcas: zhal zas tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: o badzra sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa 'bul bshags bsgral stabs bya ba ni hū trī: yi dam khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i lhar phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod dam pa 'bul: gzung 'dzin ma rig las nyon dri ma bshags: log 'khrul dam sri 'byung po bsgral byas te: phung khams skye mched ye shes lha zhal bstabs ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo stong gyur cig: o ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza ho: sa ma ya shuste a: hṝ tri sha tt+waṃ ma ra ya phaṭa: sarba rū tra kha kha kha hi kha hi bzhi ba lhag ma bsngo ba'i rim pa ni tho lhag la dbang ba'i rdo rje'i pho nya ni: ma sring ging dang liṅga 'bar ma'i tshogs pham phab bka' yi lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: lnga ba ra mdo bstan skyongs brngan pa ni hā bhyo sngon tshe bar dang

ba tshu tha ma'i bskal pa la: spyi dpal chen po pad ma thod phreng dang: grub pa'i rig 'dzin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis: spyan sngar khas blang mna' bor dam bcas pa'i:dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu rtsa gnyis dang phyi nabhe gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad sde: dregs chen bco brgyad las mdzad pho nya'i tshogs: ma yum brtan ma gtso 'khor bcas rnams kyi: dam rdzas brgyan gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dus 'khrugs nad yams rgud pa mtha' dag sol sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen bsrung ba dang: nad yam mu ge bkra mi shis pa thul: rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa mkha' la spel: dgra bgegs 'byung po bkra mi shis pa thul: phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis snang ba stsol rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya ces brjod phrin las rab 'byams gegs med 'grub drug pa rta bro 'a ba pa 'a ram pa ni hū trī: gsang sngags bsgrub la bar du gcod byed pa'i: ya ma dam sri 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun: pho brang ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu mnan: steng du khro rgyal rngams pa'i rta bro brdung: nam yang sdang bar ma byed stam

bha ya: nan nan phaṭa: bdun pa bsngo ba smon lam bya ba ni ho: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gcig tu bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig gdod ma'i ye gzhi chen po'i sang: kun tu bzang po'i rgyal sa zin par re ga: lan gsum brgyad pa rtag chad mtha' bsal bya ba ni gis snang cha thabs su shar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha rmad byung rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' la yal: slar yang sgyu ma'i rol rtsal phyag rgya yis snang stong gnyis su med pa'i spyod lam bya'o: a a phaṭa phaṭa dgu pa bkra shis bya ba'i rim pa na na mo sgrin 1 la dbang byin dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas: rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i bkra shis shog: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtshos bkra shis sgo ga: bar chad sel zhing phrin las lhun grub pa'i: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar da la la mtshan yang bkra shis bde spyod kyi li li: bar med bkra shis bde stong me re re: rtag par dge ba'i bkra shis stsal du gsol: gzhan yang shis brjod bsngo smon mtha' rgyas bya bkra shis dge ba'i lang tsho rnam par bkra bde

gtsardo skyod phan bde nyi ma gsar du 'khrungs the tshom med do gu ru pad ma' bka' sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad ma saṃ bha was ma 'ong 'gro la brtse ba chen po yi snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams pa med byung ba grub pa'i dab phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda' la thob mdo khams rtse shod gshams du dgongs rgya mdzod ma 'o snyigs ma sum bcu kha ral dus spruladapa' bo nu ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nasabastan 'gro'i pha na bde rgya chen spel sangs rgyasabastan pa'i nyi ma yongs su gsal the chem med do gu ru pad ma'i bka' bden rdzun lagasadu longs dang nges shes gsal skalamed lag tu ma shor a tham rgya lasacan snyeng gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya zab sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum bcud rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya brda tham yo rgyan gyi sgob dpon pad ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o gu rgya snyi cesapa 'ad chosakyi bdag po pad ma chos 'aze la rgya mtsho' bskul ba dang / dge btsun mchog bzang gis dar dang ran po che' lag gdub bcas nas bskul ba dang gnub zur bla ma ye sangs gis bsgrub pa'i me tog bcas nas bskur ngor bdag 'dradapa' bo nusaldan rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge'o dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so sabo maṅga lam

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta nag lcag rar can gyi zab sgrubs shin tu bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i bum bcud kyis cha lags bskang bsdus nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs jo / gtsarsha na 31 gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: goskochen gzod nas spros bral ye shes rig pa'i sku lhun grub 'gags med mtshan dpe rdzogs pa' gar khro rgyal yongs 'dus rta mchog rol ba'i la mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo' rgyan du mchod bdag 'dra o rgyan rdo rje gshog rgod ngas ma 'ongs las ldan sgrub pa po yis phyir rta mchog rol pa'i zab bsgrub bkod par bgyi: de yis cha lags bskang ba bstan par bya sa ma yā phyi na gsang mchod ga ṇa tsakra'i gter 'dod yon rmad byung kun bzang rol par dmigs bsangs sbyang spel gsum sngags kyi bsgyur byas te ye shes lha yi dgyes pa bskangs ba ni hū trī: spre) med dbyings su mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i: 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: 'gags med dbyings las gdul bya'i re ba skongs: ma 'ong sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs dam bskang: thabs mkhas thugs rje'i mdzad pa rab skyongs ba'i: da lta'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs dam bskang ka dag rang byung rig pa mngon gyur
