ba'i: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i kyis thugs dam bskang: rang bzhin ma 'gags sku dang ye shes mjal: rig 'dzin brda rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: bka' lung lhag chad med par 'chad bsgoms nyan: gang zag snyan rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang byin rlabs dgongs pa'i ye shes 'bebs mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskang log rtog rū tra 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal: bdud 'dul rta mchog rol pa'i thugs dam bskang nyon mongs dug lnga'i gdon rnams tshar gcod pa'i: khro rgyal rta mgrin rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang: tshad med rnam bzhi'i brin las sgrub mdzad pa'i pho nya las byed tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang: bar chad 'byung po drung 'byin rdul brlag pa'i: dmus long rgyal 'brel tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang zab gsang bstan pa 'dzin bsrung spel mdzad pa'i: las byed lha chen sde brgyad thugs dam bskang bstan pa'i dgra sde thal bar brlag mdzad pa'i: bka' nyan ngur 'byug khyi sprang thugs dam bskang: ye shes gcig la rnam pa mtha' yas pa'i: pad ma gsung gi lha tshogs

066 thugs dam bskang: / hrī thugs dam gnyen po bskangs ba'i dam rdzas ni: lha rdzas phyi mchod nyon mongs nang mchod dang: dug gsum rang grol sman rag gtor chen po: byang sems dkar dmar gsang mchod ga ṇa tshogs a mṛ ta dang me sa rol mo'i sgra: rdo rje'i rigs ma dkar ser dmar ljang mthing 'dod yon sna tshogs dgra bgegs sha khrag gis: bskangs che/ra dbang dang dalnga sa shā1ba 455 du gache la yig ge brgya ba bzla zhing nyams chags bskang gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dngos grub thob bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags the tshom med do pad ma rgyal po' bka' sa ma yu ye ma rgyalaba'i dbang po pad ma saṃ bha was ma 'ong 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje snying po' chos zab gsang rgya sgro wa'i chos kyi sde grub pa' dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen bdo' la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra mdzod ma 'ong snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon cha'i gzeng pa long ba'i tshe nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas sngags nag skyesabu bcu gsum la bstan pa gtad pa'i bar chad rkyen snang sel dus kyi rgud pa 'ga' re gso bar 'gyur bden rdzun lag tu
rtebye shaṃ spra sa / ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ / ༷ bye ༷ ༷/ ༷ ༵ bye / // bye bye/ // hūṃ me/ ༷ ༷ / / / rdo rte ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ /༷ / /sa ༷ teXṭwāṃ ༷༷ ༵ ༵ ༷༷ daX /༷ sho/ / ngaXs ༷༷ yaX
gas/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las rta mgrin yang gsang khrosapa'i don dbang bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

badzra na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye: 26cazamar khuza mdzes pa'i dal bkod sgrub rdzas dang yo byad rnams ni gartsa ltar bsags bdag mdun bum bzlas rig me dor slob ma gral 'god khrus kyis sbyangs tho 'tshams bgegs bsal srung gur phub bden don bshad cing maṇḍal spro: de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni kye kun mkhyen kun gzigs 'gro mgon bla ma dgongs: bdag ni gsang ba bla med sgor 'jug kyi: lus ngag yid gsum smin byed thabs kyi dbang: ji lta ba bzhin gnang ba'i bka' drin stsol: lan gsum bla mas ye ma sdon smon las 'phros bskul ba'i 'dir 'tshogs rnams: gsang sngags dang 'phrad mos pa skal ba bzang dbang med bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa'i snod ma yi: sdom gsum nyams med srungs dang dngos grub sbyin:de nas skyabs 'gro ni na mo skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs bla ma dang: rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor la: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: bdag sogs yal bar ma dor rjes su zungs: lan gsum sems bskyed ni ho: brgal dka' srid pa'i rba klong stug po dra sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdung ba'i 'gro ba rnams: tshad med

gtsaX rnams bzhis 'dor med rjes bzung zhing phyin drug spyod pas myang 'das sa la 'god lan gsum tshogs bsags ni na mo dkon mchog la gusasgo gsum dad phyag 'tshal: dngos 'byor yid sprul ting 'dzin mchod pa 'bul: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa bshags: skyes bu gsum gyi dge la rjes yi rang theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: rgyal ba sras bcas mya ngan 'da' med bzhugs: dge tshogs gcig bsdus byang chub chen por bsngo: 'gro rnams kun bzang he ru ka thob shog: lan gsum sdom bzung na kye: bla ma mcheg dang he ru ka dpal dgongs: bdag ni gsang ba bla med sgor zhugs nas: rigs lnga'i sdom pa bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yan lag nye lnga rnam dag spyod par bgyi: srung mtshams las 'das rang snang ye shes dal blo bral ngang nas spyod do rjes su zungs: rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi thabs dang cho ga yis: dbang bskur rgyal po rtsol cig sku drin can: lan gsum dam chu ni ho tshor ba sgra yi dkyil 'khor ni: rin chen 'byung ldan nyid dbang bskur: gsang ba sngags ni nyan dbang thob: dam

tshig mchog gtad bdud rtsi gtig: a dṛ ta sidhi hrī: ho: mthong ba rgyang zhags dkyil 'khor ni: rnam par snang mdzad nyid dbang bskur: gsang ba'i dal la lta dbang thob:dam tshig mchog gtad bdud rtsi gtig: a dṛ ta sirnyi hrī: ho rdo rje lce yi dkyil 'khor ni snang ba mtha' yas nyid dbang bskur gsang ba zab mo 'chad dbang thob dam tshig mchog gtad bdud rtsi gtig: a dṛ ta sirnyi trī ho thugs mchog dpal gyi ze'u nas: rdo rje sems dpa' nyid dbang bskur: blo 'das ye shes sgom dbang thob: dam tshig mchog gtad bdud rtsi gtig: a mṛ ta sirnyi hrī: ho pad ma'i bcud 'thung dkyil 'khor ni las kyi sems dpa' nyid dbang bskur 'du shes gsum ldan sbyor dbang thob: dam tshig mchog gtad bdud rtsi gtig: a mṛ ta sirnyi hrī dam bsre phyar a mṛ ta myang du gzhugs la ye ma 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: srog gcig dam tshig thag pas 'brel: dpa' bo dpa' mo'i 'du shes kyis: sngags kyi dam tshig dag mnyams khyer: rdo rje'i mna' chu bdud rtsi 'thung: de rang sangs rgyas rigs su zin: sa ma yā a dṛ

gas/: ta sidhi trī: a la la ho: mig dar bkab ci me tog sbyin slob ma lhar gsal ye shes dbab de nyid brtan par bzhugs su gsol slar yang me tog 'bul ba ni ho: srid zhi med mnyams bde ba che zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas su: rjes chags bzhad pa'i he ru gar rig pa'i me tog 'bul lo bzhes: tshe bīrya pubye pu dza ho: phyogs mtshams gar bab mtshan ma brtags khyad ra gsang mtshan gdags pa na ho: me tog dbus su bab na pad ma 'ub chub shar du bab na pad ma spyan gsal: zhe tu bab na pad ma mthong legs: nub tu bab na pad ma dbang rgyal byang du bab na pad ma tshogs grol mchams su bab na pad ma mi bskyod: zhes gdag go tshom bu'i dbang ni hūṃ hrī sgrib bral zla gam 'od gsal ga'u nas: rjes su chags pa'i zer thag rab g.yos te slob ma'i lus la rab zhugs lnga 'dus dal: bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyid bskul nas: gnas yul ḍakki 'du ba chags thog bral:gnyug ma'i nye ru ka dpal nyid 'byub shog: pra ti maṇḍal e me tiṣṭha badzra: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni ho: bu khyod ye nas dag mnyam la: mig la ma rig rdul phog nong: ye shes

spyan mchog dbye bgyid na: dag chen sku gsum zhal mthong regag: tshe dzña na tsakyu pra be sha ya phaṭa: mthong ba bstan pa ni e ma ltos shig mdun gyi dal la ltos: zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor las gdos mtshan snang ba dmigs su med: rig stong rdzogs pa chen po'i zhal mngon gsum mthong na srid pa med: dbang chen gsang gsum lhun rdzogs 'grub 'di la the tshom tsam yang med: spro ba bskyed cig skal ldan bu: a a a phaṭa: de nas bum dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ trī bum pa stong gsal 'od kyi dal/ zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas dbus bdud bzhi nyi zla pad ma'i khar: dbang chen yang gsang khros pa bzhugs bde chen 'od gsal bdud rtsi 'phro skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid kyi rtog sgrib 'khru: snang zhen dri ma rnam dag byed: bskyed rims lha sku bsgom la dbang: rnam smin rig 'dzin nyer thob 'gyur snang stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shog:rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ma: rta mgrin yang khros kyi sku gtad la hūṃ hrī nga ni rta mgrin yang khros sku: sde brgyad dregs pa'i gtsug na spa: ma mo mkha' 'gro bde 1nga spror: log

ba tshu 'dren bdud bzhi chos skur sgrol: mdzad pa'i phrin las glog ltar 'byugs: pho nya dam can las la 'gyed cir yang snang ba'i he ru ga: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa yi: sku gsung thugs dbang bu la sbyin: lha dang bskal ba mnyam gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi nyis na gsung dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ hrī dum gcig kā pa la yi nang: bla ma yab yum mnyam sbyor skyems: kun dha byang chub sems kyi sprin a li ka li'i zer 'bar ba: skal ldan lce la bzhag pa yis ngag dang rlung gi sgrib bral zhing rdzogs rims bzlas pa byed la dbang: tshe dbang rig 'dzin nyer thob 'gyur: gsal stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a snyi ṣiñtsa a: sngags phreng gam la hūṃ hrī: gsang sngags rig sngags gzung sngags kun: snying po bcud du dril ba yi rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sngags: skal ldan bu la sbyin pa yis: 'byung 'jug sngags kyi sgra ru 'pho grags stong chos kyi rol mo 'grel: bde ba'i tsho la mkha' 'gro 'du: tshims pa drag ldan zlos gar basbyar: dbang chen gsung du smin grol shog: rtsa sngags mthar wāka

a bhi ṇiñtsa a sheradabang ni hū hrī: bde ba sbyin pa'i yid 'ong ma: lha mo'i gzugs can mdza' na mo ḍakki su kha gsang ba'i dal: gnas pa rtsa khams dpa' bos phyugs: g.yo ba rlung ni dpa' mos gtams kun dha byang sems dga' bzhi'i sprin: chags dang zhen pas ma yin par: bde stong 'bar g.yos brtul zhugs kyis khu rdul rlung sems bag chags zad khams lnga smin pa dwangs ma'i sku: phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin nyer thob 'gyur thabs 'di ma spangs dang du longs: dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal mngon gyur shog rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a je ṣiñtsa 4: phyag mab rag lnga gam la hū trī: bde gshegs snying po 'khor 'das ye khyab dbyings rdo rje rin chen pad ma las rdzogs pa dkyil 'khor yongs 'dus 'khor lo 'bar bas mtshon: gcig shes kun grol don dam bden pa'i dbyings: mngon sum rtogs phyir brda dbang bu la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a je ṣiñtsa hūṃ:tshig dab ni hūṃ trī: dpe yi mi mtshon nam mkha' che: tshig tu brjod bral spros las 'das: bsam du med de blo bral don: dmigs su med do yid chos dben: dal gyis

bsgotshu shar ba'i 'od gsal zhal hrig ger rig pa'i ye shes 'di:rtogs na don dam 'bras bu'i dbang:rgyal thabs spyi blugs chen po ste:rlung ni rang dang rtog pa sangs:kun khyab chos sku'i dgongs pa ste:'di la las dang rnam smin med:lhun grub rig 'dzin sa la sbyor:khreg chod bsgoms la dbang thob nas:rig stong blo 'das mngon gyur shog:rtsa sngags mthar dzñā na a snyi ṣiñtsa tre rtsal dab ni hū hṝ:ma bcos shes pa thad gar zhog:gnad gsum gzir zhing dbyings thog dril:ngo rang thugs rje gdangs shar ba:dbying thig rig pa lu gu rgyud:'og min phun tshogs lnga ldan dal:bde gshegs thams cad dus gcig mjal:lung rig man ngag stabs gcig rnyed:lta bsgom rtog ge'i tha snyad grol:bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes mjal:shes rab klong rdol kun mkhyen gzigs:rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob nas:snang bzhi'i yon tan mthar phyin shog:rtsa sngags mthar dzñā na a dzhai ṣiñtsa tre:bsgral dbang bam phur gtad la hūṃ hṝ:lege rtego zhing bcu tshang ba 'di:dpa' bo khyod la gnyer tu gtad:bsgral ba'i dam tshig mchog la spyod:

rdzong phreng sgog ldan dbang thob nas: 'tshang ba lnga yi yon tan 'byor: 'khor ba dongs sprugs mthu thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar garma du tra pra be sha ya phaṭa: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hrī:phur skor bya zhing 'dril gdab bstabs gsum bya'o me dbang hom dang dgang gzar blugs gtad la hū hrī: 'bar ba me yi dam tshig zungs: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun byi grub: gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar ba dang: zad par skye mched grub pa dang: 'byung khams dag spyor dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar darma du tra pra be sha ya phaṭa: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hrī: tshogs sa gam la hū trī: bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo: 'dod yon lnga ldan myong grol thabs: ga ṇa tsakra'i dbang bskur bas: dam tshig nyams chags bskang ba dang: bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas: don gnyis lhun grub dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar garma du tra pra be sha ya phaṭa sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hrī: bka' dbang ni ho gsang ba mchog gi dam 'dzin pa

bsgotshu gyis ze'ur dril: 'chad nyan bsgom bsgrub mthar byin nas: gu ru'i bzhed don 'grub pa dang 'gro don bsam yas dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar dharma a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā hūṃ: brtul bzhugs kyi dab ni hūṃ trī: ma bcos shes pa thad gar klod: dug lnga'i rtog pa ar la gtad: rdo rje mchu yi bro brdung ngo: gcan gzan chen po'i gar gyis bsgyur: khro bo rol pa'i glu yi bskul: mtshan ma'i snang ba thad gar gcod 'og min chos dbyings a la la ha ste/ a e.u: ra ri tshe la la ho: mtha' brten gtor dbang ni hūṃ trī: brdal khyab dbyeras kyi bhanta sa 'od lnga lhun grub zlum 'byil klong dpal gyi mchod sdong rnam par mdzes 'dod yon lha mos rol gar bsgyur: rtsa ba gsum gyi 'du 'phro 'khrigs skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: tha mal rtog pa rnam dag nas: skye gnas thos bsam bsgom mthar phyin: rmi lam thog brdzis sprul bsgyur dbang: bsam gnyan rig pa rang grol jogasaḥ 'chi kha thim rims rang ngo shes: chos nyid 'od gsal ma bu 'dres: srid par rjes 5na zhing khams 'byang: bar do drag bsol 'bras bu'i

klong: sku gsum ye shes mngon gyur nas: 'khor ba dngos sprug nus par shog: rtsa sngagasamathar maṇḍal bā ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā hūṃ hrī: rtsa ba yan lag dam khas bla yon tu rta glang rin chen 'bul sgo gsum stos med bla mar gnyer dge ba mkha' khyab 'gro la bsngo dge mtshan bkra shisamatha' brgyan bya rjes su bskyed rdzogs zam pa btsug don gnyis lhun gyis grub par bya rgyal dbang pad ma'i thugasabacud 'di skal ba can gyi dpal du shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i don dbang bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu gye o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda zim snyi zhes pa'ang sprul sku thegs mchog rgyal mtshan chos gsal ratna sa ra rnams kyis mos ro ra kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legathanga'aphel sarba ma lo/
༄༅// bdag bskyed gu ru drag khros khyung zhon gyi 'don 'grig rab gsalame long bzhugs/

༄byubyu/ na mo gu dzagapadma ka ra ye: bdag bskyed drag khros khyung zhen 'don sgrub bya ba la/ dang po/ tshig bdun spyan 'dren lan gsum/ gsol 'debs rnam gsum/ skye ba kun /ra sogs regag bsang chu byin rlabs ni/ hū/ bisne ta krita bsang / rol bar migs: mchod dzos byin rlabs ni/ hū/ bisne ta krita su bha wa hri: chos dbyings nam mkha'i sogs khaṃ spos byung la/ hū bisne ta sā bha was sbyang / oṃ/ lha shing sogs ya ho: gsol 'debasagang rung dang rol mo byin rlabs ni/ hū hrīḥ rtags kyi rdo rje sogs a hūṃ skyabs yul bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar thogs dmigs la sgrub gzhung las/ na mo: bka' drin2nasum sogs maṇḍal mjug /a hūṃ: /dza hūṃ baṃ 21: 31gas zhing sogs gyur: skyod ma ṇi su bha wa mdzod sngagasagasum/ skye ma hā gu ru sarba hūṃ sngon gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ dza stong gsum sogs sa ma yā chang glud bsngo ba na/ bdag nyid skad cig gi/ sogs hūṃ phaṭa gzhung la bka' bgo na/ hū trī rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thogs dengs shig /sum bha gnod byed bgegs sogs phaṭa srung 'khor ni/ hu hā snang srid thams cad sogs nas/ tsitta hūṃ: byin 'beb zur bkol nas/ hu dza yo rgyan mkha'

'a1tsware sogs a ā: gzhung las/ hūṃ dza: tse( rgyan mkha' 'gro sogs shad 'gros kyi sman mchod mjug gi kha hi'i bar zur bkol sman mchod ni/ oṃ āḥdhū: gdod ma'i sangs rgyas sogs a hūṃ: rakta 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ: dung chen snod du sogs sangs rgyas shog 'dzab bskul na/ hūṃ trīḥ gsang ba mchog gi sogs myur 'grub shog spre: badzra phaṭa: hūṃ hrī: rang rig bla ma'i sogs hūṃ phaṭa: bgrangasaphreng byin rlabs las/ skyes sarba dharma sogs swā hā: rim bzhin bsnyen sgrub lasagasum bsnyen pa dang / mjug bsnyen bstod la/ lhag chad kha bskang dang / ho: drag 11sa khyung 61na sogs mdzad du gsol: gartsa ga mja bstod ni hūṃ trīḥ rigs kun yongs 'dus ho: bstod pa ni/ hūṃ trī ma chags padma sogs bstod: bka' rgyud bla ma bstod par 'os pa sogs bstod: dge ba 'di yi sogs shog mchod byang la/ gtor snod lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du gtor ma de nyid zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs dngos su gsal la: na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa sogs gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig lan gsum/ bstim cig dza hūṃ be ho: sngags drug

༄༅/ phyag drug /mchod byang la/ hūṃ/ rang mdun dur khrod/ sogs bskang gsol/ ṭā bcas gsum/ gsol bsdus ci 'grub/ gzhung gi bstod pa na/ dza bhyo chosadabyings sogs bstod ra lugs gsol kha 'don/ hūṃ bhyo: ye shes dbyings sogs stsal du gsol: padma'i ring lugs rgyal dbang sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sogs— du gsol/ bshags pa ni/ ho ye shes 'jig rten sogs shuddhi a: yig brgya gcig /rten snying gsum/ dgongs spyod dag sogs bkra shis shog: rang snang ye shes sogs ṇa sa: nongs bshags ni/ oṃ/ kun bzang chosakyis sogs dpal thob shog yig brgya ci nus bzlas/ rdzas bskang la/ yo ā hūṃ dbyings rig dbyer sogs dong sprug shog: tshogs bsdus na/ ṭā bcas/ hūṃ hrī: rnga yab srin gling sogs byang chub regag: yang na/ oṃ aḥshā: bka' rgyud bla ma sogs rje btsun bla ma sogs du gsol sa twa ci 'grub/ yag brgya/ ho: dam tshig nyam chags thams cad bshags pa'i khams gsum 'khor ba sku gsum klong du byang chub shog tshogasabyan mas na/ hūṃ hrīḥ brdal khyab sogs pu tsa kha hi: bskang rdzas byin rlab na/ oṃ ā:hū bza' bca' btung

bar sogs spro: mdzod sngags bdun/ dgyes bska ni/ hūṃ hrī: chos dbyings spros bral sogs shog bar bshags ni/ ho: blo chung sogs shuste ā: tshogs 'gugs ni/ tshogs sgod sogs khug cig lan gsum/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho: bsgral ba ni/ hūṃ 〉: snying rje'i 'gal sogs phaṭa: bstab pa ni/ hūṃ byes thob phyes sogs— kha hi: gnas bskang ni/ bla ā& chos dbyengs mtha' sogs kha hi: tshogs la rol ba na/ sa theg pa mabyedag gi sogs a la la ho bsam lhun che chung gang rung dang / sgrol ma 'don/ he ru ka dpal sogs regag lhag ma byan rlabs na/ lhag malisnod pho phe gzhung gi lhag ma ni/ phophe: chos dbyings stong pa'i sogs kha hi: tshogs mchod phul bas sogs thob 31ga de nas mdun bskyed dgra bla'i rgyal po'i sgrub pa la 'jugasaparabya'o/ bskul ba man chad bdag mdun 'thab lugs ni/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ a:las bhasto sogs skyed ā:hūṃ: gzhung gi bskul ba ni/ /: ma gapa la ma gapa la sogs sa ma yā: ge sar sgrub gzhung lasabhyo ma g.yel ma g.yel sogs mdzod: po mdo byan rlabs na/ gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur āḥ/ gartsa las/ hūṃ bhyo: dag pa'i lha

༄༅/ sogs sa ma yā:ge sar sgrub pa las/ hūṃ bhyoḥsngon tshe sogs phrin las mdzod: brtan ma byin rlabs ni/rin po che'i snod du sogs oṃ āḥhūṃ:lan gsum/ bhyo:rdo rje padma thod phreng sogs kha hi: ge sar las/ bhyo:sgob dpon padma sogs kha tī: bro 'gugs ni/na mo: bla ma drag po sogs dza dza:lan gsum/gzhung las/hūṃ:gru gsum chos dbyings sogs ya nan: ge sar las/ /: e nyid stong sogs nan:gtor gzhong bkra shis sogs swā hā: mchod bstod na/hū/ dngos su 'byor dang sogs mchod: tshe gu ru badzra kro dha ra dza ka ma tha la ra dza sa pa ri sogs ti tstsha swā hā:hā: ma bcos spros bral khyung zhon las/ hūṃ trī: padma'i zhal bstod/ ge sar las/ hūṃ hrī dpal ldan padma sogs bstod/ bka' rgyud bla ma sogs bstod par 'os sogs bstod:bzod gsol na/gzhung las/ho:rig 'dzin bla ma'i sogs sa ma yā a ge sar las/ho:gnyibasa'adzin sogs ā:bsngo smon khyung zhon las ho:snang srid sogs regag lan gsum/ge sar las/ho 'dosas dang sogs regagalan gsum/ skyod 'dir ni sogs swā hā:bsdu ldang ni/a:snang cha sogs phaṭa:ge sar las/

a: lha snang sogs phaṭa: rtsa sngags dang rten snying gcig shis brjod ni/ na mo: brgyud gsum bla ma'i sogs regag ge sar las/ na mo: chos dbyings spros bral sogs regag ston pa 'jig rten bstan pa'i gnas 'dir 'byung po 'dir ni rgyal dengs 'dir sogs su dza ya de ltar du sogs gyur cig /mtha' bsdud smon lam sogs rgyun sgol ltar ro/ zhes 'don 'grig 'di nyid rigs sras padma theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhal bkod bzhan/ dung dkar ba thub bstan grags pas yi ger bkod pa dge bas gter chen gang gi zab gter bstan pa mi nub srid mtha'i bar du gnas par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/ dza yantu/

༄7/ ho drag khros khyung zhon rtsal gyi dkyir 'khor kyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ skyobs pa'i nus mthu/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas mchog gi dngos grub drag khros khyung zhon rtsal gyi go 'phang mngon sum du thob pa dang / thun mong gi dngos grub phrin las rnam pa bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang / grub pa chen po brgyad thob pa lasogs pa/ mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub dam pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/

—8/sde: zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las: gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel bsdus pa byin rlabs 'byung gnas bzhugs so:badzra: na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye: rgatsho/gami/rgo dad mos gdung shug drag po yi: gu ru yid la dran byas nas: dus drug gsol 'debs 'di nyid bskyal bar chad zhi nges gtan tshig yin sa ma yā: e ma ho sku gsum ston pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi: thugs sprul 'gro ba'i mgon po padma 'byung : khyad 'phags rig 'dzin sku la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dabhe : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad: thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba smin grol byas: gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rab tu sbar: gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad la phyi nang gsang bsam pa nyon mongs gdung ba tsha zeradrag po yis: mnar ba'i dmus long 'gro khams kha lo bsgyur: bcom ldan gu ru drug la phyi nang gsang bsam pa spre'u tsha rgyud gnag blo rmong gtum pa rnams: thugs rje

thabs kyis dam chos lam la bkod: mkhan slob chos gsum sku la byi nang gsang bsam pa mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag bzhengs mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me gsal bar byas: rje 'bangs rig 'dzin tshogs la phyi nang gsang bsam pa sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: thugs kyi dgongs pa las can bu la bzhag/gu ru thugs rje can phyi nang bsam pa dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal ba dang : sgrub mchog bsam pa yid bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i lhag pa'i lha mchog nyid la phyi nang gsang bsam pa nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe: rang snang dag pa dpal ri pad ma'i zhing : ston 'khor rnam par dag pa rab mched nas: 'dus pa dang po' 'khor du skyebar regag: tshod āḥhūṃ:badzra gu ru padma sirnyi hūṃ: de ltar gsol ba btab pa yi phyi nang gas ba'i bar chad sel nyams dang rtogasapa'i yon tan 'phel dbang dang dngos grub thob par 'gyur bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsal the tshom med do sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya/ brda thim5nices pa 'di'ang btsun chung garta'i skye rtags can gyas bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra nus lan rdo rjes dag par phab te ya ge pa na padma smon sems kyas bgyis pa'o/

—8rdo: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las/ sngon 'gro rnam mkhyen lam bzang gi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so:—8rdo — them medasnyi na mo gu ru padma kā ra yeḥ tho/6)ca/sgacas dad dang mo gus gdu ba drag po yi'i thal sbyar nyan pa' dbya sa gyis 'di skad do e ma ho: gdod nas ye sangs rgyas pa kun tu bzang : lhun grub 'gags med rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho: thugs rje med byung bcom ldan rdo rje sems: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: chos kyi 'byung gnas dga' rab rdo rje dang : rdzogs chen ston pa rig 'dzin shrī seng : mkhas shing grub pa mañdzu mi tra la: gsol ba 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brtes pad ma 'byung bi ma mi tra ye shes bka' rgya mtsho zag phung 'od skur grol ba mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba blo gros dbang phyug khye'u chung ye shes dbyings: don gnyis mthar phyin rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga:brtul zhugs mthar phyin bdud 'dul rdo rje la: gsol ba don gyi rig 'dzin dpa' bo rol pa rtsal chos nyid 1nga rdol rdo rje khro bo lod: snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma

la: gsol ba skye med dbyings las dgongs pa ma g.yos kyang : thugs rje'i rang gzugs rdo rje'i bla ma yis: rjes bzung dbang skur blo sna chos la bsgyur: phyi nang skyen zhi sa lam mthar phyin nas: kun tu bzang po'i rgyal sa zin par regag de ltar gsol btab phyi nang bdud las rgyal nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su rnam par 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje padma'i bka' shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa rmad byung rdo rje snying po'i chosasde rnams grub pa'i 'byung gnas khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brta la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongasargya mdzod ma 'ongs snyang ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo nge da 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal na kon mod rgyal khams 'grams la stos dang mthong bka' gsang thub pa ra srung shig nges nus ma skal med lag tu ma shor a thams rgya las can snyang gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya brgyud 'debs byan rlabs pabyud chen rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza'i bkod pa'o brda zim thizhes pa 'di'ang rdo rje'i lung gas bsngagasapa'i

— mi: skyes mchog padma nor bus rdzas sna tshogs da bcas nas yang ya bskul ba dang chos bdag chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang slob bu ye shes ratna sa ra rnams kyis nan du bskul ngor bdag 'dra dga' bo nus ldanardo rjes 'bros phug ṭakki'i 'du gli nas rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin rlabs mdzad pa' gnas nas pa dma'i gsang brda zab mo las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam

ga6sdo: chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong mdzod las: sku phreng gsol 'debs byin rlabs gnad 'bebs bzhugs so:—8rdo: na mo gu ru we: e ma ho: skye med chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang : ma 'gags rang grol longs sku snang mtha' yas thugs rje rmad byung rnal 'byor nus ldan par: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ thub pa'i spyan sngar 'phags pa sha ra'i bu: o rgyan yul byon chos rgyal trig na pa: nor bu go len yang dag mngon gyur dpal: gsol ba bod khams mun sel sems pad ma'i spyan snga dra 'brog mi lo tsā khye'u chung ye shes blo: bstan pa'i phyi mo nor bu don grub la: gsol ba dgongs pa mngon gyur rnal 'byor mkhar nag pa: sbyor sgrol thabs mkhas mgon po rdo rje dang : chos kyi mdzod 'dzin he pa chos 'byung la gsol ba zab gter mda' bdag bdud 'dul rdo rje dang : grub brtes dbang phyug dpa' bo rol pa rtsal: chos nyid klong rdol rdo rje khro lod la: gsol mkha' spyod gnas nyul ye shes rdo rje dang: zab gsang sgo 'byed rdo rje drag po

rtsal brtul zhugs mthu stobs nus ldan rdo rje la gsol ma 'ongs bstan pa'i nyi ma kun skyong gling: gcod spyon drag bzhad rol ba'i rdo rje dang o rgyan bde chen gling pa ye shes mdzod gsol gdug pa tshar gcod rdo rje bsam 'grub rtsal: 'khrul zhig rnal 'byor tse rgyan zhig po ba: thabs mkhas spyod pa bskyangs ba'i mkha' khyab rje: gsol ba snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon 31 rgyan las 'phro gling : byams pa'i spyan sngar byang sems ral gri 'dzin: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas mes pa mthas yas grags: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: de ltar sku yi phreng ba bsam mthas yas: yid la dran zhing rtse gcig gsol btab mthus: khreg chod chos sku'i dgongs klong mngon gyur nas: gang shar skudang ye shes rol bar mthong thod sgal snang bzhi'i nyams len mthar 'phyol te: zad pa gsum rdzogs gzhon nu bum sku'i sbubs: 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen por sangs rgyas 31ga: de ltar mos gus gsol btab byin rlabs 'jug phyi nang gegs zhi bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya ces pa'ang chos rkya bdag po padma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang las ldan las rab zhes byas dar dang shog bu
— mi: bcas ya yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes/'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du' gling nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam/

gtsasdo: na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye zabs/do/ bsang chu gams la byin pos ni hūṃ: bisne ta krita phaṭa: bsang chu'i nang du hūṃ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad pa: khro bo'i chas du ma rdzogs par gsal ba'i sku yi cha thams cad nas khro chung rdul phra rab tu 'phros pas: 'byung po dam sri thams cad rdul tu brlag pa dang: mchod rdzas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rol bar bsgyur nus pa'i mthu ldan du dmigs la: nyu bisnan ta krita tshinta tshinta phaṭa: nyer gcig bo da lha nyid 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rol bar dmigs: de nas mchad pa'i rdzas la chab byung ni hūṃ bisne ta krita sogs mchod rdzas byin rlabs niḥ trīḥ chos dbyings nam mkha'i brgyan gyur lha rdzas sprinaḥbade sbyin rdo rje lha mos phyag las sprosaḥ zag med zag bral kun bzang dga' ston gteraḥ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams skongs phyir spelaḥ sa badzra pū dza sma ra ṇa dzaḥ zhes pa'ang nus ldan pas sngo mtsho'i 'dabs nas sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/

—8rdo: spos byu niḥ o lha shing sna tshogs sman gyi dri bsung ldan 'ja' lnga'i spos sprin spro ba'i bdug pa moḥ mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dgyes pa skongs sems can ma rig rlung sems sangs gyur cigaḥ sang sa le sang nge badzra dhu be pu dza sa ma ya hoḥ 'di yang gnyan po g.yu rtse'i gnas mdun nas nus ldan pa sa sbyar ba dge/ rol mo byin rlabs ni rol mortul sprugs bsang sbyangs bya stong nyad lta ba rtogs pa yi hūṃ hrīḥ rtags kyi rdo rjes snang ba zang thal byed: chos dbyings dril bus mtha' bral dgongs pa mtshon: bcu drug ltag sprod dpa' bo yab yum rdzas: bya ba yongs grub rol mo ting ting shag: khams sum chos sgras khyab pa'i rnga bo che grags stong chos 'khor bskul ba'i mkhar rnga dang kha grags dbyangs snyan rgyal ba dgyes pa'i sprin: snyan 'gyur ye shes glu yi mchod pa rnams: ka dag klong nas gzugs kyi bkod par ngom: rdul snyed rgyal ba'i zhing kun mchod byed cing : stong gsum 'jig rten chos kyis rang sgras khyab: 'khor ba dong sprug mdzad pa mthar phyin shog: ma badzra ghaṣṭi dharmā shabha ri ti ā 〉: skyabs yul bskyed pa ni mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig

le me dpung gi klong na gu ru drag po khyung zhon rtsal la rig 'dzin paṇa grub rgya mtsho: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bka' sdod pho nya rgya mtsho: rtsa gsum sprin gyi phung po thams cad kyi bskor nas rang cag rnal 'byor pa la zhal gyis phyogs spyan gyis gzigs: thugs brtse ba chen pos rtag tu srung zhing bskyab par dmigs la dza hūṃ be ho tshogs zhing rnams 'od du zhu nas ra la zim pas rgyud smin cing grol bar gyur sngon gtor chang glud bsngo ba ni bdag nyid skad cig gis dran rdzogs ga ga ma'i lha sku dbang chen he ru ka dmar po g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad pa: dur khrod dpal chas kyis mdzes par brgyan zhing: zhabs gnyis gyad kyis 'dor thabs su bsgrad pa: che btsan gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khyud cing : ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du snang srid zil gyis gnon par bskyed do: de'i spyi gtsug nas rta skad drag po stong gsum khengs par sgrogs pas lha srin dregs pa dam sri 'byung po thams cad dbang du sdud cing dam la 'dog par bsam mo na mo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med

—8rdo: pa'i bden pa'i mthus: sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i 'dre bgegs dam sri 'byung po las dang skyen las byung ba thams cad sbyin yul mgron du khug cig: sarba bhu ta a na ya dza: dza hūṃ baṃ ho: o su bha was sbya sa stong pa'i ngang las tre las rin po che'i snod dutsan las glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung por gyur: o ā:tu: lan gsum/ saṃ bha ra dang a ka ros glud gtor zad med gter du spel de nas gnyen po las kyi la rang nyid dbang chen gnas su gyur pa las: bdud 'jom rdo rjegu ru drag po khyung zhon rtsal rngams pa'i brtul zhugs can dpa' brdzid bzod par dka' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan par bskyed do: gu ru rakru kro dha rā dza hūṃ phaṭa: de nas bsgrangs phreng byin rlabs ni oṃ sarba dharmā ga ga na ā: phreng ba rnams bde gshegs zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor du gsal gdab: phreng lung ye shes lnga yi gsang lam la: mdo 'dzin kun bzang yab yum kyi dgongs nyams la dgyes par rol ba'o kun kya bde ba chen po'i gzi byin 'bar te gar mdzad: byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis dzul snyed rgyal ba'i gzi byin bskul bar

mos: lha tshogs kun gyi zhal nas gsang sngags snying po'i rang sgra 'u ru ru sgogs pas 'khor 'das kyi dpal yon dwangs bcud byin rlabs dngos grub kyi rnam pa ma lus pa bsdus nas bdag sgrub pa po la stsol bar dmigs la: skyod ru tsi ra ma ṇa pra warbha na ye swā hā: dbyang sa gsal rten snying lan gsum brjod me tog 'azor la rab tu gnas tshogs 'gugs ni 37gas snye da lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du: tshogs rdzas de nyid zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs dngos su gsal la: na mo rig 'jin rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam gu ru drag po khyung zhon bdud 'dul dgra bla wer ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus: sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad tshogs tha ma dmigs pa'i rten 'di la myur du khug cig: 3sna badzra adru sha dza: dza hūṃ baṃ ho tshogs bsgral bya lhag ma'i sno bharnya lcang lo can gyi nang du bzhes lhag dang drangs lhag zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur: pañtsa a dṛ ta hūṃ ha ho hrī: lhag sdud kyi pho nya dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams 'du ba chen po tshogs kyi pham

—8rdo: phab kyi dga' ston la gshegs shig byon cig: e a ra li trīng hrīng pho phernyi lhag ma gtong ā las bhanta yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dgra bsgral ba'i sha khrag las byung ba'i 'dod yon zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir gyur: snyen āḥhūṃ: lan gsum bskul bdang chad mdo gtong rin po chelisnod du bshal chu zag med ye bdud rtsir gyur: o a:sa: lan gsum dang brtan ma gto na mo: bla ma drag po gu ru khyung zhon rtsal dang mdun bskyed dgra bla'i rgyal po'i lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa'isgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri nyu4 spun dgu bse rag dbul sri pho mo thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab gsal ba'i 'og rol tu khug cig: tri'u tri'u rā dza da nan: tri'u ya ma spun dgu nan: tri'u bse rag dbul sri nan: tri'u the'u rang god 'dre nan: tri'u tri'u hur thum dza: gzer thum trig shag ram̐: sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gshā gnod byed sgab 'dre khug: rgab 'dre'i snying la dza dza: bro mnan bya gtor gzheng bkra shis mdzes pa'i snod yangs par: phan bde'i dge mtshan dpal yon gyi char chen potha

su gang bar gyur cig sarba a yudzñā na pukhye puṣṭi ku ru ye swā hā:me tog mthor bkra shis so/bsregs blug nyon mongs g.yul 'joms kyi sngags byang ni/sa mthularātsanasarbasamayāpher:dgrabagegasadamasri'abyungapo〉rayatsalaram̐khatwe:

dza dam chos thugs kyi gter kha lasaḥ gu ༄ drag 'gros khyung zhon rtsal gyi gsol 'debs dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs soX dza na mo gu ru padma ka ra yeḥ ༅phonaza zabasgo khyed shes dad pa drag po yis gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa na ma ā&: ka dag spros mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nas chos sku gdod ma'i mgon po yab yum laX byar med blo 'das ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ dgongs rgyud rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobs 'gags med bde stong 'od gsal pho brang nasaX longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga yab yum laḥ 'dzin med rang babs ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ brda brgyud rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ stsol med thugs rje phyogs klong bral ba nasaḥ sprul ba'i sku mchog dga' rab rdo rje laX yengs med spro bral ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ snyan brgyud dgongs don rtogs par byin gyisarlobasaX rang snang 'od gsal zangs mdog dpal ri nasaX rang rig ngo bo bla ma pad 'byung laX gnyis med zung 'jug ngang nas gsol ba 'debs lhan skyes gnyug ma rtogs

nyis rlobasaḥ dhu ma tha la mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus nas ma cig mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyal mo laḥ dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal ngang nas gsol ba 'debs zab don bar bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ gar bzhugasam nges dag pa'i pho brang nas lang gro lo tsa dkon mchog 'byung gnas laḥ mos gus ltems rkyangs bral bas gsol ba phrin las thogs med 'byung bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ spyi gtsuganyi zla padma'i gdan steng nas rtsa rgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams laḥ khyed shes dad pa drag po'i gsol thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobasaX mi 'gyur thugs mchog dpal gyi ske'u nas gu ru drag khros rdo rje khyung zhon la rtse gcig gdung shugs drags 4 ba 'debasaḥ snyigs ma'i rgud pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ tshad med brin las lhun grub pho brang nasaḥ dpa' bo keng dang bka' sdod rgya mtsho laX dam tshig gsang / pas gsol ba 'debs bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs de ltar gsol babatab pa'i byin rlabs kyis lus ngag yid kyi 'dzin zhen rang sar

dzag dgaḥ'agyur med bde stong gsang gsum phyag rgyar smin dka' ba med par nyams rtogs stsal rdzogs nasaḥkun bzang ye shes bla ma'i sa thob shogaX de ltaragasol ba btab pa'i mi'i bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur phyi nang bar chad bdud las rgyalaḥnyams rtog yar ngos zla ltar 'phelaḥs ma yuḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥzhes pa'ang lung zinag༄garab mi'abar nasabakra shas dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang /slob bu dhe wa'i shog gu'i mthun rkyen bcas mos blos bskul ba dang /grogs nas kyang nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byoragasang sngagasamibaskyes gling pa' mkha'a'agro'i mdzod brda las bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa na las smon 'phro 'dzoms 'gyur rdo ming gis 'gyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga lam/

dza dam chos thugs gyi gter kha lasaḥ gu ru khyung zhon rtsal gyi gsol 'debs phrin las myur 'byung glogs zhags zer 'bar bzhugs soḥdza na mo gu ru gro dha ra dza yaḥ rtanasharwa/ dus kyi mar gshams snyigs ma'i dusaḥ nad mtshon rgud pa'i gzing langs nas bstan 'gro'i bde skyid nub rar phyogs de tshe lha 'dir re stos gyis gsol ba thob dang bslu ba med skal ldan pho ma'i snying la phur dam tshig ma g.yel sa ma yuḥ e ma ho rnga yab srin gling mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje boḥ byas rgyan chen po padma thod phreng rtsalaḥ snyigs 'gro skyabs med dag la mi dgongs samaḥ thugs rjes gzigs shig gu ru rin po cheḥ mtha' mi kla kle'i chu klung 'khrugs dus 'diraḥ yid gnyis thes tshom med par gsol 'debs naḥ sngon gyi dam dgongs du ru ka tshogs bzlogaḥ 'jig rten bde skyid ldan par byin gyis rlobasaḥ rgyal bstan rin chen nyams par mi byed par der 'dzin 'dus sde bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bcas rnam pa kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa na 31 rgyan chen po padma'i thugs rjes zungs de ltar gsol btab byin rlabs myur sems can bsod nams dman dbang gas mi dge bcu la dus

// mthun las kyi 'brasabu sminaḥ o rgyan thugs rjes skyobs par dka' bya ba thams cad chos la slob gom pa 'dogs 'jog dpal rir smon bar skabs nyi zhur tsam pa la ra gsol ba thob gdung ba'i 'bod do mig chu gzag las ldan mchis na skyobs kyang srid skal ldan pho mo'i thugs la brlanaḥ sa ma yuḥ zhes pa'ang sngags kyi dbang phyug dam ra mdo khams gnas kyi mchog gyur rdo rje phur ba'i bla mtsho'i 'gram/ gnyen po g.yu rtse'i srung skyobs mdzad pa' dga' tshal nas/ bdag 'dra o rgyan mkha' mnyam mi bskyod

dza e ma hoḥ rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba'i pho brang nasaḥ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dpal mgon bla ma laḥ khyed shes dad pas gsol ba yang yang 'debasaḥ sngon las 'phral rkyen rgud pa kun zhi zhing ཿ tshe dang bsod nams nyams rtogs 'phel ba dang ཿ khreg chod gzhi yi bden pa mngon mthong zhing ཿ thod rgal snang ba bzhi yis rtsal rdzogs ṭwāṃX/sa ༷ dī ༷ /'i sangs rgyas kun bzang dgongs klong duḥ khyad chos drug ldan bum skur byang chub 3 gaḥ zhes pa' dad lan a ska 'jigs skoms nas dad pa'i rten du bskul ba' mos ngoranusaldan rdo

dzag dam chos thugs kyi gter kha lasaḥ gu ru drag 'khros rdo rje khyung zhon rtsal byin 'bebs 'od zer drwa gur bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs bzhugasaḥdza na mo gu ru padma ka ra yeḥ rkasgadhā7/chatha rku sbyar spos bdug cing rol mo sgrogs mos gus gdung dbyangs glus bskul teḥ hū dzaḥ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus pad sdong khar rgyu rkyen las 'das rang byung sprul ba'i skuX mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gnad nas bskulaḥ nyams rtogs sgron me 'bar ba'i byin phob cigaḥ dur khrod chen po brgyad la dbang mdzad cing gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rjes bzung baX gu ru thod phreng sde lnga'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul ba'i dbang byin phobaX gdung dmar srin gling rnga yab dpal ri nasaḥ thugs bskyed zhal bzhes sngon gyi dam bca' can mi mjed skyabs gcig drag khros khyung zhon stsal gnad nas bskul lo dbang byin char du bsnyilaḥ bde stong mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling dbus nasaḥ dpa' bo ṭasmi 'bum khrag mkha' 'gro'i rjeḥ mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyal mo mtsho rgyal mas nyams rtogs 'od

dza/ bzhin gnang bar zhu dam chu sbyan pa ni hūṃhrīX 'di ni khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil rdo rje bgegs mthar chen po steḥ khyod kyi lce la reg pa yis gsang ba mchog gi dam tshig zungasaX phung 'tshengs nus pa sngags kyi chosaḥ gzu bor gnas mdzod skal ba canaḥ tho ā 〉༷ zhes dam chu sbyinaḥ sa ma ya na ra gaṇaX de nas dam khas len mig dar bkab cing me tog sbyin slob ma ltar gsal ye shes dbabaḥ de nas brtan pa ra bzhugs su gsol slar yang bum dbang bskur ba na hūṃ&ḥ stong gsal 'od lnga'i bum pa ru rigs kun yongs 'dus bla ma'i dalaḥgasang ba gsum rdzogs bdud rtsi 'khyilaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ sgo gsum dri ma dag gyur cigaḥ bskyed rim lha dbang thob pa dngaX snang stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shog rtsa sngags mthar ka ya.a bhi shing ma gu ru khyung zhan rtsal gyi sku gtad laḥ hūṃhrīḥ che btsan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam rdzu 'phrul sprul ba bsam mi khyabaḥ mi mjed zhing gi skyabs gcig paḥ gu ru drag po khyung zhon gyisaḥ sku gsung thugs dbang bu la sprinaX lus ngag yid gsum smin pa dang : dregs pa dbang bskur mthu thob shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi

jegs bdag seṅge sgra sgrogs kyi sku gtad laḥ hū trī mi stegs dam sri'adul mdzad cing ཿ gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me cheḥ gu ru seng ha garnye yisaX dbang mchog bu la yongs rdzogs gog rtsa sngags mthar kā ya.a bhi dpa' bo sde bzhi' sku gtad laḥhūṃ hrīḥ tshad rmed rnam bani'i brin las canaḥ gdul dka' 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags 'changaX las mdzad dpa' bo sde bzhi yiḥ dbang mchog bu la yongs rdzogs re gaḥrtsa sngags mthar kwa yas bhi ging chen sde bzhi'i sku gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ grin las rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa canaX mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung g.yul 'joms pasaḥ drag rtsal ging chen sde bzhi yi dbang mchog bu la yongs rdzogs regag ༷ rtsa sngags mtharaḥkā yaspeg bhi dbang phyug nag po' sku gtad la hū hrīḥ khamabangagasum srid la panga' dbang mdzadaḥ sbyor sgrol dam tshig thugs la 'changaḥ lha chen mtshon 'khor nag po'i dbang ཿ gdug pa 'dul phyir bu la sbyinaḥ rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi gshin rje 'char ga'i sku gtad laḥ dī rnyiḥ 'gro ba'i grog ladabang bsgyur zhingaX skye 'chi'i snang ba ston mdzad pa'iX shan pa lag dmar 'char ga'i dbang ༷ gdul dka' 'dul byir bu la sbyin rtsa sngags

dza mthar ka ya a bhi gnam sman nag mo'i sku gtad laḥ/ 1 chos dbyings nam mkha' dbang bsgyur zhingaX 'gro ba'i stong stog 'phrog pa mo za byed gnam sman nagamo'i dbang ༷ mngon sprod grub phyir bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi bdud nag ral pa can gyi sku gtad la / hṝḥ /kho bculidagra la bdud 'ad gnyis gcig tu bsdu yang rung mapha byed cing 'gro ba'i tshe srog bla la bza'aX bdud nag khrag ral can gyi dbang ཿ gdug pa 'dul phyir bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi srin po nag po'i sku gtad la / trīḥ nye mjas 'khrul palidagra sgog gcodaḥ mtha' bzhi'i dmag gis gnya' gnon pa gsod gcod 'phrul gyi srin po'i dbangaX sgor ba 'joms phyir bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mtharaḥkā ya a bhi drang srong mgo dgu' sku gam laḥshā nyi 'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur zhing ཿ gzas po'i srog la dbang za ba'i dra srong smug nag mgo dgu'i dbangaX dgra dpung gzhom phyir bu la sbyin rtsasngags mthar ka ya a sdi mgon po nag po'i sku gtad laḥhūṃ che 'oja galiyul la mnga' dbang bskyar gsang sngags bstan pa 'dzin bsrung byedaX dam nyams sgog bdud mgon nag

dza la bzhag pa yisaḥ ngag dang rlung gi sgrib dag shogaḥ gsang ba gsung sngags bzla la dbang ཿ rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i mthu ldan 'gyur gsal stong 'od gsal mngon gyur regagaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wākka a bhi 144 āḥsngags 'khor gtad laḥhūṃ hrī gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi yang snying bcud dril sngags yi ge'iḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ 'khor 'das gsang sgog mngon gyur 31gaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wākka a snyi phreng ba gtad laḥ sa trī rgyal ba rigs brgya 'dus pa'i dalaḥ gsang sngags bzlas pa byed pa'i rtenaX rin chen pad phreng dbang bskur roḥ rtsa rlung thig le'i khams smin shog rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wākka a bhi dregs pa sde gas snying po gto laḥ / trī zhing bcu'i rgol ba tshar gcod cing ཿ dge bcu'i khrims bsrung dam tshig 'dzinaḥ sa bcu'i dbang phyugs grogs byed pa'iḥ bka' stod gsung la dbang bsgyur shog rtsa sngags mtharaḥwākka a bhi gsum pa sher dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ trīḥ bde ba sbyin pa'i yid 'ong ma mi mo'i gzugs can 'dzum sgegs bzhadaḥ nye lam phyag rgyas mkha' gsang dbang ཿ skal ldan bu la dbang

bskur bgyi skyon du pha blta dang du longasaḥ dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal thabs shes rabasaḥ yas bab mas brtan mngon gyur teḥ rtsa rlung thig le'i khams smin nas bde stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shog rtsa sngags mthar tsitta abhi ṣiñtsa (ཿ phyag mtha rnam lnga gto laḥ hū trīX bde gshegs snying po'i ye shes dbyingasaX rigs dang dkyir 'khor 'dus pa'i zhal brda rtags rdzogs pa phyag rgyas dbang ཿ dpe la brten nas don rtogs shog rtsa sngags mtharaḥ tsitta a bhi mtshon cha sna tshogasagato laḥ hū hrīḥ zhid bcu dang du len pa dang ཿ mngon spyod las la sbyor ba'i phyir sna tshogs mtshon cha'i dbang bskur roḥ bsgral 'dren nus mthu phun tshogs shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a bhi rdo rje rtse dgu dang marga 'khor gto laḥ hū hrīḥ gdul dka'anyon mongs 'dul ba'i mtshon gnam lcags rdo rje mtshon 'khor gyis dpa' ba'i rtags 'byung dbang bskur roḥ sa gsum 'gro 'dul mthu thob shog rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a bhi me rṣa gto la phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub cing / rgol ba thams cad tshad gcod phyiraḥ drag po me yi dbang bskur ro bdud sde tshar gcod blag nus shog rtsa sngags mthar

dza bzhi skyang lnga rdor sems mamaḥ byang sems 'pho lugs rnam gsum lamaḥ ka dag grol gzhi mngon gyur shogaX chos nyid 'di gsal bar do rtsa gnad gsumartogs pa mngon gyur te rang snang rang shar rang grol teX gzhon nu bum skur spyod par shog0 srid pa 'khrul snang bar do yang ཿ rjes dran drug dang mngon shes lnga'iḥ 'dun pa rtsegacig gzung byas shing ཿ man ngag don la sa zin te ༷ sku gsum 'bras bu mngon gyur shogaḥ gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa bzhinaḥ gang la gang 'dul chos ston zhing gzugs sku rnam gnyis mdzad pa yisaX 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par shog rtsa sngags mthar maṇḍal bha 'o/ a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃyisahūṃ hrīḥ mtha' rten gam cing bden brjod byaḥ dam tshigs khas lenadabang yon 'bul sgo gsum ltos med maṇḍal 'bul shis pa brjod cing dge rtsa bsngo de ltar dbang 'di thob nas slar bskyed rdzogs nyams len bsgom byung zhing ཿ dngos grub bsgrub la bar chad med bsam pa' don kun yidabazhin 'grub man ngag srog gi gta' ru zungasaḥ sa ma ya yim rgyal dbang padma thod phreng gis snying gi yang tig ba da dril ba snying 'gro'i gdul bya skyobs pa'i phyir lasa'aphro can dang 'phrad par shog 'phrad nas gdul bya'i

ba:tshu dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las khyung sgrub spru gri reg gcod bzhugs soḥ badzra: na mo gu ru ba dma ka ra ye thazadartam hūṃ phying gsang ba'i dmargya bsdamaḥ smra bcad mi dang mi 'phrad par 'dre lajug yu dkar mang can dang ཿ gla nag rtsi dang shang kun bcas drag po lnga sbyor ril bu brtsam glang dmar rwa ya nang du gzhugs dal dbus bkod cing nyer spyod bkramaḥ bde ba'istan la bag pheb gnas lhar gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis skad cig bo/du ra bam las dug gi rgya mtsho khol zhing me rlung 'tshub ma'i klong du lcags kyi rgong nga sngo nag 'od 'bar ba las spros pa'i 'od kyis dregs pa can ma lus pa'i nus mthu bsdus te gnyis su med par bstims slar yongs su gyur pa las yi ge khromaḥ mthing nag las spros bsdus byas pa'i mthus bskul te bdag nyid ye shes kyi khyung nag rlung gi btagag pa can lcags kyi mchu sder bsgrad cing spyan mig g.yas g.yon la gser dngul kyi chu 'khyil ba ba spu dang sgro gseb nas lcags kyi bye tshan 'bar ba'i char g.yo zhing bu ga thams cad nas me rlung dug zer byi bu yug 'tshubs shing sprul ba thog ser ltar 'phro bar bsgomaX gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa

bon dang thugs srog khromaḥ yig las spros pas 'od zer kyis ye shes kyi khyung dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la bstims moḥ thugs gar nyi ma'i dal steng du khro mthing nag lasngags phreng 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar g.yas su dmar kyi li li 'khor ba las spros pas 'od kyis sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen gri bo the 'gong thams cad tshar bcad cing rduladu brlag par dmigs laḥ skyonaje 1) ru ṭa bisne sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭaX brgya stong la sogs gang skabs brjod 'thu 'bum bzlas pas nyams rtogs 'baraḥ ཿsa ma yuḥlas spyor ni gnam lcags zhun ma'ikhyung gi tsha tsha 'khrugs pas gang gnod za 'dre phung sri nyes byed thams cad tshar bcad cing rdul du brlag par dmigs laḥ tshe lhang lhang : tser tser krig krig shag shag shelashel thum thumaX kas pur nanaX gnyan mgo la chodaḥ mo 'dre'i sha la dzaḥ bse rag gi sgog la rbad 'gong po'i mchu ching ཿ ram̐ ram̐ḥ hril hrilaX u mu ka myagaX mā ra ya rbad sod 'bum phrag bzlas pas nus mthu 'bar rno nus yon tan bsam mi khyabaḥ sa ma yu khyung chen sde lnga'i ril bu laḥ sngags kyi gzi byin yang yang dbabs nad gdon gang la gzir na'ang ཿ phan 'gyur the tshom yid gnyis bralaḥ sa ma shā/

bsgo/: mo 'dre'i kha ching byed 'dod na mthi shog la ni rgya mtshal da /khyung lnga bsres pa'i 'di ltar bri pe letshahuratsha'akhros b.raze—1musadadzwanag da dbu can rga med dgapa ra bra las sngags khri brjod rab tu gnas gang bsrung mgul btags bar chad kyiḥ'abyung po du 'dre'i rgol mi nusaḥs ma yuḥ bse rag za kha bcing 'dod na ri bong snying gi shun pa la mtshal dang khyung lnga bsres pa yi ༄dgagaceXsanusrunadagu'ilusangaga'adigasumadumabu'ikhudakhuzadza da dbu can tshag med dag par bra las sngags khri yi dbang bskur na bse rag 'gong po'i glags mi rtedaḥpha lam zung ba'imachog tu bsngagasaḥs ma māḥgri btsan kha tsha bya 'dod na rgod ma mtshal kha'i snying shun la gri khrag mtshal bsres khyung lnga yis pa'iparanan tsasarnad tsajunakhasduradadzar thu dbu can tshagamed dag par bri las sngags khri yis byin bskyed nas ga bsrung mgul btags gri btsan gyis gnod sbyor rgol bas glags mi rnyedaḥs ma yuḥrgyal po'i kha ching bya 'dod na ku ku dkar po' snying shun la mtshal dang rin chenalnga bsre pa /khyu chen lngar sbyor 'di ltar brtsalaḥ dzadatsha(tsho sdaldadadzas shi dbu can tshag med dag par bri las sngags khri yi byin gyis brlabs gang srung mgul btags ra dza yiḥrgol dang spyor ba tshugs mi
